zhing dag pa de lta bu la tshogs gsog par gyur na phun sum tshogs pa mi zad pa'i gter mdzod bsgrubs pa yin te/ de ltar lags par yang*/ rtag par tshul khrims ldan pa la// sbyin pa bkur stis brgyan pa sbyin// de ltar nor rnams gter bcug na// rjes su 'brang zhing dbrog tu med// bgyi ba gsung*/ de la sbyin pa gang yin na zan cig tsam sbyin par byed pa de yin/ bkur stis brgyan pa zan de sbyin pa'i dus su khyim ga dar legs par byed pa dang*/ gdan 'dings ba dang*/ snod legs pa'i nang du bzhag nas gus pa dang bcas pa zhe sa dang bcas pas sbyin par byed pa de bkur stis brgyan pa yin/ zan de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa la longs spyod pa sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bar du 'byung ba de dang mtshungs ldan du de'i khyad par gyi chos su 'byung*/ bkur stis brgyan pa de med na khyad par gyi chos de mi 'byung*/ des na zan cig tsam sbyin na yang bkur stis brgyan nas sbyin par byed pa yin/ tshan cig na re/ su thod thod la bkur sti gar thub zer ba 'dug ste de gar bden/ de gti mug gi rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ des na zan cig tsam sbyin par byed pa yang khyi la bskyur ba bzhin du phyogs su skyur du gar btub ste/ de nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ de mi dgos khyi la zan cig sbyin par byed na yang de zhing ma dag par sus shes te/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// gar mkhan dag dang ri mo bzang ltar snang*// bgyi ba gsung*/ gzhan yang de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bzhugs pas kyang zhing dag ste/ jo bos sems can gyi skyon mi mthong ba'i tshul gsung*/ gzhan yang de sems can gyi zhing du byas na yang*/ dman pa dang bkren pa dang ma rungs pa yin te/ ma pham pas/ dman la brtse dang sogs pa gsung*/ des na khyi la zan cig sbyin par byed na yang ngag snyan pa 'gas khrid nas kho dga' bar bsgrubs nas zan de byin nas/

kho dga' ba dang de'i rna lam du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan zhig brjod na de la zhe sdang mi skye bas khyi de myur du sangs rgya ba'i rgyu 'bras bsgrubs pa lags mod/ des na skyes bu rnams chos rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid nyams su len pa yang a cang ches te/ 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i chos ni 'di 'dra ba zhig gi khul nas sgrub par mthong gsung*/ gzhan yang rab tu byung ba sdom pa med pa zhig yin na yang de zhing du btub ste/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar por phog cig sdom pa blangs nas phyis sdom pa de shor bar gyur na yang*/ de bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la theg pa gsum po gang la zhugs pa'i theg pa des mya ngan las 'da' bar gsungs/ gzhan yang mdo de nyid du tshogs gsog pa'i rten du btub par gsungs te/ gla ba shi ba dang 'dra bar gsungs la/ gla ba shi yang rtsis gzhan tshim par byed pa dang 'dra bar/ kho rang la sdom pa med kyang gzhan gyis 'di rab tu byung ba yin snyam nas tshogs bsags pas gzhan gyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i rten du btub par gsungs/ 'di la dgongs nas 'jig rten mgon pos kyang thams cad rab du byin pa yin/ de la zhal snga nas khong gis 'jig rten mgon po tshur dbu bskor ba yin te/ phog cig btsun pa bya las spyi rgyags blang*/ de nas bu smad can du phyin pas chog snyam nas dbu tshur bskor ba yin gsung*/ spyis nas khong mgo phar bskor ba yin ste phog cig sdom pa blangs nas de nas babs kyang bskal pa bzang po 'di la mya ngan las 'da' bas mgo 'khor tshabs spyi'i de che ba yin gsung*/ de la ban gsar tshan cig snyam na sdom pa phog cig blangs/ de nas babs kyang sangs rgya bar 'dug pas babs pas chog snyam pa yang srid de/ des kyang mi chog pa'i tshul lugs yin pas de ltar mi mdzad/ de ltar dge 'dun la spyi dang bye brag bslab pa la gus pa dang*/ sdom pa phog cig blangs de nas sdom pa mi srung ba gos ser po gon tsam yang zhing du btub par gsungs pa yin pas na/

de ltar zhing dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab/ de bzhin du de la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ de ltar zhing dag pa la tshogs gsog par byed pa la bsam pa dag pa zhig gal che ste/ de gang yin bgyis par gyur na sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste bgyi ba gsung na/ de la sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i shes rab de don dam shes pa'i shes rab kyang ma lags/ kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab kyang ma lags te/ sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i shes rab de rin po che'i bzhed pas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la bzhed pa lags/ des na tshogs gsog par byed pa'i dus su sngon du 'gro ba'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems 'di bsgrub dgos/ de yang 'di ltar ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya snyam pa'i sems de lan bdun tsam bldabs nas bsgoms pas rgyud la bltab kyis bskyed/ des khyad par du byas nas sbyin pa de gtong ba yin/ de ltar ma yin bar gya tshoms su sbyin pa btang bas gar 'ong*/ des na su thod thod kyis sbyin pa gtong du mi btub ste/ bsam pa ma dag pa nyon mongs pa gsum gyi bsam pas sbyin pa btang na ni/ sbyin pa des bsam pa de rdzogs par byas nas rang phung gzhan phung bskyed pa yin/ de yang dpe ji lta bu yin snyam na sog ma med lta bu yin gsung*/ sbyin pa sbyin par byed pa la zhing dag pa dang bsam pa'i dug sel ba'i thabs la mkhas dgos/ bsam pa'i dug bsam pa ma dag pa nyon mongs pa gsum la sogs pas sbyin pa btang bar gyur na sbyin pas bsam pa de rdzogs par mi byed par gsung ste/ sbyin pa 'di ltar byin na ni khyim bdag shing sa la chen po lta bu rnams kyi nang du skye ba nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du gsungs na/

sbyin pa 'di ltar byin na ni ces pa ni bsam pa'i bye brag la zer ba yin/ des na zhing dag pa la bsam pa dag pas dngos po che ba btang rung chung ba btang rung*/ gang btang ba des bsam pa de rdzogs par byas nas zhing de dang mnyam par 'byung ba yin mod/ zhing dang bsam pa'i dug sel ba'i thabs la mi mkhas par gyur na sbyin pa bsod nams kyi tshogs su gar btub/ zhing dang bsam pa'i dug sel ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i drung du rgyu'i dug dang lam gyi dug bsal bas 'bras bu'i dug rang shugs kyis sel nas 'ong*/ des na 'bras bu rnam par dag pa zhig 'dod na rgyu rnam par dag pa zhig sgrub dgos pa yin/ zhing dang bsam pa'i skyon sel ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i dus su/ rdzas kyi dngos po yod par gyur na tshogs mi gsog par 'jog gar phod/ 'di rang nyid la dgos pas rang nyid skyid pa'i kod kod cig bya snyam na rang skyid pa de lta sus mi 'grub ste/ chos byed pa dang skyid pa'i kod kod gnyis lan bu lhas su gar btub/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis kyang de gnyis lhan du mi 'dzom par mkhyen nas dga' bas nyams su blangs pa lags te/ rdzas kyi dngos po gtong ba dang bu dang chung ma gtong ba la sogs pa la tshor ba sdug bsngal re re mi 'ong ba ma lags kyang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ mi gtong ba gnyis lhan cig tu mi phrugs par dgongs nas btang ba lags mod/ des na skyes bu rnams snying nas chos byed na rang 'dzom pa zhig dang chos byed pa gnyis mi phrugs pas yang na cag kyis 'jog pa yin/ tshe 'di yang med/ phyi ma yang med pa'i yam yom 'dis gar 'ong*/ des na sbyin pa bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog par byed dgos/ de la gtong ba'i dngos po bzhi yin/ gtong ba ni rdzas dang zang zing gi dngos po gtong ba yin/ de yang zhing rnam par dag pa'i phyogs su bsam pa byang chub kyi sems kyis dngos po phra ba zhig btang yang des bla na med pa'i byang chub thob ste/

de yang dbul mo rgan mo lta bu yin/ yongs su gtong ba bu dang chung ma gtong ba yin/ gtong ba chen po lus gtong ba yin te nying sha'i spyan can lta bu yin/ de yang dus la bab pa'i dus su gtong ba yin/ nam dga' dgar gtong ba ni ma lags/ tshad med pa'i gtong ba ni/ 'gro ba gzhan la chos ston pa yin/ 'di gtong ba gzhan pas gtang bar dka' bas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ byams pas zhus pa las/ gang gis gaṅgā'i sogs gsungs so// gzhan yang rgyal po 'od zer chen po'i gtam rgyud gsung*/ des na 'gro ba gzhan la chos ston par byed dgos pa yin/ de la tshan cig chos ston pa ngo tsha ba 'dra bas kyang slob dpon byed zer ba 'dug ste/ da lta mi lus rin po che thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'phrad/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa dang mjal ba'i dus su chos mi ston na ngan song gi gnas gsum du skyes pa'i dus su chos ston nam/ chos tshur la zhu ba la bsnyen bkur byed pa la ston snyam na/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus su de 'dra gar srid/ chos phar la ston dgos pa yin te/ nged pas che ba sangs rgyas kyis kyang lnga sde bzang pos sran btsugs pa la chos phar ston du bzhud pa lags mod/ 'jig rten mgon pos kyang log mda' mdze grong du chos phar ston du bzhud pa'i gtam rgyud gsung na gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ 'o na ma gsol bar chad pa'i nyes pa mi 'ong ngam snyam na/ tshad med pa'i snying rje dang ldan pa'i dus su 'gro ba la chos phar ston pa las 'os ci yod/ des na rngan tshun chod byin nas 'gro ba la chos ston dgos pa yin/ rngan bzhin chos bshad pa gar bshad snyam na de yang 'jam dpal gyis gser mchog 'od dpal ma btul ba lta bu yin/ de ltar gtong ba'i dngos po bzhi gsungs ste/ aṃ gtong dang yongs su gtong a gtong ba che// tshad med gtong ba dam chos rin chen sogs// tshad med sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa pa yis// sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog

/bgyi ba gsung na de ltar gtong ba'i dngos po bzhi ni sbyin pa bsod nams kyi tshogs yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ de'i 'bras bu yin te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa thob pa de yin/ des na rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs las 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs 'byung ba yin/ snag tsha dang shog bu sbyin pa ye shes kyi tshogs su bshad pa yod snyam na/ de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'ong ste/ de bas 'gro ba gzhan la chos ston pa yang bsod nams kyi tshogs su bshad pa yin/ de ltar sbyin pa bsod nams kyi tshogs de don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyis khyad par du byas pas na gnyen po gzhan med de nam mkha' dang 'dra la de chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par 'byung*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyis khyad par du byas pas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho ma stongs kyi bar du sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lor 'khor zhing*/ sems can gyi khams dang mnyam par 'byung*/ de ltar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis bsags pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum thob ste/ chos kyi sku rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i ngo bor sangs rgya ba yin la/ gzugs sku gnyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas thob ste/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba yin/ de yang skyes bu rnams rtsa ba bsod nams kyi tshogs la rag las pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ de lta yin pa la nga'i nye du dang gnyen 'brel rnams kyis tshe gzhug mi phyid pas dogs/ nga rang gis kyang tshe gzhug mi phyid pas dogs snyam na ka ca'i bsog brun byed pa la dgos pa ci yod/ 'chi ba'i dus su 'jog nas 'chi ba yin/

nye du yin pa skad rnams kyis 'di shi na dga' ba la/ na na dga' ba la snyam nas/ 'chi ba'i dus su ka ca'i dngos po la 'di ngas thob bam khos khyer snyam du mig lta zhing*/ shi ba'i dus su ro rul pa de sgor ci thon thon byas nas khong rnams ha bzhad di re/ khong rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i rgyur song nas ro'i zas nor mi zas byas pa la dgos pa ci yod/ des na skyes bu rnams ltogs pa zas kyis gdungs pa'am da phrug phas gdungs pa bzhin du bsod nams kyi tshogs bsogs pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom par zhu ba de chos lags// //gnyis med 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor der// gzung 'dzin sprin tshogs ngo bo nyid kyis dag /dus gsum shes bya mkhyen pa'i ye shes shar// mi shes mun sel 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// skal ldan gdul bya rnams kyi snying la zhugs// thos bsam sgom gsum yon tan gter kha bye// chos lnga byang chub sems gnyis ded dpon gyis// pha rol phyin drug yid bzhin nor bu blangs// tshe 'di'i 'dod yon 'dam rdzab nang nas bton// rang byung ma ma rnam dag phyi bas phyis// mos gus sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'phyar// rang gzhan don rnams 'grub pa'i gsol ba btab// 'khor 'das bde skyid dgos 'dod char pa phab// khams gsum nyon mongs sems can dbul 'phongs bral// e ma 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i chos// 'khor 'das kun la ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// 'di bris bsod nams nyi ma lta bu dang*// bdag dang 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba 'dis// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob bar du yang*// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing*// mnyes pa bsgrub cing thugs dgongs rdzogs par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhing rnams su// rgyal ba'i sras mchog gtso bo 'jam dbyangs ltar// dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos mdzod 'dzin pa dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi gtso bor 'gyur bar shog

/'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// sems nyid 'od gsal dus gsum 'gyur ba med// a yi rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa// sgrib pa kun spangs mkhyen gnyis rdzogs par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung gi mdzod// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab mo'i chos// ma lus sems can khams la ston pa dang*// bla med theg pas smin grol byed par shog /sarba maṅga lam// //

817 ) ༄// tshogs chos rin mgon ma spyan snga sher 'byung gis zin bris// na mo rat+na gu ru/ rgyal ba'i zhing khams mi mjed snying po mdzes pa'i brgyan// thub chen nyi ma gnyis pa mnyam med rin po che// snyigs dus skye dgu ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa// dpal ldan 'bri gung chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal sras dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs dbus su// dri med sku mchog lhun po'i rgyal po snang mdzad de// bod yul dbus su byon cing rgya che'i chos// bde chen bla med 'khor lo bskor la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid mthu che grags ldan pa// mi mjed bdag po tshangs pa brgya byin lha dbang dang*// lha min klu dang gnod sbyin dbang po'i cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad mor gus pas btud la phyag 'tshal lo// rje thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di la/ rgyal ba bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten du lan gnyis su byon pa/ dgongs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku brnyes pa/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku che ba'i yon tan gyi grags pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pa/ phrin las thogs pa med pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ 'gro ba ma lus pa bde ba chen po'i sa la 'god par mdzad pa/ sngon thub pa chen po rtsa mchog gi drung du zhi bar gshegs phyin chad/ yon tan dang mdzad pa'i phrin las 'di nyid dang mtshungs pa de sngon phan chad kyang ma byung*/ da phyin chad kyang mi 'byung*/ da ltar sa chen po'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba/ gdul bya sems can thams cad kyi mgon gcig pu/ skyabs gcig pu/ dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bla ma/ mtshungs pa med pa'i rin po che/ gsol ba gang btab kyi dgos 'dod skong bar byed pa/ 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa de'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ltar skyob pa thugs rje chen po ldan pa/

rgyal ba shākya'i rgyal po des/ rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ tha mar rdo rje gdan gyi spo la srod la bdud btul/ tho rangs ye shes kyi mes shes bya'i bud shing thams cad bsregs nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes brnyes pa'i chos de gang yin snyam na/ sems nyid chos kyi sku spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar thugs su chud pa 'di yin te/ de ltar yang*/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig khong du chud// su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas// mi smra nags kyi nang du gnas bya snyam// zhes gsungs pas/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de rtogs par dka' bas na zab pa/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa dang bral bas zhi ba/ gdod ma nas sgrib pa med pas 'od gsal pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ rgyu rkyen gyis ma skyed pa'i 'dus ma byas pa yin te/ de nyid gang gis rtogs shing khong du chud pa de/ skye rga na 'chi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las brgal zhing*/ skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba med pas na bdud rtsi lta bu lags pas/ de bzhin gshegs pas thugs su chud cing sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyang de yin la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyams su blang rgyu'i sgom yang de lags/ 'o na de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi phung po dpag tu med pa gsungs pa de rnams rjod byed kyi tshig tha dad cing*/ chos kyi sgo sna tshogs su 'dug go snyam du sems na/ de yang yod mod kyi/ 'on kyang don la tha dad med de/ de ltar yang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams mgon po khyod kyis bstan// zhes gsungs pas/ chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor yang*/

don la sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba ston pas thams cad don gcig pa yin/ de la spyir chos kyi 'khor lo gsum du gsungs pa'i dang po wa ra ṇa sir bden pa rnam pa bzhi dang*/ bya rgod phung por mtshan ma med pa dang*/ rtsa mchog la sogs par nges pa'i don gyi chos kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa de rnams kyang*/ rten gyi gang zag rnams kyi rgyud tshod dang*/ blo'i rim pa la dgongs nas bsod nams bsags pa'i kha tshon du/ khrid kyi rim par gsungs pa yin te/ thams cad kyang sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba 'di rtogs par byed pa'i thabs lags/ de yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas sems nyid ston par byed pa'i thabs de rnams ni lam/ 'bras bu sems mngon par rtogs pa de ni rgyu/ des bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ston pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ de las 'gal ba ni 'khrul pa'i rgyu kun 'byung*/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu las sna tshogs pa las/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal 'byung ba 'bras bu yin te/ 'di la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs las 'byung ba dang*/ lugs las ldog pa gnyis yin/ de la yang lugs las 'byung ba rgyu ma rig pa yod na ma rig pa'i rkyen gyi 'du byed nas/ rga shi'i bar du 'byung la/ ma rig pa 'gag na 'du byed nas rga shi'i bar du 'gag pa yin te/ 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa dang*/ rig pa'i ye shes gnyis yin pas/ sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba de ma rtogs pa ni ma rig pa yin/ de rtogs pa ni ye shes yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa yin pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ rtogs dang ma rtogs ma gtogs pa// 'bras bu thob dang ma thob med gsung*// 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes las kyang*/ sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas de bas na rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa gnyis las/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis su byung*/

de nyid kyang rten 'brel gyi ngo bor gnas pa yin te/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba de mkhyen cing thugs su chud pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la thams cad mkhyen pa zhes gsungs pa yin/ 'o na rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba de rang sangs rgyas kyis rtogs par bya ba ma yin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa la de bas lhag pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba yin no snyam du sems na/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ nga byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa na rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di mngon du mdzad pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa yin no// zhes grong khyer lta bu'i mdo las gsungs te/ rten 'brel de nyid kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral bar thugs su chud pas/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel gyis bsdus pa/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis ji snyed pa mkhyen pa yin/ de ltar na mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba'am/ bla na med pa'i byang chub ces bya ba yang sems rtogs pa la zer la/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin pas/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ sems rtogs pa ni byang chub te// sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i gur las kyang*/ skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgya'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces gsungs pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang gi sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba bsgom par bya ba gal shin tu che gsungs/// /yang rje 'gro ba'i mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang*/ gshegs shul de dam pa'i chos bden pa bzhi yin/ de yang zab pa ston pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nas/

tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur/ stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces pa dang slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*// khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu kun gyi sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par thub pas gsungs// zhes pa dang*/ bu mo rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan gyi rgyu tshul khrims yin par rgya cher bshad pa dang*/ yang*/ nor bu rin chen lta bu'i tshul khrims bsrungs// rjes su mthun pa'i grogs la rtag tu bsten// sdig pa'i grogs la nam yang ma bsten dang*// sangs rgyas ye shes ring por mi thogs thob// ces pa dang*/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed du// dang ba'i sems kyis zas dang skom dag dang*// gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba yis// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim 'gro byas// gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag pa'i dus kyi tshe// nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa// bsod nams de ni de bas khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las kyang*/ tshul khrims 'chal ba rnams la sngags 'grub par ni rnam pa thams cad du ma gsungs pas/ tshul khrims kho na gal che bar gsungs pa yin no// de la dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i dbang du byas na/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis dam pa'i chos mdo rtsa ba 'di bden pa bzhir gsungs nas gda' la/ bden pa bzhir gsungs pa 'di drin re chung snyam pa la/ de shin tu yang gsungs nas 'dug pas drin che snyam par byung*/ gsungs pa'i tshul lugs kyang de nyid las/ nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas na zhes gsungs pa de'i don/ 'di ltar nges par 'byung bya ba gang nas gang du/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar nges par 'byung ba gsum du shes par bya ste/

gang nas ni khams gsum gyi 'khor ba nas/ gang du na byang chub rnam pa gsum du/ tshul lam thabs ni bden pa rnam pa bzhi/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras spong zhing mya ngan las 'das pa rgyu 'bras bsgrub pa yin/ de yang rgyu kun 'byung las 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'byung ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ gzhi nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang nas/ las yan lag bzhi ldan gyis/ ltung ba sde lnga gang rung gi las rdzogs par byas na/ 'bras bu khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'byung bar gsungs te/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po der rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis ma rig pa dang*/ 'du byed nas rga shi'i bar du 'khor ba'i phyir te/ gnas mal gyi gzhi las kyang*/ gtsug lag khang gi sgor cha lnga pa'i 'khor lo bris te// dbus su phag rgod bri bar gsungs so// des mtshon pa'i phag de chos gnyis dang ldan pas/ de yang ci rnyed rnyed thams cad za ba dang 'dra bar/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gzhi bzhag tu gyur cing*/ chags sdang gi rtog pa rab du rgyas pas blo shin tu blun pa dang*/ bsad par dka' ba bzhin du gti mug de yang spang shin tu dka' ste/ yang dag pa'i ye shes ma yin pa gzhan gyis mi sod pa yin gsung*/ ye shes de gang yin snyam na 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems las ting nge 'dzin skye/ de las shes rab skye/ de ltar zhe sdang dang gti mug 'dra bas/ de gti mug 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin te/ de mtshon pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bri bar gsungs/ zla ba de yang chos gnyis dang ldan pa yin te/ nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba zhi bas bsil ba/ gti mug gi mun pa sel bas gsal ba yin no// lam gyi bden pa dang 'gog pa'i bden pa'i dbang du byas na/ lam 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad du yang gsungs te/

mdor na nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sam bslab pa gsum yin/ de yang cha lnga pa'i 'khor lo de nyid du/ dge slong rtags dang ldan pa bri ba'i dgos pa lam gyi bden pa mtshon pa yin te/ 'dul ba bsdus par/ brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya// sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya// 'dam bu'i khyim nas glang chen bzhin// 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya// gang zhig rab tu bag yod par// chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba// skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas// sdug bsngal tha mar 'byin par 'gyur// zhes pa de 'bri ba'i dgos pa yang de yin/ de lta bu'i dam pa'i chos de gang las byung na/ sangs rgyas las byung bas/ de'i phyi rol du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'bri ba'i rgyu mtshan nam dgos pa yang de yin gsung*/ de la kha cig na re/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pas spong ba bdun 'khor dang bcas pa ma gtogs pa/ yid kyi gsum po spong bar mi 'dod do zer yang*/ 'dir ni de mi spong na nyon mongs pa mi spong ba dang*/ sum brgya pa dang*/ mdo rtsa nyid nas 'du shes gtso zhes pa dang*/ shes gtso zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa ma yin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pas wa ra ṇa sīr bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de/ rab tu byung ba 'ba' zhig la bskor ram/ khams gsum gyi sems can la yang bskor/ rab tu byung ba 'ba' zhig la yin na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas dge slong dang*/ dge tshul rnams kyi steng du bcas pa'i gong tsha nyes pa thams cad bzhag par 'gyur ba'i skyon yong bas/ mdor na nyon mongs pa las las/ las la las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pas khams gsum gyi 'khor ba 'byung bar byed pa gang yin pa de/ khams gsum gyi sems can gang yin pa de rnams la mi 'byung bar 'ong te/ de ni ma yin zhing*/ de bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can thams cad kyi 'dren par byon pa yin pas/ dge slong la bcas pa de ni sems can thams cad la bcas pa yin/

de ltar na bkag pa thams cad ye bkag gnang ba thams cad ye gnang du 'ong ba yin/ 'o skol ni ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa gong ma rnams kyi rjes su 'brang bar byed dgos pas/ de yang mdor na rang bzhin gang na yod pa'i bden pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa rnam pa gnyis ni bsgrub pa'i bslab pa yin te/ khyed rnams kyis de ltar shes par mdzad nas/ chos 'di gzhan la yang ston/ sgrogs kyang sgrogs shig gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad zhing dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ dngos po rnam pa gsum gyi rten 'brel yin la/ 'di go na nga'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang go bar 'gyur bas/ gsum po 'di'i rten 'brel 'dzoms pa la mthong chos su 'byung te/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gang yin yang rung thams cad 'dzom pa dang*/ gang ma 'dzoms pa'i bye brag la skyes nas myong 'gyur dang*/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur du gong ma rnams kyis gsungs/ de yang 'dir phyogs gcig mtshon na/ dper na yul rang la gnod pa byas pa'i pha gsad pa'i lag dmar po lta bu de zhing phan 'dogs pa'i pha dang ma lta bu de'i bar chad bsam pa zhe sdang gis gsod par 'dod pa de bsam pa/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems de'i bar chad/ mtshon rnon po'am dug la sogs pa de dngos po/ so med pa dang*/ yu ba chag pa dang*/ sman la sogs pa'i bar chad de rnams dang bral na bsam pa 'dod pa de'i 'bras bu 'grub/ yang zhing mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ bsam pa dge slong tshul gyi sdom pa thob par 'dod pa/ dngos po lus ngag yid gsum gyi las rnam par dag pa dang gsum 'dzom na/ gang 'dod pa'i don de 'grub pa yin/ de las 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu gsungs pa las sngon brgyan po pa rgyal ba zhes bya bas/

sa phyogs gcig na chos smra ba gcig bsod nams bsags pas bde ba thob// de phyir mi yis bsod nams bya// de 'ang yang dang yang du bya// de ring nyid du bstun te bya// zhes smra ba thos nas dad pa drag po skyes pas/ rang gi gdugs dang*/ bla gos dang*/ mchil lham phud nas chos smra ba de la phul/ 'gron bu gter te khyim du 'ongs pa na/ chung mas khron pa'i nang du spyang 'dzul btang nas chu bcus pas/ de la gser zung bzhi 'khril nas byung bas gza' mi thams cad kyis drangs pa las/ de khron pa'i steng du thon pa dang*/ brgyan po pa rgyal ba ngo mtshar skyes nas/ kye ma yon tan kun gyi rang bzhin zhing*// nyes kun rnam par spangs pa la/ de ring nyid du sa bon btab// de ring nyid du 'bras bu smin// zhes smras zhing bstod pa byas te/ de yang zhing dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ dngos po rnam pa gsum 'dzom pa'i mthong chos tshe de la byung ba yin/ 'o na de nyid gcig pu'am snyam na/ skye ba de'i phyi ma la rgyal po bsod nams stobs zhes bya bar gyur nas/ lha'i bla re dang gdugs nam mkha' las byung ba dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khri dang*/ rin po che'i char bab pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra grags pa la sogs pa byung ba de rnams ni lan grangs dang*/ gzhan la myong ba dang*/ skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi rnams yin te/ brgyan po pa rgyal bas tshogs bsags pa de'i 'bras bu sangs ma rgyas bar du 'byung ba yin/ de ltar gyur pa'i dus su/ zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum ga 'dzom na mthong chos/ gnyis 'dzom na skyes nas myong 'gyur/ gcig las ma 'dzom na lan grangs gzhan la myong ba yin zhes/ mkhas pa rnams kyi smra na yang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyi 'di yang phyogs gcig tu 'ong te/ re re la yang gsum ga 'dzom pa 'byung ba yin/ 'di lta bu 'byung ba'i don rtogs pa'i dus su/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la go ba rnyed pas/

rten 'brel thams cad sgrigs pas chog te/ nga 'bu sngon phag mo gru na yod pa'i dus su/ sgom pa chos ye na re/ bzhed pa ni mang po gcig bzhed par 'dug te zer nas/ de nas kho la da 'o na ngas sang nyin nas 'tsho ba 'dra 'ong ba'i rten 'brel bya'am byas pas/ mdzad par zhu zer/ 'o na khyed rang ci 'dod pa'i dngos po cung zad re re khyer la shog byas pas/ ja dang phye dang*/ mar la sogs pa rnyed tshad khyer nas byung ba dang*/ rten 'brel gyi khug mar dngos po de rnams phul bas/ phyi nyin nas cha le chi le 'bul ba byung bas chos ye na re/ 'di 'dra ba ci mdzad mdzad 'dug pas/ da sdug sris byed mi nus zer nas phad phod byas pa yin te/ de rten 'brel sgrigs pa yin/ yang rten 'brel yin byas pa'i dus su mgo skor ba'i rten 'brel ser ser byi'u ldad dang*/ pag bu gro ser dang*/ lung btang 'dre mig dang*/ mda' bya rgod ma la sogs pa la zer ba min/ phag gcig na zab zab mo'i gdams ngag gzhan yang yod pa ma lags/ da ltar gyi zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gyi sgo nas tshogs gsog pa 'di nyid la rten 'brel zer ba yin/ 'di dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ rten 'brel ma lus pa'i snying po/ shin tu zab pa'i chos yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sngags mtshan nyid thams cad kyi lam bgrod pa'i shul de/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yin/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun de'i gzhir gyur pa dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi yin te/ dang po bzhi po 'di dang ldan na gong ma rnams gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gyur te/ 'og ma stobs su 'gyur ba la zer bas/ de yang 'og ma spangs pas gong ma thob pa ma yin/ de bas na dang po dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi po 'di shin tu zab pa yin/ de yang 'di ltar du mchi bas/

dang po lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa 'di yang*/ lus 'di mi gtsang ba'i rdzas kyis gang ba dang*/ de dur khrod kyi ro ltar mi rtag par lta ba la zer/ de nyid kyang lus la mi gtsang bar mthong bas/ lus de nyid kyi snying po phyi ma la don rgya chen po bsgrub pa/ bla ma'i zhabs tog bsgrub pa ltar lus la snying po len/ lus de mi rtag par mthong bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rtag pa 'tshol te/ de'i rgyu bsgrub pa zhig dgos/ de lta bu'i rgyu bsgrub pa zhig ma byung na mi rtag pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes bsgoms pa la yang dgos pa med/ de ltar bltas pa'i dus su lus kyi thog ma dang tha ma med par mthong bas/ chos kyi sku thob pa yin/ yang gnyis pa tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa de yang*/ tshor ba bde sdug btang snyom gsum mi rtag pa dang*/ de la chags sdang skyes na sdug bsngal 'byung bar lta ba la zer/ de la mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal du go bas nyon mongs pa spong ba dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis dbyen spyos pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po skye dgos/ nyon mongs pa phra rags rnams mi spong zhing snying rje mi skye bar/ don gyi go ba tsam gyis sa mi chod/ de ltar mthong nas tshor ba de ma skyes par rtogs pas/ lus dang sems dben pa 'thob pa yin/ gsum pa sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa de yang*/ dmigs yul tha dad pa las sems tha dad pa skye la/ dmigs pa med na sems skye ba med pa shes pa la zer/ de yang sems la sems kyis bltas pas/ sems dang dmigs pa dbyer med par gau nas/ de nyid spros pa dang bral bar shes shing*/ sems bzhin du 'khor 'das thams cad go bas mnyam pa nyid kyi don mthong ba yin/ de'i dus su 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras ni ma dag pa'i rgyu 'bras yin la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog cing*/ bsod nams ma yin pa spong te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du lam dbu ma la 'jug pas/

thub pa'i dgongs pa 'di shin tu zab bo// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu yin gsung te/ de yang phyi rol nam mkha' ma yin te// sems kyi nam mkha'i dbus gnas pa// gsung bas/ bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gdod nas skye ba med pa yin/ gdod nas skye ba med pa de la/ gdod nas sangs rgyas pa yang zer bas/ de ltar yang*/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas te// 'on kyang blo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ de bas na rang gi sems nyid de gdod nas skye 'gag yod med/ rtag chad/ 'gro 'ong la sogs pa spros pa'i mthar ma lhung ba de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis kar mi rtog pa// 'di de shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba de bzhin du/ bdag gzhan gyi chos thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de ltar yang*/ bdag ci 'dra ba de 'drar sems can thams cad shes// sems can thams cad ci 'dra de 'drar chos kun shes// zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bu rtogs pa de mnyam pa nyid yin te/ de ltar yang*/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do// zhes gsungs pa yin/ 'o na mnyam pa nyid gcig pu yin nam snyam na/ de la ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba yin la/ de'i mnyam pa nyid ni gong du bstan pa de yin/ rnam par spros pa ni rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel la zer bas/ rje dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dpag tu med pa yod kyang*/

da lta'i rtogs pa 'di 'dra bas chog pa min gsung*/ de'i dgongs pa gang yin snyam na/ dper bgyi na/ mda' gcig bsnun pa la gos phigs pa tsam dang sha la phigs pa'am/ khong pa'i nang du sleb tsam byung yang*/ gnad du phog pa min/ snying la phog pa lta bu zhig yod/ de la 'o na khyed kyi khyad par gyi chos de gang yin na/ ri rab sna tshogs pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs pa nyid do zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu 'di lta bu las 'bras bu 'di lta bu 'byung bya ba yin te/ 'dir rgyu byang chub kyi sems mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa las thob/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya snyam pa'i sems des/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i don la gnas kyang*/ gnas skabs su brag skyibs su char babs pa dang 'dra te/ dus gtan du der sdod pa'i gnas med/ byang chub kyi sems de'i 'bras bus/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ji srid pa de srid kyis sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang*/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang*/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'gro ba'i don byed pa 'byung te/ de yang dpe ji lta bu yin snyam na/ rje sgam po pa chen po sngon sangs rgyas pa yin yang*/ da ltar snyigs dus 'dir yang 'gro ba'i don la byon pa yin te/ de ltar yang zhal snga nas/ sngon gyi dus su me tog zla mdzes la// thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nur gyur// lnga brgya'i dus na skyes bu chen po nyid// ces gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pas rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang mi 'gal ba yin no// mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa'i steng du rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel rnam par spros pa go ba 'di nga'i khyad par gyi chos/ rje dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo phyi mar gsungs pa yin gsung nas/

rgya cher nan tan du gdams pas/ sangs rgyas gnyan sgom gyis tshogs su bkrabs pa'i chos zab mo'i rje tho lags so// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che 'bri gung pa de'i zhal snga nas/ spyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che bsgrub pa la sdom pa gsum ldan zhig dgos/ de la sdom pa gsum po 'di dkon mchog gsum re re gtso bor gyur pa yin pas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba so thar gyi sdom pa la/ zhing dge 'dun gtso bor gsungs pas/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs las sdom pa len pa dang*/ dge 'dun kho na la brten pa dang*/ nyes ltung byung yang dge 'dun nyi shu'i tshogs dang*/ re re'i bar la bshags pa yin te/ de yang bsam pa snga ma la 'gyod pa skyes pa/ phyi ma srog la bab kyang mi byed pa/ dngos po ltung ba ming rigs gang yin pa brjod nas bshags pa yin pas/ nyon mongs pa che 'bring gis ltung ba sde lngar gsungs pa la/ 'dul 'dzin dag spong bdun du 'dod pas/ yid kyi gsum po la nyes pa med par smra na yang*/ 'dir ni rgyud pa rin po che'i dgongs pa dang*/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i bzhed pas nyes pa shin tu yod pas/ nyes pa thams cad bshags sdom bya ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gsungs pa bzhin du bya'o// yang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la zhing chos gtso bor gyur te/ de ltar yang snying rtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes pa med// ces gsungs pas/ ded dpon snying rje chen po'i snying rjes mi nag mdung thung can bsad pas/ bskal pa 'bum gyi 'khor ba phyir bsnyil ba dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u skar mas lo nyi khri'i bar du tshangs par spyad pa la/ grong du bsod snyoms la phyin pas/ bud med cig bram ze'i khye'u la chags pas zin nas/ bud med de lam du 'gyel ba la ma bltas par/ sgom pa bdun bor ba'i rjes la snying rje chen po skyes nas phyir log te/

lo bcu gnyis su bud med de'i khyim thab byas nas/ yang tshangs par spyod pa spyad pas/ bskal pa nyi khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar gsungs pas na/ byams snying rje dang ma bral na ltung ba'i nyes pas mi gos par gsungs pa yin yang*/ 'di la nyes pa gtan nas med pas ma gos pa yin nam ma yin zhes brtag pa bya ste/ spyir yang sdig pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung bar ma nus pas/ mi nag mdung thung can bsad pa'i 'bras bus lo brgya phrag mang po dang*/ lo stong phrag mang po dang*/ lo brgya stong phrag mang por sems can dmyal ba chen po rnams su btsos zhes bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis zhal snga nas gsungs pa dang*/ snying brtse ba dang*/ byams pa dang sems dge ba la nyes pa med pa ni/ byams snying rje gzhir byas nas/ ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ */des bskyed las ni dge ba yin/ */zhes gsungs pas/ bsam pa de lta bu'i las dang bya ba de la nyes pa yod par ma go bas/ nyes pa dang ltung ba cung zad byung yang*/ 'dul ba gtan la phab pa nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo ltar/ thun tshod las ma 'das par byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral bar bya ba dang*/ byams pa snying rje gzhi bzhag tu byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba bshags pa bzhin du bya/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa la/ zhing sangs rgyas gtso bor gsungs te/ de yang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis dbang bskur nas/ lus lhar nges shing*/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje yin pa la/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum du 'khrul na slad pa yin te/ phung po sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid// de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ log par 'khrul na slad pa'i nyes pa chen po 'ong bas/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ yon tan skye khar bla ma ci mthong ba yang 'ong gsung*/ de la ji ltar bgyi na/ sgom pas chog pa yin gsung ba dang 'dra bar/ mthon dman gyi rtog pa ci skyes kyang de nyid bdag gir byas la lam du btang zhing*/

sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom/ de la ma yengs par byas pas/ skyon thams cad yon tan du 'gyur/ bar du gcod pa thams cad dngos grub du 'ong bas/ nyes pa dang ltung ba ci byung ba thams cad sbyang ba yang*/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i sbyor bas 'dag pa yin gsung*// //yang chos kyi rje 'gro ba'i mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ spyir 'brel pa bya ba dam bcas pa de skyong bar byed pa yin te/ 'jig rten pa kun kha sdom btang ba de'i thog tu mi 'jog pa ni mi ngan pa yin zer/ de bzhin du 'dir yang*/ dam bcas pa mgo mi thon pa ni mi mkhas pa yin pas/ dam bcas pa'i tshig de dang 'brel dgos/ de la 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po snying rje yin gsung te/ de ni nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ phyi rol mu stegs byed dang yang thun mong du gyur pa lags so// de la gtam rgyud gcig gsung*/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na rgyal po rdul phran zhes bya ba'i mdun na 'don bram ze gnag lhas skyes zhes bya ba/ mkhas pa kun gyis bkur ba/ bram ze rnams kyis tshangs pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod do zhes smras pas/ 'o na khyed rang srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i mi dge ba 'di dag spongs la/ snying rje sgoms shig zer ro// bram zes bsam pas/ bdag khyim na gnas pas ni de dag mi nus kyis// da rab tu byung dgos snyam nas/ de rab tu byung ba dang*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po gzugs can snying po lags par gda' ste/ sngon gyi 'brel pa des 'dir yang rgyal po gzugs can snying po la brten nas/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad pa de rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu zhes bya ste/ rgyu dang 'dra ba de'i 'bras bu yin te 'brel pa/ de gcig pur yang ma zad/ 'jig rten mgon pos spyir dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba/ dug gsum med pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por bzhed la/

dge ba de dag thams cad sdud par byed pa'i sdud shing ni byang chub kyi sems/ de yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gyi don du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol bgyi ba/ dge ba de yang ji lta bu yin snyam na/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas bsdus pa yin/ 'dod chags de yang phyi yul dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa dang*/ de bzhin du zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug la 'dod chags dang bral ba zhig dgos/ 'dir 'jig rten gyi bya ba tshong byed pa gcig pu la yang*/ chags pa med pas don 'grub/ chags pas nyes pa bskyed par byed de/ de yang sngon gyi gtam rgyud las/ mu ge chen po zhig byung ba'i dus su/ gser gyi lug mgo dang rkyang sha lag pa tshong byas pas/ gser la chags pa'i mi de shi zhing*/ rkyang sha zos pa'i mi de chags pa med pas gson pa dang 'dra te/ de bzhin du rang gzhan gang la yang zhe sdang ba med pa'i sems dang ldan na/ zhe sdang gi las mi dge mi 'byung te/ de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa mi 'byung ba'o// gti mug med pa ni ston pas kyang gti mug gi gnyen por rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsungs te/ de yang phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ dngos po gang yang rung ba 'di thams cad 'byung ba bzhir go 'byed pa nam mkha' dang lngar ma 'dus pa med de/ sra ba dang gsher ba dang*/ dro ba dang*/ g.yo bar byed pas phyi snod dang nang bcud thams cad 'grub par byed de/ tha na rdul phra rab yan chad skyed par byed pa yin/ nang rten 'brel ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung bya ba lags te/ de la yang ma rig pa ni mi shes pa gti mug gi mun pa yin la/ de shes shing rtogs pa ni ye shes sam/ sangs rgyas yin pas na/ de ma rtogs pa ni sems/ sems de nyid ma rtogs pa las khams gsum gyi 'khor ba 'byung te/ de ltar yang*/

sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa// sgro btags rnam pa can rtog yin// gsungs pas/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang*/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang*/ 'khor 'das thams cad sems su 'du zhing*/ sems dbu ma la 'jug par gsung pa dang*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ rtsa ba gcig la sdong po gnyis// rgyu mtshan de las 'bras bu gcig /ces gsungs pas/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis thams cad kyang sems yin/ sems de ni yod med spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/ rkos phor la ri mo med na/ tsha tsha la ri mo mi 'byung gsung bas/ thag gcad pa lags so// 'o na 'bri rdzi'i bus 'phags pa kun dga' bo la chos bstan pas/ dgra bcom pa thob pa yin no zer yang*/ de ltar smra ba rnams ni ston pa'i gsung ma thos shing ma go ba yin/ de la 'phags pa kun dga' bo des/ ston pa'i zhabs drung rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa la/ de'i rgyun cung zad bskul ba ma gtogs pa 'bri rdzi'i bus chos bstan pas dgra bcom pa thob pa min te/ go'u ta ma khyod ni bag med ma mdzad par// shing drung dben pa bsten la sgrub pa byas// ring por mi thogs zhi ba'i gnas thob 'gyur// zhes bskul ba las/ de la yang*/ spyir mang du thos pa la phan yon rnam pa lnga yod gsung*/ de nyid kyang gang zhe na/ phung po la mkhas pa dang*/ khams la mkhas pa dang*/ skye mched la mkhas pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang*/ mang du thos pas gdams ngag gzhan la rag ma las pa yin pas// de ltar ston pa'i man ngag bsgoms pas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa yin gsung*/ gzhan yang da ltar bla ma dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la gsol ba btab pas/ yon tan rgyud la skye ba 'ong te/ tho yor du skyes pa'i rin seng dang*// gung thang gi mi la ras pa gnyis// chos nyid kyi dbyings su yal gyis yal// bya ba dang*/

nā ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag de// nga rnal 'byor ras pa'i sems la shar/ bya ba dang*/ sing ga gling gi rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig mas rgyang ring po nas gsol ba btab pas 'bras bu thob pa lta bu yin pas/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gal che/ bla ma 'ga' zhig la mos gus byas pas yon tan ma skyes pa'i pha rol tu nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang*/ nyes pa thams cad gyi grib 'ong bas/ de dag thams cad ni spang bya yin no// bla ma dam pa rtogs pa dang ldan/ zhing byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba zhig la mos gus byas par song na ni/ de'i byin rlabs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po sad par byas te/ de la rgyun srings pas sangs rgyas pa rje bram ze chen po dang*/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa lta bu yin te/ 'bring du song yang 'chi kha'i dus su sangs rgya la/ tha ma yang bar do dang por 'od gsal chos sku ngo 'phrod nas sangs rgya ba yin/ 'o na chos kyi sku bya ba ni de yin na/ gzugs kyi sku de ci tsug 'byung*/ gzugs sku rtog pa las 'byung ngam/ chos sku las 'byung*/ chos sku las 'byung na ni de las 'gro ba'i bde skyid thams cad 'byung te/ de ltar yang*/ 'phags pa dkon mchog rtsegs pa nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyis rlabs kyis sa nas sar 'phar ba dang*/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ phyi rol pa kun kyang rdzu 'phrul dang*/ brtul zhugs 'grub pa la sogs pa 'byung ba yin la/ de ma yin pa gzhan yang sems can kun gyi bde skyid ji snyed pa kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis rlabs su gsungs pa yin pas/ de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag pa ni phyag rgya chen po yin te/ mtha' thams cad dang bral ba des chos thams cad 'dzin nus pas/ gtad drags na yang mi zin/

ma gtad na yang mi zin te/ des na thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag de la khar sang gi chos de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po snying rje yin bgyi ba de nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu rab lus 'di nyid kyis lha'i gnas su 'gro/ 'bring 'chi kha'i dus kyi tshe dang*/ tha ma yang bar dor cis kyang lhar 'gro ba dang 'dra bar/ zhes gang gis kyang 'bras bu rnam pa gsum rim gyis 'byung bas/ 'dir byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi rjes su 'brang bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis snying rje med na sangs mi rgya bar gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang*/ stong nyid ston pa'i bstan bcos dbu ma la 'jug pa'i klad du snying rje la bstod pa dang*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal nas kyang*/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*// des ni lam mchog rnyed par mi 'gyur te// 'on te snying rje zhes pa dang*/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gsung gis kyang*/ snying rje ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por bzhed pa dang*/ chos kyi rje nyid kyi thugs nyams su myong bas kyang*/ snying rje chen pos mdze nad sos par gyur pas/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bar bya gsung*/ de la yang 'dir sems dang*/ sems las byung ba bgyi ba lags te/ sems de ni byang chub kyi sems lags/ de las byung ba'i lus ngag yid gsum bkol ba yin pas/ de la yang zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'bras bu mngon sum 'byung la/ 'dir zhing dkon mchog gsum las/ sangs rgyas yin te/ de yang sku gsum dang ldan pa'o// chos kyi sku dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de'i yon tan/ sprul pa'i sku de'i byed pa'i las yin la/ phrin las des 'gro ba bde la 'god de/ de la yang lam dang lam gyi rten la 'god pa gnyis yin/ rten la 'god pa ni thabs la mkhas pas 'brel pa 'jog pa yin te/

de yang da lta nga'i drung du zan gcig gi ched du byang chub kyi sems kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rab du byung*/ de nas lhan pa dang nas khyer nas rang gi yul du phyin nas babs pas dmyal bar 'gro te/ dmyal ba'i gnas su chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes/ kho la khyod kyis sngon mir gyur pa na/ rab tu byung ba rnyed nas babs pa dang*/ nas dang lhan pa khyer ba la sogs pa smras pa dang*/ de nas kho ngo tsha zhing 'gyod par gyur nas/ sdug bsngal/ de la brten nas bla ma dran/ bla ma des nga la mdzad rgyu 'di las med/ nga bla ma de'i drung du tshul khrims bsrung zhing chos mi byed pa snyam nas mos gus skyes pas/ gong gi chad dang 'brel des nga 'bu sems can dmyal ba'i gnas su yer gyis 'ong te/ ngas sems can de la chos bstan pas/ de gnas de nas tshe 'phos nas/ nga 'bu gar 'dug pa'i lha'am/ mi'i gnas la sogs par skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ ston pa'i gsung rabs su yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas nas yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa na/ 'od zer bkyes pas ngan 'gro'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas nas/ 'od de gang gis mthong ba dang*/ gang la reg pa thams cad ngan 'gro'i gnas de nas tshe 'phos nas/ lha dang mi'i gnas su skye bar byas pa de lta bu ni lam gyi rten la 'god pa yin/ lam la 'god pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po des 'od zer de lta bu bkyes nas/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs shing*/ bltams pa nas sangs rgyas pa'i bar du gyur te/ lha dang mi rnams la chos bstan pas/ sa brgyad la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' man chad kyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la bskyed pa de sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin/ chos dkon mchog ni 'dir byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis yin/ 'di la skyabs su song bas gnas skabs kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi nas sangs rgya ste/ nga 'di la skyabs su song bas nad kyis ma thub/

de bas na bla ma shes dgos la/ slob ma yang shes dgos pa yin/ dge 'dun dkon mchog ni/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis 'dres par nyams su len pa la zer bas na/ de rnams ni zhing yin/ bsam pa ni byang chub kyi sems/ dngos po ni sems las byung ba'i lus ngag gi las yin te/ khyed kyis spang shing khur gcig blangs pa de dkon mchog gsum dang mnyam mi mnyam brtag pa mdzod/ de bzhin du rang gi bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ dge 'dun rnams dang mnyam par 'gro bas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa la 'bad par bya gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ de la 'dir 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i chos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po snying rje yin bgyi ba 'di gcol re chung*/ gcig la nor re che gcig byung te/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis rang la yod pa ngo sprod pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med de/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas mdo sde gtan la phab par/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun du gsungs nas 'dug te/ de snga phan chad gsungs pa yin/ de la byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun du gsungs pa de sems can rnams kyi 'dug lugs yin/ de shes shing nyams su blangs pas/ de'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa'i gnad 'di go dgos/ de ltar du gyur tsam na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po phyogs gcig tu byams pa snying rje yin/ de rgyas par phye na dge ba mtha' dag la zer bas/ 'di lta bu'i don ston par byed pas ston pa/ de lta bu mngon sum du shes shing rtogs pas thams cad mkhyen pa/ de gang gi rgyud la yod pa sad par byed pas na/ sad par mdzad pa'i mgon po zhes zer ba yin gsung*/ de la mkhas pa kha gcig ni don spyi bsgoms pas don rang gi mtshan nyid mngon du 'gyur bar 'dod de/

de 'dra ni rje dpal ldan phag mo gru pas mi bzhed pas/ de ltar yang zhal snga nas/ bsgoms pa'i shugs las sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan rgya mtsho 'ong zer nas// sol ba brdar bar gyur pa la// dung mdog dkar po 'dod pa ni// phyogs chos khyab pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// ri bong ra yi gnyer ma dag /bskal pa du mar bgrang ba yin// zhes gsungs pas/ bsgoms pa las yon tan skye bar mi bzhed do// yang 'ga' zhig na re/ phyag rgya chen po skye ba dka' zhes zer te/ ngo sprod ma shes pa yin/ bla ma la yang rtogs pa med pa dang*/ rgyus chung bas lan pa yin/ zhi gnas la lhag mthong gis ngo sprod/ lhag mthong la zhi gnas kyis ngo sprod byas na/ de ni tsha reg la grang reg gis ngos sprod byas pa dang*/ grang reg la tsha reg gis ngo sprod byas pa lta bu yin la/ ngo sprod shes na ni rang sems kyi de kho na nyid ji lta ba bzhin du yod pa de ngo sprad pas/ sngar 'dres kyi mi dang 'phrad pa bzhin// rang sems rang ngo rang gis shes// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar na sgom rang la yod pa la dka' rgyu ci yod/ zan za ba bas kyang phyag rgya chen po sla ba yin gsung*// //yang rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ de ring nga 'bus khyed la bla ma rin po che'i gsung tshig gcig snyan du gsol bas/ de la rje dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de'i zhal snga nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' thams cad dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas 'bring rnam pa gsum/ sde tshan drug la sogs pa thams cad kho bos byang bu logs gcig tu 'dus par gzigs te/ de yang bsgoms pa las byung pa yin gsung*/ de yang gang yin na/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad 'di ltar sems ni sems ma mchis pa ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes gsungs pa'i gsung 'dir 'dus pa yin/ de la sems med pa gang zhe na/ gang 'dod chags dang mi ldan ma bral/

gang zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug dang yang mi ldan ma bral ba yin te/ de ni 'gyur ba med cing rnam par rtog pa med pa'o// de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du 'gyur ba med cing rnam par rtog pa med pa'o// zhes gsungs pa de ni chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de/ de la sems med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o zhes gsungs pa lags/ de la shes rab snying po lta bu phyogs gcig gi dbang du byas na/ chos pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad 'dus pa'i snying po'i tshig de lta bu cha gcig chos de ston pa'i ston pa/ spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs par ston pa de cha gcig bya rgod phung po'i ri la sogs pa'i gnas de cha gcig dge slong gi dge 'dun dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun 'di snyed gcig ces bya bar ston pa de cha gcig dus de rnams tshogs pa'i dus dang rnam pa lnga yin te/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngar 'du ba yin gsung*/ de la de gcig pur ma zad/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ston pa dang*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba rnams kyis chos rnams kyi sgo tha dad pa mi 'dra ba mang po ston par 'gyur bas/ mdor na de rnams kyang phun sum tshogs pa lngas bsdus pa yin te/ 'dir rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mtshon na/ chos snying rje chen po/ snying rje de ston par byed pa'i tshul yang ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'khor snying rje chen po de nyid dang ldan par skyes pa thams cad/ gnas ni ri gru 'dzin nam/ ri bo ta la ste/ snying rje des dbang du byas shing de las grub pa'i gnas/ dus ni de rnams tshogs pa'i dus yin te ri bo ta la 'am/ 'og min yang logs na med pas/ snying rje chen po skye ba gal che/ snying rje de la yang snying rje dang gcig snying rje chen po dang gnyis/ nye bar zhi ba'i snying rje dang gsum yin/

de yang tshad med pa'i snying rje yin te/ 'dir dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje de ston par byed pa'i dus su/ zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum gyi rten 'brel las byung ba/ me tog gcig gis kyang de'i chos ston nus pa'i phrin las 'byung te/ dus de ni snying rje chen po'i dus zhes bya/ de yang tshur nye bar bcar nas gtan la 'bebs na/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po me tog zla mdzes bzhin du/ ri khrod pa rnams kyis kyang*/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga bsgrubs na/ skyon 'dag cing yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur te/ kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod lta bu'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' gzungs thob pa lta bu'i 'khor/ byang chub sems dpa' me tog zla mdzes lta bu'i ston pa rang nyid/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po lta bu'i chos/ de rnams 'dzom pa'i dus dang rnam pa lngar bsgrub shes na/ ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub dka' ba med de/ bcu chos dang sum chos kyang mi zab/ chos 'di kho na zab pas thugs la zhog gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ de ring ni rlabs po che'i tshig ya zung zhig snyan du gsol bas/ 'di thugs la bzhag nas rang nyid kyang nyams su blang*/ grogs mched snying nye ba rnams la yang shubs te bzla/ gal te 'gro ba la phan pa bsgrub par 'dod na/ dang po khong rang la bsnyen pa gyis bya/ de la nga 'bus sgom gsal khams su btang nas/ khos bya byed rnams legs pa bsgrubs pas phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa la/ bsnyen pa dang bsgrub pa med pas kho rang shi bar gyur pa yin pas/ de la nyes pa sna tshogs pa 'byung*/ nye ba'i sa phyogs de dag tu rang gzhan la phan pa bsgrub par 'dod pas/ dang po byams pa bsgom/ des phan bde rgya chen po 'byung te/ de ci tsam byung ba tsam du grib dang nyes pa thams cad rang la dpungs kyis 'ong ba yin/ de mi 'ong ba'i thabs ni/ byams pa dang snying rje dang*/

yi dam gyi lha dang*/ gang yang rung te/ de la yang bsnyen sgrub gnyis dgos/ de la spyir gsang sngags kyi rgyud du jo bo thugs rje chen po lta bu gcig la yang*/ bsnyen pa byed pa'i thabs grangs dang*/ rtags dang mtshan mas bsnyen pa byed dgos te/ de la yang grangs gtso bor gyur pa yi ge grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho la sogs pa bya/ 'di la yang lha de ma gsal na sngags kyi grangs su mi gzhug par gsungs pas/ grangs de tshod tsam gyis brtan pa thob rgyu zhig yod par 'dug de ltar byas pas rtags dang mtshan ma mang po 'byung*/ de byung ba dang sgrub pa bya/ des phrin las thams cad 'grub pa la tshegs med/ phrin las phran tshegs kyi sgrub pa la grogs med pas mi bya/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i zas bsod snyoms la brten nas dgos par bslab pa gsum nyams su blangs pas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis spyan gyis gzigs nas/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster ba yin pas bsgrub pa bya gsung*// //yang chos kyi rje 'gro ba'i mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ nga 'bu sngon 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhabs drung na yod pa'i dus su/ zhal snga nas chos gsung ba thams cad kyang ngo sprod 'ba' zhig tu 'byon par 'dug pas/ 'o na de yang rang la yod pa'i 'di yin snyam pa'i nges pa'i shes pa byung nas/ pha 'di lta bu la bu nga rang 'dra ba dgos pa yin mod snyam pa byung ba la/ de ring grags 'byung na re/ khyed kyis tshogs su chos smras pa de dag thams cad la/ dge 'dun rnams la de rang du myong ba skye ba yin zer bas/ kho'i tshig de bden rung mi bden rung bden du gzhug go// de la spyir mos gus dang ldan pa'i slob mas bla ma'i gsung tshig re re la yang myong ba skye bar 'dug go// gnyis pa grogs dang gnas dang rdzas la sogs pa rnams la brten nas/ ting nge 'dzin 'byung ba la sogs pa mtha' med pa gsung ba yang 'dug te/

tshogs su gsungs pa yin yang phag tu zlos mi phod/ 'o na de gang yin na dngos po kho na'i che ba'i yon tan chab tsha 'thungs pas/ gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar nas ting nge 'dzin gsal bar gyur pa yin gsung te/ de'i rgyu mtshan phyis go ba byung la/ ri khrod du yang ting nge 'dzin de'i rgyun srings pas yon tan ma lus pa thams cad 'byung te de spyi bye brag tu byas na/ me nyag rin chen dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i chos la/ spyir rang nyid dam slob dpon nam grogs po'am/ gzhan yang rung te/ nye gnas sam slob ma zhabs tog byed par gyur pa yod la/ de la yang rang nyid kyis phan mi 'dogs par drung du bsdad na bsdad thes med/ gzhan du 'gro bar gyur na dug mda' gtong bar byed na bla ma mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa yin/ yang slob dpon nam grogs po'am/ chos dang mthun pa de dag la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bsnyen bkur byed du 'gro ba la yang*/ 'gro na 'gror mi ster na/ slob ma bskyang ma ran pa yin te mdor na rang nyid kyi bsam pa la dris la/ rang nyid kyis phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub par nus shing*/ gnod pa las skyob par gyur na bla ma yin/ slob ma la sogs pa gzhan du shor dogs pa'i bsam pa yod kyang phan bde bsgrubs/ gnod pa las bzlog na shor ba'i dogs med la/ gnod pa bskyal nas phan ma btags na ni/ khyed 'gro na ni dam nyams yin/ rgyud 'khrul yin/ khyod dang 'brel pa med byas kyang mi phan/ kho 'gro bar 'ong*/ de la de lta bu'i slob ma rang nyid kyis bskyang bar bya ba la/ nad dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa byung na/ bcos ni byed dgos/ bya ba'i tshul lugs ji ltar bya snyam na/ khyi dang sha ba 'thab/ rngon pa nyi ma lde bya ba dang 'dra/ 'dir byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang*/ rang gi dge sbyor byed du gzhug dmigs pa sgom pa 'di la bka' rgya yang nas yang du mdzad par gda' bas/ gnyis tsam min pa byed ma myong*/

de yang lan gcig sgom she'i pha de la mis mda' rgyab pas/ mde'u lus nas zug zer chen po byung ba la/ phyi nub zhe sdang cung zad gcig skyes pa dang en gcig legs/ phyis sman pas bltas pas mde'u 'dug pas phyung ba dang 'dra ba yin/ de bas na byed du mi tub pa yin/ de ltar yin pa la/ de mkhan slob rnams pa la mi byed kha med byung te/ de yang mkhan slob la 'bag par gda' bas/ dge bshes ston 'jam la slob dpon gyis gsung skad/ 'di la rje rin po che 'bag par gda' bas mi byed par zhu zhus pas/ cis kyang byin gyis brlob pa yin gsung*/ de'i rgyu mtshan yul pha rol la dmigs pa gtad pas/ sems gnyis med pa'i gnad kas/ yul de'i nad dang sdug bsngal lam/ nyes pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i mthu yod kyang*/ tshu rol gyi sob stong par lus pa der/ nad dang gnod pa dang mi ma yin pa rnams zhugs nas/ nam ting nge 'dzin de btang ba dang gnod pa mang po 'byung ba yin no// 'o na de mi 'byung bar ci tsug byed snyam na/ 'di yin gsungs pas/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam du bsgoms nas/ rang nyid ting nge 'dzin de las ma yengs par byed pa yin/ gtor ma dang sems bskyed la sogs pa sbyor ba'i chos byas nas/ dus su sbed du 'jug pa yin te/ na ning sngon nga 'bu yang khams ngan pa la de bzhin du byas pas khams bde bar byung*/ de la rang nyid khams ni ngan/ dmigs pa ma gtad na ni slob ma la mi phan/ cho ga khyad du bsad par yang 'gro/ gtad na ni grib 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin te/ lar ni slob ma'i bya ba zhig bsgrub ni dgos pas/ de la nyes pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ byung ba sel ba la tshegs med pa yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ltar chos bgyi ba 'di thams cad myong ba dang 'brel pa yin pas/ gnad re re go bas thams cad go bar 'gyur ba yin te/

sngon rdza mkhan gnyis kyis rdza byas pa dang*/ gcig shes rab che/ gcig brtson 'grus che bas dka' sla dpag tu med pa'i 'jam por byas pa dang*/ gnyis pa des hel ke chur bcug pa gcig gis dus gcig la 'jam po byung ba dang 'dra ba yin pas/ 'dir myong ba dang 'brel ba'i chos dum khrigs cung zad cig snyan du gsol/ de la spyir sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i yul la phyi nas sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ nang nas gcod pa gnyis yin/ de la phyi nas sgro 'dogs gcod pa la shing bu'am rde'u gcig la/ 'di kun rdzob yin nam don dam yin zer nas don dam pa'i byed pa dpag tu med pa de'i thog tu 'bab pas/ de lta bu la mtha' thug pa med par 'gyur te/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po la snag tsha byas/ rtsi shing dang nags tshal la smyu gur byas nas bris kyang zad par mi 'gyur te/ sems dga' ba'i dus su go ba khyad par can skye/ sdug bsngal ba'i dus su yang go ba khyad par can rnyed pa 'byung*/ gang yang yid la ma byas na yang de'i nyams su myong ba 'char ba yin te/ sngon gyi dus su zangs rir ma jo lab sgron bya ba zhig byung ba la/ khyo gcig yod pa ni shi/ phru gu ma sos pas/ brgyad stong pa'i klog cung zad byas kyin phru gu gsos ba la/ lan gcig gi dus su skyes pa cig snying du sdug pa'i rnam par rtog pa zhig skyes pas/ de nas de je 'phel je 'phel du song bas/ der sdug pa la tshugs pa med pa byung ba'i dus su kha nang du log nas bsam mno btang te/ 'di tsam du sdug pa 'di la bsams pas je sdug la 'gro bar 'dug da ni sdug par mi bsam dgos snyam nas rtog pa gcig skyur gnyis skyur/ je skyur je skyur btang te/ sdug pa yid la ma byas pas/ de nas blo je bde je bde la song te/ de'i rgyun goms par byas pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa de nyid kyi bdud kyi le'u nas/ yid la mi byed pa de nyid kyi bka' stsal rgya cher gsungs pa de'i don go bar byung nas/

de rang chos yin snyam par byung te/ der thul pa gog po gcig yod pa de nub mo phru gu la bkab cing*/ sgren mor bsgoms pas/ 'khrul zhig mar grags shing grub thob mar gyur pa lags te/ da lta gcod yum zhes par grags/ gcod pa thams cad kyi khungs de yin/ de ltar na myong ba dang 'brel ba zhig dgos pa lags so/ yang byang zla shod du mi zhig gis g.yag gu zhig khrid pas ma thub nas/ ya ra ya ra zhes byas shing brid de then kyang ma thub pas/ da ni mi thub par 'dug dgos pa ci yod snyam te/ g.yag de btang nas/ de rang du bsgoms pas/ de la grub thob g.yag sgom bya ba byung ba dang*/ mdo smad du ka sgom bya bas/ yi ge ka bsgoms pas de grub thob du gyur/ rgan mo mkha' lding bya ba yungs dkar la dmigs pa gtod du 'jug pas ting nge 'dzin skyes/ de grub thob du song ba la sogs pa'i gdams ngag dpag tu med pa yod/ de dag kyang yid la byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin/ yid la mi byed pa de phyag rgya chen po yin te/ de ltar yang*/ slob dpon chen po bram ze'i zhal nas kyang*/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i sku/ 'bras bu gang la'ang re ba ma byed rnal 'byor pa// zhes gsungs pas/ phyag rgya chen po do ha la sogs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa mthar thug de yin pas na/ mdor bsdus na sems yid la mi byed pa de rtogs pas/ sgro 'dogs thams cad chod par 'gyur ba yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ltar ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems des khyad par du byas pa'i spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar dang ma shi'i tshe dang*/ dus de ring nas bzung ste/ nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam pa'i sems dam bcas pa des/

dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ni rgya cher 'phel/ nag po mi dge ba'i phyogs thams cad ni 'dzad/ lung ma bstan thams cad dge bar 'gyur ba yin gsung*/ de la yang khyed kyis bshad pa'i dge ba dang mi dge ba de dag go bar zad pa la/ lung du ma bstan pa gang yin/ de dge bar ji ltar 'gyur snyam par song na/ 'di la brtag pa gnyis byas pas lhur byung du go nas 'ong bas/ de la 'dir nyon mongs pa dug rnam pa gsum de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi las la mi dge ba zer ba ma lags sam/ de zer ba yin no// nges so// sems dug gsum med pa de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la dge ba zer ba ma lags sam/ de yang yin no// nges so// de la dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rtog pa gang yang ma skyes pa'i lus ngag yid gsum po 'di la lung du ma bstan pa zhes zer ba yin/ kun gzhi zhes kyang zer te/ de ltar mi 'dug gam/ de lta bu'i lus ngag yid gsum po de byang chub kyi sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ lung du ma bstan pa dge bar 'gyur ba thabs la mkhas pa'i man ngag chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i thugs dgongs mchog tu gyur pa/ ngo mtshar la rmad du byung pa'i chos gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// //yang gnyis pa lung du ma bstan pa'i lus ngag yid gsum po de/ chos kyi sku gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes par rtogs pa'i dus su/ de dge bar 'dug gam mi 'dug de dge bar 'dug ste/ de yang gti mug med pa'i dge ba rtsa ba yin la/ gti mug med pa de yang gang la zer na/ dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa'i shes pa de la zer/ de ltar mi shes pa de ni gti mug chen po yin te/ de la ma rig pa zer/ lung ma bstan yang gti mug gis rab du phye ba yin la/ de la yang gnyis yin pas/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i dus su las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i don ci yod/

de ma rtogs pa bdag dang bdag gi bar 'dzin pa des lan te/ 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ thog med dus nas bdag lta ci la 'khrul// mig ser ldan pa'i skra shad de dag gis// skye med ngang pa'i tshogs rnams bzung gyur na// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i snyi rnams gcod pa la// sems nyid rtogs pa'i chu gri ma mchis par// blos byas stong pas snyi la then gyur kyang*// chad par mi 'gyur slar yang dam par 'ching*// zhes gsungs pas/ sems nyid 'di rtogs dgos/ blos byas pa'i stong pas mi phan/ nyams sgoms pas kyang mi grol/ brtson 'grus byas pas kyang mi phan te/ ngas kyang ji snyed gcig re sgoms na/ mi sngon gyi jo mo/ res 'dag car byas/ res smra bcad byas tho les thob cig de ltar sems mngon par rtogs pa 'di med na/ gti mug gam/ ma rig pa bya ba de gzhi bzhag tu byas pas/ rkyen tshogs pa la brten nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba yin te/ da res 'dir ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gcig lung khungs su drang bas/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa// de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs// rkyen rnams tshogs nas sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung*// ma rig 'khrul 'khor de ni zad med 'phel ba med// ces gsungs pas/ mi shes pa'i gti mug pa nga dang bdag bya ba dang*/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa de'i las kyis khams gsum du rgya ri ri 'khor te/ lta log sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa thams cad bdag bya ba der 'dus/ nga dang bdag bya ba de yod na/ de'i khyad par gyi chos bdag rtag pa/ bde ba/ dben pa/ mtha' yod pa/ med pa/ yod kyang med pa/ yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad 'byung la/ rtsa ba bdag de med par rtogs pa'i dus su khyad par gyi chos mi 'byung bas/

bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab de las 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung ba yin/ de ltar yang*/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ci snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// rkyen rnams tshogs nas ye shes 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung*// shes rab pha rol phyin la zad med 'phel ba med// ces gsungs pas/ mngon par rtogs pa de las ye shes dang*/ yon tan dang phrin las thams cad 'byung te/ de ring gi chos 'di dpe med par zab pa lags pas thugs la bzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che 'bri gung pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dir khrid kyis ci bsgom dris pas/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom zer/ phyag rgya chen po gang yin byas pas/ lnga ldan yin zer te de tsug mi bya bar/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems gang la yod pa des theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'grub la/ de gsum med na mi 'grub/ de dang 'dra bar gsum po go bar zad la/ chud mi za bar bsngo ba'i rgya dang bcas pa bzhi po ni thabs yin la/ phyag rgya chen po chos kyi sku rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ don dam pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni shes rab yin pas/ de ltar na lnga po'i ming dang tshig de shes pas sgom yod pa ma yin pas na/ khyed rnams kyis lan 'debs pa'i dus su de ltar gdab/ de la yang khrid dang tshogs chos gnyis yin/ pag tu khrid byas pas myong ba skye/ tshogs chos kyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa yin pas/ 'jig rten mgon po'i tshogs chos 'di bas zab pa med de/ de bas na tshogs chos nyan pa la yang 'bad pa gal che/ gnyis pa 'di ltar du mchi bas/ dge sbyor rgyud la skye bar byed pa la yang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa la mos gus kyi gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa yin te/ de'i dgos pa gang yin na dge sbyor skye bar byed pa yin/

'jig rten 'di'i bsam pa dang*/ rgyal rigs bram ze'i che mtho la sogs pa 'dod pa'i bsam pa yod na yang*/ srid pas len pa yin te de dag 'grub la/ de bzhin du nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang 'grub bo// de la 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa 'di ltar bzhed par gda' ste/ theg pa chen po chen po gsang sngags zab pa'i mthar thug pa lags kyang*/ tshe 'di 'dod pa'i ched du bsgrubs na/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras yin gsung*/ rang nyid zhi bde thob par 'dod na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas sems bskyed pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas tshe gcig gis sangs rgya ba'am/ skye ba ci rigs pas sangs rgya ba yin gsung te/ de ltar yang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud du/ gsang sngags spyod pa dmyal ba dang*// lha dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub la sogs pa// rim pa bzhin du thob par gsungs// 'o na gsang sngags dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi khyad par ci yin snyam na/ khyad par dpag tu med pa zhig bshad kyang*/ nga 'bu'i 'dod pas dbang gi khyad par yin par 'dod/ dbang la yang mang po bshad pa'i gnyer ka med/ bum pa'i dbang gis rang gi lus ngag yid gsum yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su go zhing rtogs pa de yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin che'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ mos gus chen po mthar thug pa byas pa las 'byung la mos gus mthar thug pa de gang yin na/ bla ma dam pa la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes skyes pa de yin/ 'di gcud pa gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor bgyi ba lags pas/ de la sems chos kyi sku'i 'du shes dang ma bral bar byed pa yin la/ de ltar chos kyi sku'i 'du shes su nan tan skyed nas byas kyang*/ chos sku yin re she snyam pa'i rtog pa 'byung*/

de'i dus su yang nan tan byas nas bsgoms pas dub pa'i dus su yang snga ma bzhin du chos sku yin re she snyam 'du shes skye/ yang de rang la nan tan byas nas bsgoms pas/ phrig pa gcig skye/ de'i rgyun srings nas bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen por 'gyur ba yin te/ nga 'bu'i sngon phag mo gru na yod pa'i tshe/ bla ma la mos gus skyes nas/ rje rin po che'i gsung*/ nyes pa rab zad pas kyang lhag pa gcig yod snyam pa byung*/ de bdud zhugs pa yin/ rin po che'i gsung 'di bas lhag pa med pa la/ nga'i blo phyin ci log 'di ma dag bar du zas kyang mi bza'/ ngal yang mi gso snyam pa'i go cha chen po byas nas 'bum pa la skor ba byas pas/ phyi dror song ba dang thang chad nas shi med ko med du gsol ba btab pas/ de nas 'gyur rgyu gcig byung*/ de'i go ba/ nyes pa thams cad rab zad cing bgyi ba las dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs pa yin pa dang*/ yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa zhes pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi yon tan gyi gter du gyur pa yin pa dang*/ 'bras bu thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa zhes pa/ 'bras bu thams cad rdzogs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la zer ba yin pas/ khyed la yod na khyer la shog snyam pa'i blo skyes pa lta bu yin pas/ de ltar mos gus chen po byas shing bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyed nas bsgoms pas/ yon tan skye ba la tshegs med pa lags/ gnyis pa ni bla ma'i mtshan nyid kyang tshe 'di la ltos pa med pa zhig dgos par 'dug tshe 'di la ltos pa yod na slob ma'i bya ba dang byed pa gcig kyang mi 'grub te/ sngon sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su/ bse sgom bya ba mi tshang yang yin/ bza' 'thung yang med/ chos kyang med pa gcig gis/ nga 'bu'i drung du smre sngags bton pas de la tshe 'di'i zhen pas/ khyod nyin re phul phyed kyis 'tsho'am byas pa la/ 'tsho zer bas/ nged gnyis kyis nyin re phul re za zhing yod tsam na/

bse sgom gyis nyin gcig rje btsun 'khor ba rlung khyer la 'bar bas/ de la zhe sdang drag po zhig skyes/ da phyin chad tshe 'di la ltos pa med pa'i dus ma gtogs pa/ sbyin pa khab gcig kyang gtong re snyam pa'i zhe mna' chen po zhig bskyal/ phyis phag mo gru na ston mo gcig byed pa la/ khos trigs se kha gang ma gtang*/ de nas mi gcig 'bod pa la/ 'di la sa 'gag yod/ 'di mi che ba la sogs pa zer bas/ skyugs pa gting nas log pa las/ tshe 'di'i bsam pa phyis je brtan je brtan la song ste/ don gyis ltos pa med pa ma gtogs pa/ ltos pa dang bcas pa'i zan kham gcig gis kyang rang nyid phung bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ sbyin pa ci sbyin yang bsngo ba zhig byas te/ chos la 'god pa gal che/ de yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khang par phyin pa thams cad kyang*/ phyin chad ngan song gsum du mi skye bar gsungs nas 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ khyim bdag des gang la zan byin pa de rnams kyang*/ chos la 'god pa yin pas/ de ltar nyams su len par byed pa de ni gal shin tu che bas de bzhin du mdzad par zhu gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ de ring mi chos kyi mdun ma gcig bshad pas/ de la mi chos kyi mdun ma bya ba de/ 'di tsug gyis dang 'di tsug 'ong bya ba de mi chos kyi mdun ma yin la/ thos pa dang bsam pa la sogs pa lha chos yin te/ de yang gang yin na/ rang cag thams cad su dang yang mi 'dra ba re 'dod par 'dug te/ su dang yang mi 'dra ba gcig ma byas par gar 'ong*/ gtsang pa kun na re/ ku teg pa zhig byung na mig tu sgog chu blugs na yang blugs zer ba dang 'dra bar/ ku teg pa zhig 'ong bar 'dod na mi bas lhag pa zhig byed pa yin/ de yang chos skad du byas na/ mi'i chos las bla mar gyur pa bya ba yin te/ mi'i chos dge ba bcu las rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyis lha dang mi ci rigs pa dang*/

bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyis khams gong ma'i lha la sogs pa thob pa dang*/ dug gsum che 'bring gsum gyis ngan song gsum skyed par byed pa dang*/ de thams cad spangs nas zhi ba phyogs gcig 'dod pa nyan thos yin la/ 'dir dge ba bcu'i steng du phar shes pa/ mar shes pa/ dge sbyong dang*/ bram zer shes pa/ rigs kyi nang na rgan pa la bkur bsti byed pa/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang drug te/ de ltar na mi chos bcu drug yin pas/ de yod pas kyang bla mar gyur pa ma yin/ 'o na gang yin na/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi khur khur nas/ de'i bya ba dang byed pa thams cad byed pa yin te/ de yang rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i gnas su 'phen pa'am 'grub par byed pa tshul khrims yin la/ de yang 'dul ba'i sde snod du gsungs pa'i mi dge ba bcu spong ba 'di sdom pa gsum gar yang 'gyur te/ de yang rim gyis byed dam cig car du byed pa dang*/ 'o na dmyal bar 'gro na sems can gyi don sus byed zer na/ bdag dmyal bar 'gro la khyad par gyi chos sems can gyis don byed pa mi srid/ bdag med pa yin/ de yang sems can gyi don du bya ba dang byed pa thams cad don du 'gro bar byed de/ de yang rgyal po dbang chen sde zhes bya ba zhig la/ pha rol gyi dmag 'ong bas/ de bzlog pa'i thabs sngags dang*/ srung ba la sogs pa byas kyang ma phan pas/ blon po log tu bcug nas kho rang bros pa la/ lam du bram ze slongs mo ba byung ba las/ kho rang bcings te bram ze la byin nas dgra la 'tshong du bcug pas/ de la ngo mtshar skyes nas yul de rgyal po de rang la byin pa lta bu yin pas/ yang rgyal po gser mdog bzhin du rang la 'byor pa yod kyang cher bzar med/ ltogs pa rnams la yang chung ngu sbyin du med de/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du thams cad la snyoms par byas nas rgyal khams bskyangs pa dang*/

sngon mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyis kyang bod khams thams cad la bsdu 'god yang yang byas pa dang 'dra ba yin pas/ byi bo yang rab gcig 'ong ba yin/ mdor na mi'i chos bla mar gyur pa las che 'bring rnam pa gsum gyis khams gsum gyi lha mi thob pa dang*/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi ba dang grol bar 'dod pa nyan thos kyi theg pa de nged mi 'dod pas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang*/ de'i rang bzhin rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa ni/ mkhas pa rab/ gtso bo rab/ slan pa rab/ byi'o rab du 'gyur bas/ de'i dus su lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi yang gtso bor 'gyur na/ mi kha cig lta smos kyang ci dgos/ skyes bu rnams de ltar gyur pa'i dus su/ byang chub kyi sems kyis 'gro ba rnams bde ba la 'god pa'i brtul zhugs 'di shin tu zab te/ nga 'bu'i nyams su myong bas kyang grub pa yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ da lta khyed rnams thams cad bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung na/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa la sogs pa gang byed kyang*/ khyed rnams kyi nang na tshogs mi bskyang snyam pa gcig kyang med pas/ de la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thob dgos/ de la nan tan dang brtson 'grus kyis nyams su blang dgos pas/ 'dir dad pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ chos la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar bya/ de yang bla ma'i mtshan nyid thos nas/ zhabs drung du phyin pa'i dus su zhe 'dod byed pa ngan zer te/ chos dang gdams ngag la 'dod pa'i shugs chen po dgos pa yin/ de ltar byas na de dag gi don go bas myong ba rnyed/ yid chos skye/ de ltar ma go na 'jigs byas pas mi phan te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen phya pa'i zhal nas/ ngas gzhung thams cad la yig sna byed na mi shes pa med gsung ba la/ slob ma gcig gis rdo rje'i tshig rkang gcig bstan nas/ 'di la yig sna zhig mdzad par zhu dang byas pas/

'di mi go ba gcig 'dug gsung skad/ de dang 'dra bar myong ba med pa'i dbu se dge bshes 'ga' zhig la/ 'khor mang pos bskor nas chos 'ong snyam pa'i dus su/ khyi lud kyi skyug pa rgyangs kyis 'ong*/ ci 'ong na/ mi chos kyi 'dun ma 'di ltar gyis bya ba dang*/ khe dang grags pa'i phyir 'di ltar bya ba dang*/ 'di shin tu zab pa yin zer nas/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i gdams ngag bstan te/ 'dod chags spyod pa'i sbyor thabs mtha' yas pa ston par 'ong*/ yang gnyis pa gdams ngag rnam par dag pa gcig sgom 'dod nas/ de'i tshe cis kyang thos pa dgos zer nas/ lung log pa gcig 'bogs par 'ong yang*/ de la slob ma shes rab che ba'i rab yin na de'i kha la mi nyan/ 'bring byed pa de byed kyang shes pa rang la byed du 'gro zer nas drung nas langs/ tha ma yin na de'i drung du bsdad nas ci zer zer byed pa zhig 'byung te/ de la dgos pa med pa gcig 'byung bas/ da lta nas chos 'ba' zhig la nan tan byed pa gal che ba yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sngon dang po rje dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ sems mngon par rtogs pa'i rten gyi gang zag skye ba mi len gsung*/ yang dus phyis skye ba len pa yin gsung te/ de yang sems mngon par rtogs pa'i dus na/ de la sems zhes bya ba de yang med la/ de'i khyad par gyi chos skye ba len pa mi 'byung te/ de ni mngon par rtogs pa de'i ngos nas gsung ba yin/ 'o na da lta'i sems rtog pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig nyon mongs pa phyir che/ rtog pa phyir rag pa yod na/ de ci ltar yin snyam na/ de ni sems kyi rtsa ba chod pas gnod par mi nus te/ dper na shing ljon pa rtsa ba nas gcad na lo 'dab sngon por gyur kyang skye ba'i nus pa med pa dang*/ ja gong ma sreg gis 'bras kyi snye ma mtsho nang du bor ba sbra sbur la brten nas myu gu skyes kyang 'ching ba'i don byed mi nus pa bzhin du khams gsum gyi 'khor bar mi 'khor ba yin/
