'o na 'di ltar lus dang snang ba la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang ba 'di ci yin snyam na/ 'di ni rgyu ngan pa las skyes pa'i 'bras bu yin pas/ nam lus 'di dang bral ba'i dus su bum pa chag pa'i nam mkha' bzhin du 'od gsal gnyis po dbyer med du gyur nas sangs rgya te/ gzugs sku gnyis po shugs las 'byung gsung*/ skye ba len pa'i rgyu ci lta bu yin snyam na/ sems spros pa dang bral ba de goms shing mthar phyin pas/ lus dang snang ba la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi dge sbyor dang dbyer med du rtogs te/ de la do gcig ces bya la/ de ltar rtogs pa'i dus su rang dbang med par sems can gyi don du skye ba mi 'byung kha med gsung*/ de la skye ba'i rgyu gang yin na/ sems bskyed pa 'di yin te/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya snyam pa'i sems 'di las/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i lus su 'gyur bas/ de mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bya ba yin te/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba yin pas de ltar go bar bya gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'dir 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i byang chub kyi thugs rin po che 'di ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis thugs kyang 'di yin la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po yang de yin/ bsam pa de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang byed pa thams cad sems can gyi don du 'gyur te/ zas za ba gcig pus kyang 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don byed pa 'byung*/ de yang steng gi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ spos brtsegs zhes bya ba'i zhing khams zhig na zhal zas kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa yod par gsungs pa bzhin du 'ong la/

nad lta bus kyang 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mtha' yas pa 'byung te/ byang chub sems dpa' li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa smyung ba la grong khyer gyi skyes pa dang*/ bud med khye'u dang*/ bu mo mang pos nad 'dri ba la 'ongs pas 'bras bu la bkod pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs li tsa byi'i drung du nad 'dri ba la btang te/ rje btsun byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'od bsrungs nyan thos kyi 'khor dang bcas pas/ dge gnyen chen po'i drung du phyin te/ cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa dang bcas nas chos bstan pas/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don byas pa lta bu yin pas/ cis kyang 'di lta bu zhig 'gro ba'i don yin zer nas/ mi 'ga' zhig bsdus nas chos bshad pa dang*/ tshogs skyong mi dgos/ 'dir srog chags kyi nad gcig pu gcig la yang*/ lam du btang ba dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas lus sbyin par btang na/ de rnams dang*/ gnod par byed pa de'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcu thams cad du smin par byed pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur te/ byang chub kyi sems las gzhan med/ bdud kyi rgyal po sdig pa can gyis kyang stong pa nyid la bar du mi gcod cing*/ byang chub kyi sems la bar du gcod pas/ de khyed la shes byed ci yod snyam na/ de ltar yang bdud kyi le'u las/ rigs kyi bu gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong na/ ci'i phyir sems can gyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi blo bskyed du yod ces byang chub kyi sems la the tshom bskyed du 'jug pas/ de bas na byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di dang mi 'bral bar bya ba gal che gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems yin gsung*/ de yang rje 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de la bla ma brgya rtsa mang po yod de/

thams cad kyang mkhas pa dang*/ btsun pa dang*/ grub thob mang po yod pas/ de rnams thams cad la 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa'i rgyu gang gis lan bya ba zhus pas/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gi zhal nas/ gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i gtan tshigs chen po rnams kyis ma gzhigs pas lan bya ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gi zhal nas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pas lan bya ba dang*/ bla ma sa skya ba'i zhal nas rlung dbu mar ma tshud pas lan bya ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje sgam po pa yin pas/ rje de'i zhal snga nas/ sems ma rtogs pas lan pa yin gsung*/ de la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems bgyi ba de 'di ltar bzhed par gda' bas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa/ mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin la/ sems de skye ba med par rtogs pa'i dus su 'khor ba yang med/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang med/ de gnyis ka med pa de la gnyis med ces bya te/ snang ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ yod pa dang*/ med pa la sogs pa thams cad gnyis su med par rtogs pa yin la/ rtogs pa de yang dben par skyong ba yin/ dben pa'i dgos pa yang*/ dben par bsdad nas rtogs pa bskyangs pas/ rgyu 'bras sam rten 'brel go nas 'ong te/ bsam pa 'dis 'di skye/ 'dis 'di 'grub bgyi ba/ don la bcu chos gnad du 'gro bas/ 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos kyi mig des gsung rab dge ba'i bshes gnyen du shar nas 'ong te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab thams cad rang gi sems thog tu go// de nas snang ba rten 'brel stong pa nyid du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags nyams su len par byed pa la/ dpe rnam pa gsum dang ldan dgos te/ ded dpon lta bu'i bla ma/ tshong pa dang 'dra ba'i grogs po/ nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ba'i gdams ngag go// de la ded dpon lta bu'i bla ma de yod na phan pa dang*/

gnod pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ bsgrub par bya ba ma yin pa dang*/ dus tshod shes pa la mkhas pa yin/ tshong pa dang 'dra ba'i grogs po rdo rje spun grogs de yod na/ bsam pa mthun pa/ don phyogs gcig tu bsgrub pa'i blo dang ldan pa yin/ nor bu dang 'dra ba'i gdams ngag bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin pas/ de dag gis bar chad gang yin pa'i phyogs de spong ba'i thabs la 'bad na/ gcig gi don grub pa dang gzhan thams cad de la brten pas ma chog pa med pa yin te/ slob dpon gu pa 'dzi pa bya bas bla ma la ma zhus par spyod pa byas pas/ bud med sngo bsangs ma zhig gis rgyab tu rdog tho zhig rgyab pas sgur por song nas phyis mtshan yang sgur po zhabs zhes bya bar grags pa lags par gda' te/ de nas phyis gshags pa byas pas sangs nas/ u rgyan du sgrub pa byed pa la de'i dus su mu ge chen po zhig byung nas/ sems can mang po 'chi bar 'dug pa gzigs pas/ de la thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas/ de rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ thugs dam mdzad pa ni nam mkha' la yi ge bh+rūm̐ gcig bsgoms nas/ bh+rūm̐ de las 'bras kyi char chen po phab pas sems can rnams bde bar byas shing*/ da ltar yang dpal ldan 'bras phung zhes bya bar grags pa dang*/ sngon byon pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal po de rnams kyang lha re re phal gyis bsgrubs nas/ de grub pa dang rgyal khams thams cad skyong ba yin te/ mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam pos jo bo thugs rje chen po grub pa dang*/ rgyal po nga las nus 'khor los sgyur ba grub pa la sogs pa dang*/ dper gyis na zhing pa gcig gis zhing gi so nam legs par byas na/ phyis 'gro ba mang po'i bza' btung dang*/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad 'byung ba dang 'dra bas/ sgrub pa byed pa gal che bas/ 'gro ba'i don 'byung ba rnams la sgrub pa byas pas 'byung ba 'di kho na don che ba yin pas/

gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa la nan tan dang brtson 'grus bya gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ spyir slob ma rnams kyis kyang bla ma brtag dgos/ brtag pa'i tshul yang sngags mtshan nyid thams cad du/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid dpag tu med pa gsungs pa de rnams yin/ de la rje dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ tshogs pa brgya yan chad kyis bskor ba yin na de la brtag pa mi dgos gsung*/ lan ni tshogs pa brgya man chad kyis ni mthon dman ci byed kyang de la nus pa med/ de yan chad du song ba'i dus su ci yang 'grub pas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan mi ldan/ chos byed dam mi byed de tsam na gsal ba yin/ de la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma tshogs pa khri phrag stong phrag yan chad skyong ba'i bla ma de'i thugs dgongs dpag par dka' ste/ de sngon bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs kyang*/ da rung ci tsug 'ong dang*/ bzang byed dam ngan byed cha med de/ gdul bya tha dad pa rnams kyi khrid dang gdams ngag dang chos de min pas mi shes/ de bas na de la zab zer/ de rgya che ba yin te/ de'i spyod pa rlabs po che ma gtogs pa mi srid pas/ 'di yin bya bar tshod bzung tu mi tub te mi zin pa yin/ gnyis par na bla ma dang 'khor thams cad la de'i byed pa phrin las bzhi yin te/ de thams cad ni bla ma chen po 'tshal pa'i rnam par thar pa ltar yin pas dgra yin yang drung du phyin pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed/ ci srid rang gi sa ris 'das kyi bar du skyel ma byas nas gtong ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ pho nya gsad par mi bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ bla ma des ci gsung ba bzhin du bsgrub pa gal che ba yin/ de yang mdor bsdus pas sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems/ dngos gzhi bla ma dam pa'i gsung bsgrub pa/ rjes bsngo ba bya ba dang gsum yin gsung*/ de yang byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mthun pas bsgrub te/

'dir yang nga'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi mthun na khyed la mi 'chol/ rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa dang*/ bde ba'i thabs bstan pa de la ni the tshom dang som nyi med par gsung byon pa dang*/ bya mos lud pa thob pa bzhin du byed pa gal che gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum mam/ de'i phyogs kyi bya ba dang byed pa thams cad la gtso bor bya ba dang*/ 'khor du bya ba rnam pa gnyis yod te/ thos pa byed pa rnams kyis po ti re re tsam shes par byed pa mthil/ de sgrub par byed pa la dmag dang dmu dang rnam gzhag dpag tu med pas de'i phyogs sgrub par byed pa yin te/ po ti re re tsam ma shes na mtshang snon du 'gro la/ shes na yon tan du 'gro bsam pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa nas bdag med gnyis kyi don bsam pa yin te/ de skyes pas bya ba thams cad bor rgyu snying po med par rtogs pa de 'dra ba 'ong ba yin te/ tshe 'di blos ma thongs par ka ca'i gsog brun rnams dang*/ tshul khrims la gces spras med par sems can la 'tshe ba dang*/ bdag tu 'dzin pa shas che bas phung po dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad/ nye du dang gnyen 'brel la mngon par chags pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gces spras mi byed par/ bdag med gnyis kyi don rtogs ces bya ba ni mi srid pa yin no/ |'dir sgom chen pa rnams kyi mthil du bya ba ni sgom pa kho na yin te/ thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shes rab kyis bogs 'don pa dang*/ shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs kyis bogs 'don pa yin te/ de yang sgom ma skyes pa bskyed pa/ skyes pa brtan pa/ brtan pa gong nas gong du bogs 'don pa/ bdud mi 'jug cing*/ zhugs pa bzlog pa dang bzhi dgos pa dang*/ yang na 'jig rten mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis cig car du 'byung ba dang lnga yin la/ de la 'dir sgom skye bar byed pa'i thabs/

maṇ+ḍal dang yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma byung ba rab/ 'bring 'bum dang bye ba la sogs pa'i grangs song ba/ tha ma yang dus zhag bco lnga yin te/ de ltar nyams su blangs zin pa'i rjes la sgom 'debs pa yin no// de la yang rab 'bring gsum yin te/ rab mtshan thos pa/ 'bring zhal mthong ba/ tha ma khrid byas pa gsum yin/ de yang bla ma me nyag lta bu yin pas/ bla ma me nyag des rje phag mo gru pa'i mtshan thos nas zhabs drung du 'gro bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa byung ba dang*/ de rang gi mtshan mo lus la drod skyes/ ting nge 'dzin rang dbang med par byung ba dang*/ 'dre yin snyam nas mtshan mo lha gsol 'dre skrod byas pa dang*/ yon bdag mo gnas mo zhig na re/ ci byung zer/ 'di 'dra ba zhig byung byas pas/ khyed phag mo grur 'gro 'dod pa min nam/ der 'gro na bla ma de'i byin rlabs kyis de 'dra ba 'byung ba yin zer bas/ der gzod kyis byin rlabs su go nas/ zhabs drung du phyin nas bsdad pas/ rtogs ldan me nyag sgom ring bya ba byung ba yin/ tha ma khrid kyi dbang du byas te sgom btab pas sems gnas/ de la brten nas nyon mongs pa dug gsum gzhi gang che ba slongs/ slongs pa de bla ma des de'i rang bzhin spros pa dang bral bar bsgom du bcug pas/ de nyid las grol bar 'gyur te/ dug gsum po de re re la yang*/ 'dod chags 'od gsal bde chen zung du 'jug /ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/ 'dod chags phyi longs spyod la chags pa/ zhing dang khang khyim la sogs pas tshul khrims dang 'gal ba ka lan ta ka'i bu bzang sbyin rigs kyi phyir bslab pa nyams pa lta bur 'gyur bas/ zhing dang bsam pa dang*/ dngos po gsum gyi rten 'brel sgrigs la dbul bar bya'o// zhe sdang ba ni mnar sems rim pa dgu yin te/ 'di 'dod pa tsam ni ma mthong 'phrang du gdong thug tu bkye ba khyi dang 'dra bas/

de yang rang sar bzhag pa nyid kyis rang grol du 'gro ba yin/ zhe sdang 'od gsal skye med zung du 'jug /ces gsungs so/ gti mug ni nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa yin te/ rtog pa de nyid rtog pa med pa mtha' brgyad dang bral ba yin/ de las logs su med pas/ de ltar yang*/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pas rten 'brel mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid de bsgom par bya ba yin la/ de'i rgyun sring ba la 'gal ba'i rkyen thams cad spang ba dang*/ mthun pa'i rkyen bsgrubs pas/ ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ khyed thams cad kyis sdug pa dang*/ 'khon pa dang*/ dra sha chad pa'i dus su dkon mchog gsum dran par bya/ de dran na sdug bsngal thams cad zil gyis non nas rang yang dbugs dbyung 'bad rtsol dang brtson 'grus kyi shugs bskyed/ yon tan gong ma dpag tu med yang rgyud la skye ba yin/ de yang lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis 'thab pa'i dus na lha ma yin shugs dang stobs che ba'i dus su ni/ lha rnams sgyid lugs cing ngal ba dang dub pa'i dus kyi tshe na/ lha'i dbang pos lha rnams la khyed nga'i rgyal mtshan mchog chos bzang lha'i mdun sa dran par gyis shig ces byas pas/ lha rnams kyis chos bzang lha'i mdun sa dran par byas pa dang*/ lha rnams dbugs thon zhing sdug bsngal zil gyis non nas lus kyi stobs rnyed de/ brgya byin 'dod chags can/ zhe sdang can/ gti mug can de'i gnas dran pa yang de 'dra na/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de'i gnas dran pa ni lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes gsungs na/ dkon mchog rin po che gsum dran par ci'i phyir mi byed/

'o na de yang dang po sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa gang yin na/ khyed thams cad la yi dam gyi lha re re yod pa ma yin nam/ de bas na rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo bar bsgoms nas/ de'i bstod pa/ thugs rje dbyings las bzhengs pa'i sku mchog ni// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// sna tshogs pad ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// zhabs gnyis brkyang skum bgegs chen du ma gzir// zhes bstod pas dran par byed pa yin/ yang na jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgoms nas/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can// zhes pa la sogs pa sku de'i khyad par gyi chos/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa de ltar dran par byed pa yin te/ nga 'bu la khyod rab gnas mkhas pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin 'dri na/ ngas sangs rgyas rjes dran tshar gcig 'don shes pa yin snyam/ de nged kyis kyang shes zer na/ bdag dang*/ gzhan dang*/ rten rjes su dran pa ni/ tshangs par spyod pa thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ de yang byang chub kyi sems kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sran ma rdog ma phyed dang lnga phul ba'i rgyal po nga las nus gling chen po bzhi dang*/ gser gyi ri bdun dang*/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su lha'i dbang po'i stan phyed pas te/ brgya byin brgya rtsa bcu bzhi'i tshe thub cing phun sum tshogs pa thams cad la longs spyod pa byung la/ de dang 'dra bar byang chub kyi 'bras bu rgyun chad med par 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung la/ de ltar go ba'i dus su nas rdog ma re re 'am/ tsha rdog ma re re la yang ji ltar 'gyur te/ de go na chos nyan pa'i dus su chu 'chag pa gar dran te mi tub/ lus dum bur gyur kyang chos snying por byed pa 'byung ba yin pas/ de ni chos rjes su dran pa yin no// dge 'dun rjes su dran pa ni/ dad pa'i stobs skyed pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdo las gsungs pa bzhin du/

sems can phal pa gzhan pas phyi rol pa'i drang srong 'dod chags dang bral ba/ drang srong bas dge bsnyen ston pa lha gzhan la mi bsten pa/ dge bsnyen pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ de bas kyang dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang*/ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ de bas kyang chos khyad par du 'phags pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ phyugs kyi shing rtas 'gro ba dang*/ glang po che'i shing rtas 'gro ba dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba lta bus 'gro ba dang*/ nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ rim pa bzhin du bsod nams dpag tu med par gsungs pas/ de dran par bya/ tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin te/ 'di bya ba med par 'gyur te/ bsod nams mthar thug pa med par 'gyur bas/ de ni dge 'dun rjes su dran pa yin no// de ltar dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pas/ yid bde bar 'byung*/ tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin te/ 'di bya ba bsgrub pa rnams kyi chos zab pa yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ de ring mtshal pa mi chen po rnams byon pa'i dus 'dir/ chos shin tu che ba zhig bshad pas/ 'di yid la zung shig de la chos chen po de gang yin na/ spyir nged rang sems can thams can gdod ma nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa de yin/ de la khyod kyi chos chen po gcig gang na 'dug de gang gis bshad snyam na/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs te/ 'dir theg pa chen po gsang sngags re shig bzhugs su gsol la/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i dgongs pa/ mgon po byams pas gtan la phab pa/ rgyud bla ma bgyi ba/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams te/ don gyis dbu ma dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa/ gong na med pas na bla ma yin la/ de la khams zhes bya ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'am/ gzhi'am/ gdod nas sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i gshis de las mi 'da' bas/ gzhi'ang de nyid/ lam yang de nyid/ 'bras bu yang de nyid yin pas na rgyud ces bya ste/ de lta bu'i don ston pa'i rgyud bla ma zhes bya ba der rgya cher gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa chen po des de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i mdor/ dpe dgu dang*/ don dgus bstan te/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la// sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser// sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras chung dang*// gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni// bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang*// sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar// zhes pas pad ma shin tu rgyas pa'i nang na sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa bzhugs pa bzhin du/ ye gdod ma nas sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par yod pa yin no// 'o na de ni nye bar zhi ba'am/ skye ba med pa'am/ de bzhin nyid lhun gyis grub pa tsam zhig ma yin nam snyam na/ chos kyi sku dang*/ chos sku de'i yon tan dang*/ phrin las rnam pa gnyis ni chos kyi sku de dang tha mi dad de/ nyi ma dang 'od zer ram gla rtsi dang gla rtsi'i dri bzhin du mtshungs par 'gyur te/ gzugs stong pa nyid dang*/ stong pa nyid gzugs dang 'dra bas/ ston pa'i gsung gi rim pa de las mi tub te/ dper na dmus long la nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba yin pas/ gshis la yod pa de ston pa yin/ bstan pa de nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos de gcig pa yin/

de yang sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'byung ba yin te/ de ji ltar 'byung na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des/ gdul bya 'ga' zhig byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la bkod nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ de ltar mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'byung ba yin/ 'dir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len pa la/ gcig gis sbyin pa gtong ba kho na la zhugs na/ de la gtong ba chen po'i blo dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig gis de mthong nas/ bdag gtong ba chen po la zhugs pa yin/ 'di yang sbyin pa gtong bar 'dug ces dga' ba skyes pas kyang thun mong du 'gyur/ dma' ba ser sna can gyis mthong na yang bdag ni ser sna dang ldan pa yin te sbyin pa 'di ltar gtong ba de ni ngo mtshar re che snyam pa 'byung bas de yang thun mong du 'gyur bar sbyin pa la dga' bas/ des sbyin pa gtong ba mthong na/ des sngar sbyin pa btang ba dang*/ phyis gtong ba la 'jug pas de ltar rjes su yi rang ba thams cad kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad thun mong du 'gyur la/ de ltar tshul khrims nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug la yang*/ mtho ba dang*/ dma' ba dang*/ bar ma gsum du 'gyur ba dang*/ bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ rjes su yi rang bar byas pa thams cad de'i 'khor du 'gyur ba yin te/ khrag khrug dang cal col la sogs pa'ang 'byung srid pas/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin la sogs pas kyang phan pa mi bsgrub kha med pa yin te/ dper na mchog tsha rang dbang med par nye gnas su 'gyur ba'ang de yin gsung*// //'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ spyir bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la/ lta spyod gnyis 'dzom pa gal che gsung*/ de la bod khams 'di'i lta ba mthon po rnams kyang spyod pa dang 'dzol/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa rnams kyang lta ba dang mi ldan te/

lta sgom spyod pa thams cad tha dad par 'dod pas/ lta ba la yang*/ sgom gyi thog nas lta ba phar 'tshol ba dang*/ lta ba'i thog nas sgom pa tshur 'tshol ba gnyis yod pa la/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa de mi bzhed pas/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i lta ba rang gi sems kyi de kho na nyid gnyis yod pas/ gzhan chos nyid gtso bor byed de/ 'di rgyud pa 'di'i pha skad ma yin/ sems nyid 'di rgyud pa 'di'i pha skad thun mong ma yin pa lags pas/ sems de rtogs pa lta ba/ de nyid las ma yengs par sgom pa yin pas/ lta sgom gnyis gcig tu 'ong gsung*/ spyod pa ni lta ba de dang mthun par spyod pa la zer te/ lta ba dam dum kun la yod kyang*/ spyod pa glang po thabs su gces zhes gsungs pas/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba yin te/ de nyid kyang thub pa'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yin pas/ de yang gnas 'du 'dzi las dben pa dgon par sdod dgos pa yin la/ de'i bye brag tu dur khrod dang*/ shing drung dang*/ bla gab med pa dang*/ bas mtha' te/ bye brag bzhi dang*/ gos phyag dar khrod yin te/ de yang nyams pa dang*/ dor ba gnyis yin pas/ chos gos gsum pa dang*/ phying ba pa ste/ gos la gsum dang*/ zas la bsod snyoms pa/ stan gcig pa/ phyis mi len pa ste/ zas la gsum dang*/ spyod lam tsog pu ba dang*/ gzhi ci bzhin pa ste/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis po spyad pas/ 'phags pa nye sde'i 'khor dang 'dra ste/ 'phags pa nye sde'i 'khor sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis dang ldan nas/ shin tu mdzes par gyur pa de/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs pas/ thugs shin tu mnyes nas/ nye sde khyod kyi 'khor 'di ltar mdzes pa'i rgyu ci yin gsungs pa la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 'khor 'di ltar mdzes pa ni rab tu byung ba na sbyangs pa'i yon tan khas len du bcug nas/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas par gyur pa las byung ba lags so// zhes zhus pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas/ sus sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sngags pa brjod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sngags pa brjod pa yin no zhes gsungs pas/ spyod pa mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas par bya ba yin gsung*// //yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ltar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos de thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba yin te/ de ltar yang thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la// da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang*// zhes gsungs pas/ thog ma dang*/ bar dang*/ tha ma thams cad du dge ba lags/ de la thog mar dge ba bgyi ba/ tshe 'di'i bde ba la sogs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rin po che 'di las 'byung la/ nges par legs pa'i 'bras bu byang chub rnam pa gsum las/ nyan thos kyi byang chub dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po ste/ thar pa thob par byed pa de yang dam pa'i chos las 'byung zhing*/ chos kyis byang chub rnam pa gsum thob par byed pa lags/ de ltar thar pa byang chub rnam pa gsum po de yang lam gyi rim pa ma gtogs pa theg pa la tha dad med cing*/ theg pa gcig tu nges pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ dus da lta nyid nas theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa la 'jug pa gal che gsung*/ de la bla na med pa'i theg pa de gang yin snyam na/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di yin te/ sems gsum po rten 'brel rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa las skyes pa de la byang chub kyi sems zhes zer ba yin/ de ltar yang byams pa'i chu bo mi gcod cing*// snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brlan te// byang sems ljon shing rab rgyas shing*// sa bcu'i me tog thon gyur nas// don gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad gsol// zhes gsungs pas 'di yod na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin pa yin/

rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras su gyur pa yin/ sems can gcig gam gnyis sam nyung shos byang chub kyi sems la bkod kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byas pa yin la/ byang chub kyi sems la ma 'khod na/ nyan thos kyi byang chub dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la sems can dpag tu med pa bkod kyang mi phan pa yin te/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba byon nas/ sems can dpag tu med pa dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod kyang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sems can gcig tsam yang ma rnyed nas/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa ni/ sems can sems bskyed pa la dgod pa'i ched du byon pa yin la/ bdag gis sems can gcig tsam yang sems bskyed pa la ma bkod na ni sangs rgyas kyi bya ba ma byas pas/ da ni sems bskyed pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa gcig gang na 'dug par gzigs pas/ gzugs med kyi khams na sems bskyed pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa zhig 'dug par gzigs nas sems can de'i tshe'i tshad bskal pa brgyad khri'i bar du gnas par 'dug pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku tshe ma thub pas/ de'i don du sprul pa zhig bzhag nas mya ngan las 'das par gsungs pa yin te/ de bas na sems bskyed pa la 'god pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mdzad pa yin la/ bcom ldan 'das kyang shin tu dgyes pa yin/ rang gi bla ma dam pa yang mnyes/ bla ma mnyes pa des mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yin te/ de ltar yang de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni// kun mkhyen nyid kyang 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsung so// 'o na mnyes pa'i bya ba gang yin na/ spyir bla ma des ji ltar gyis gsung ba de bsgrub pa'am/ thugs dgyes pa'i dngos po'am/ bya ba gang yang rung ba yin te/ glu dang bro gar gyis mnyes par byas pas don grub pa slob dpon ri khrod dbang phyug lta bu yin la/ 'dir khyad par du bla ma dam pa de 'gro ba'i don byed pa la mnyes pas/

de bsgrub na yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes dang bcas nas 'ong te/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa la ni gdul bar bya ba'i skyes bu las gzhan med do ces pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'char ka de bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa las bsgral nas/ dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' drin dran pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la 'di lta bu'i mdzad pa mdzad na/ 'di'i drin lan ci lta bu zhig gis bsgrub snyam pa las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa sems can drang ba'i don du yin gyis/ bdag gis kyang sems can la phan pa bsgrub pas de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes shing drin lan len pa yin no snyam nas/ des khyim pa khyim na gnas pa thams cad dad pa dang gus par byas shing*/ 'bras bu rgya chen po la bkod pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ nga'i dge slong khyim pa dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi mchog ni/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yin no zhes gsungs pa lta bu lags pas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang sems can dpag tu med pa thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa gal shin tu che/ des na bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che gsum gyi gdung rgyud 'dzin par byed par yang yod la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa mnyes par yang des mchi ba lags pas/ de ltar thugs rin po che la bzhag nas/ sgrub pa dang nyams len tshul bzhin du mdzad par zhu 'tshal gsung*// //thub pa'i bstan la gangs can rgyud 'di ru// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen byon pa mtshar// zab cing rgya che'i dam chos gsungs pa la// ban ldom sher 'byung zin bris bgyis pa mtshar// grogs mchog yon tan dpag med gter 'chang ba// rin chen mgon pos brtse bas skul ba mtshar// rje gcig zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs gyur nas// lo dgu'i tshe na mthil du phyin pa mtshar// tshangs par mtshungs spyod dam tshig gcig pa rnams// thugs dgongs bslab gsum rin chen bsgrub pa mtshar// ci mnyes bsgrub cing mi mnyes rnams spongs bas// dpal ldan grogs mchog ba yi rtsa ba 'dis// chos rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs dgyes pa mtshar// 'di bris dri med dge ba'i rtsa 'dis// chos rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*// bstan pa rin chen dam chos rgyas pa yis// 'gro ba sems can sangs rgyas thob gyur gcig
/dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig chos thun po lnga pa'o// //

818) ༄// zhu ba dang zhus pa'i lan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gces pa'i snying po ma rig mun sel// oṃ swa sti/ sems nyid 'od gsal mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings// rang bzhin rnam dag 'gyur med byang chub sems// rang sems bde chen bla ma rin chen ni// sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku// mtshan dpes rab brgyan stobs bcu mnga' ba'i gsung*// smra bsam brjod med mkhyen gnyis ldan pa'i thugs// ma rig mun sel rang rig ye shes ni// rtag chad 'gro 'ong med cing 'dus ma byas// skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal nad kyis dben// dus gsum chags thogs med par rin chen gyis// ma rnams yang dag sa la 'god mdzad pa'i// yid bzhin dpal 'bar bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// yon tan gter mdzod bla ma rin chen de// tshangs pa brgya byin lha klu mi'am ci// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// 'jigs med seng ge pad nyi'i gdan steng du// shin tu rnam dag gser gyi mchod sdong ltar// drang por bzhugs pa'i sku ni lhun po 'dra// zhi ba'i spyan gyis dul ba mtha' yas la// gzigs shing dgyes pa'i zhal ni 'dzum zhing mdzes// mtshungs med dbang phyug smra ba'i seṅge des// zhal gyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram// dung gi tshems bar nas ni dam pa'i chos// rab 'byams thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad dang*// chos rje'i thugs dgongs dri med gcig pa'i gnad// 'khor 'das chos rnams rang sems stong pa la// rgyu 'bras spu ris ma 'dres 'byung ba'i tshul// 'jigs med seṅge'i nga ro 'gran zla bral// skye 'gag med cing snyan pa'i chos char ni// tshangs pa'i dbyangs 'dra mnyam zhing tshim pa med// blta bas mi ngom bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs drung lhags pa'i gdul bya de rnams kyang*// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma de phyogs su// bya ba byas shing spobs pa dang ldan pas// zab cing rgya che dam chos rin chen la// zhu ba rgya mtsho dpag med zhus pa la// rgyal ba'i sras po chos la gus ldan pas// chos brjod yul de nye bar thob phyir dang*// bla ma'i thugs dgongs dri med rdzogs phyir dang*// zhus dang zhus pa'i lan du cung zad 'bri//

//bcas rang bzhin gcig tshul gang lags zhus pas/ gzhan gyis bcas rang bzhin mi gcig par 'dod de/ dgag bcas dang sgrub bcas gnang bcas gsum du 'dod la/ rang bzhin pham pa bzhi/ dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam/ so so tha mal pa la sogs pa sems can gang gis byas kyang mi dge la/ bcas pa sa rko me reg la sogs pa phyi dro'i kha zas la sogs pa rkyen la ltos te/ res dgag par bcas pas ltung ba 'byung la/ res gnang bar bcas pas nyes pa med par 'dod de/ phyi dro'i kha zas nad pa dang las dang po pa la gnang bas nyes pa med par 'dod/ rje rin po che'i bzhed kyis dge ba mi dge bar mi 'gyur/ mi dge ba dge bar mi 'gyur bas/ bcas rang bzhin gcig ste/ dgag sgrub gnyis su nges pas gnang bcas su mi bzhed do// pham pa bzhi gang gis byas kyang mi dge ba/ bcas pa gang byung gi sar rang bzhin gyis khyab ste/ mi dge ba'i g.yos su gcig pa phra rag ma gtogs pa ltung ba sde lnga'i ngo bor gcig ste/ sa rko me reg phyi dro'i kha zas la sogs pa bcas pa rnams/ bya dang byed pa mang*/ las dang lam la sgrib/ gzhan ma dad par 'gyur/ ngan song gsum du skye ba'i dgag bya nyes dmigs de dag dang ldan na gnang ba'i go skabs gtan med pas dgag par bcas/ rgyu mtshan bya dang byed pa mang bas/ dge 'dun gyi 'khor gsum la bar du gcod pa dang*/ las dang lam la sgrib ste/ dge slong gi las brgya rtsa gcig la sogs pa la mi dbang*/ lam 'phags pa'i lam du 'gro ba 'gog pa byang chub pa gsum mam/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi la bar du gcod/ gzhan mi dad par 'gyur te mkhan po'am slob dpon tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten na dkar po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la mos pa rnams mi mnyes pa'i nyes dmigs de dag dang ldan pas gnang ba'i go skabs gtan nas med gsung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar gsungs pa de bsgrub par ma nus pa la ming nyes med du btags pa yin/

bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod la gnang gsungs pas ltung ba mi 'byung na bcom ldan 'das byed pa por 'gyur ba dang*/ las dang po pa la gnang bas ltung ba mi 'byung na/ las dang po pa de ltung ba 'byung byed kyi rgyu bzhi dang mi ldan la nyon mongs pa gsum gyis dben spyos pa'i bya byed mi mnga' zhing*/ dge 'dun gyi 'khor gsum dang ldan pa zhig yin nam/ las dang lam la mi sgrib ste dge slong gi las brgya rtsa gcig la dbang zhing*/ 'phags pa'i lam 'gog pa byang chub rnam pa gsum mam/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi'i bar chad du mi 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan ma dad par mi 'gyur la/ las dang po la mkhan po dang slob dpon la sogs pa chos dang ldan pa thams cad kyis de la bsngags pa brjod pa zhig yin dgos/ de rnams dang mi ldan na las dang po pa la gnang bas de la nyes pa mi 'byung na/ bcom ldan 'das byed por 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sgrub par ma nus pa la ming nyes med du gsungs pa ma gtogs pa/ nad pa la phyi dro'i kha zas gnang ba nyes pa med na bsgrub pa'i bslab pa yin dgos te/ nad phan pa'i dus su bshags bsdam byed pa gsungs pa de bdag gis dge ba byas pa bshags so bya ba yin te/ de ltar mi 'gyur bas/ dge ba thams cad gshis kyi dge ba gnang ba ye gnang*/ mi dge ba gshis kyi mi dge ba bkag pa ye bkag gnang ba'i go skabs med pas na bcas rang bzhin gcig pa yin gsung*// //sbas pa gsum gyi dngos 'dzin zhus pas/ dga' ba gsum gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sbas pa ni/ 'dod chags chos kyis sbas pa/ snang mched thob gsum gyis bar do dang po'i 'od gsal sbas pa ni/ sems snang ba gsum gyis sbas pa/ kun rdzob sgyu ma mi rtag cing*/ 'jig pa'i chos can gyis 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa sbas/ 'di gsum go na gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbugs song ba yin te/ gsang 'dus kyi snying po yin gsung*//

//chos rje'i zhal nas khyed rnams kyis grogs bya sgong tsam zhig yod pa de za mi shes/ zhag nya mig tsam zhig yod pa de nyab mi shes/ srog rta rnga tsam zhig yod pa de 'tsho mi shes gsung ba de gang lags zhus pas/ grogs bya sgong tsam zhig za mi shes pa de skye bzhin pa'i rnam par rtog pa de grogs yin/ de lnga ldan gyis nyams su blangs pas sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'byung ba yin/ zhag nya mig tsam zhig nyab shes pa ni/ gtum mo bsgom pa'am/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas rlung nang du log rtsa kha bye/ bde ba'i stobs rgyas pa de/ sum chos kyis gnad du bsnun pa yin/ srog rta rnga tsam bca' shes pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams su myong ba de yin pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de ma gtogs pa gzhan la gsang*/ 'di'i skabs su rgya gar na dpal rga lo la zag pa gser du byung ba bla ma'i bla ma yin pas mi sto snyam nas a bh+ya la bzlas pas 'phro chad pa la sogs pa gsung*// //sangs rgyas kyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos kyi sku thugs su chud pas/ dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal de yang thugs su chud na/ dmyal ba la sdug bsngal yod pa ma bde zhus pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas par thugs su chud de rtag chad bral ba'i gnad kas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel du byung bas/ zhe sdang gi sems de'i las kyis dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal myong ba de yang sangs rgyas kyis zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas dang gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med so so ma yin tha mi dad par thugs su chud/ dmyal ba la sdug bsngal yod pa de ltar ma rtogs pas lan gsung*// //sems ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs su med par gsungs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis sems can gyi rtog pa spu ris mkhyen pa de yang sems yin pas ma bde zhus pas/

sangs rgyas kyis sems mkhyen/ ji ltar mkhyen/ sems ni sems ma mchis pa ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal bar mkhyen/ sems can gyi sems de yang sems ma mchis pa ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal bar mkhyen gsung*// //dmigs pa'i rigs ji snyed cig bsgoms kyang sems nang du gnas thabs su 'dug la/ phyag rgya chen po bsgoms kyang sems nang du gnas pa'i thabs yin la/ dmigs pa bsgoms pas thang chad cing phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas ngal sos par 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ gnyis ka sems nang du gnas par gcig kyang*/ dmigs pa'am bskyed rim bsgoms pas shes pa dub nas 'ong ba yin/ spyod lam cha mnyam zhing bsgoms pas de nyid phyag rgya chen po dang gnyis su med par rtogs nas bsgoms pas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gis lam bgrod pa yin gsung*// //bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sa mtshams gang lags zhus pas/ gshis kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i 'khor lo las mi 'da' ste/ rtog pa rtogs ma rtogs pa theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyis lam bgrod pa yang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa lha dang rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po gnyis kyis lam bgrod pa yin la/ mdor bsdus na bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sa mtshams rtogs ma rtogs gnyis yin gsung*// //'dir rtogs pa dang ldan pa bar do dang po'i 'od gsal sgug mi dgos pa dang*/ 'chi khar 'pho ba 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ shin tu dgos/ de la dar tsa ring mos rje rin po che la zhu zhing 'dug pa la 'pho ba zhe sdang dang bsre bar gsungs la/ sangs rgyas la ni zhe sdang med na/ 'pho ba mdzad pa ma bde zhus pas/ thugs hur gyis mdzad/ zhe sdang sangs rgyas la med dam sems can la med/ sangs rgyas kyis seṅge'i nyal stabs 'pho ba ma mdzad na/ deng sang rjes su 'jug pa mi 'ong ba yin gsung*// //rang sangs rgyas la dang po rtogs pa la slob dpon ni med na sangs rgyas pa'i dus su rigs kyi bdag po med pa lags sam zhus pas/

rang sangs rgyas kyis khams gsum 'khor ba rten 'brel lugs 'byung ma rig pa las 'byung bar go nas/ ma rig pa 'gags na 'du shes dang rga shi'i bar 'gag par shes shing*/ rten 'brel lugs ldog bsgoms shing de nyid la mos pa de sangs rgyas kyi gsung la mos pa yin pas dbu brgyan pa yin gsung*// //bla ma sku'i rigs su yod pa la slob ma gsung gi rigs la mos na rigs 'chol bar mi 'ong ngam zhus pas/ de mi 'ong ste bla ma la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa yod pas/ slob ma gang la mos kyang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la mos pa de'i rigs kyis dbu brgyan pa yin gsung*// //chos rje'i zhal nas/ nga 'bu 'dra ba bzhis gsol ba phyogs gcig tu btab na/ mgon po phag mo gru pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bzhugs nges gsung ba de/ thugs dam ci lta bu zhig la mnyam par bzhag pa yin zhus pas/ mgon po phag mo gru pa tshad med pa bzhi'i sku yin pas tshad med pa bzhi la mnyam par bzhag nas thugs dam rgyud bskul ba yin/ thugs dam sems can gyi don du thugs bskyed pa yin pas na/ thugs tshad med pa bzhi la mnyam par bzhag pa yin/ de yang sems can thams cad rang gi ma yin pa la byas pa shes shing byas pa drin du gzo ba la skyes pa ni byams pa tshad med pa/ ma rnams khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor 'khor ba la/ khong mi bzhugs pa skyabs mgon gzhan med pas gdung ba'i shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa ni snying rje tshad med pa/ khong bzhugs na sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar byas nas phrag mi dog cing dga' ba tshad med pa/ rang 'dzam bu gling 'dir yod pas/ 'di gcig pu'i sems can du ma zad/ sems can thams cad la nye ring med pa'i thugs kyis bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar bzhed pa de btang snyoms tshad med pa yin gsung*// //gsang sngags su mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla mas zin nas spyi bor 'phos na sangs rgyas par gsungs pa de sdig pa des 'dag pa yin nam/

ma dag na ji ltar gnas zhus pas/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang spyi bor 'phos na sangs rgyas par gsungs pa de/ gsang sngags kyi rang skad bkas bcad pa yin gsung*// //yang rje rin po che la zhus pa/ rtogs pa yod na spyi bor 'phos na sangs rgyas par gsungs pa de bde/ rtogs pa med na yang spyi bor 'phos nas sangs rgyas pa ma bde zhus pas/ de yin rtogs pa yod pa spyi bor 'phos na sangs rgya/ rtogs pa med pa spyi bor 'phos na sangs rgya gsung ba de/ rtsa dbu mar rlung sems chud pas mi rtog pas mtshams sbyar na spyi bor 'phos na lha mi'i go 'phang thob pa la dgongs pa yin/ mdor na 'chi khar 'pho ba byas pa pha rol du mi lus thob nas rgyu mthun gyi las kyis gsang sngags la longs spyod pa zhig tu 'ong*/ mtshams med kyi las 'bras snor bas des nad drag po la sogs pa 'byung*/ ji ltar gnas na sems kyi dag pa la gnas/ de ltar yang mgon po byams pa'i zhal nas/ tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni// sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas// gsungs// //byams pa dang snying rje sems can la skye bar 'dug pas sems can gang yang rung ba des/ rkyen byas pas bsod nams mnyam por thob bam/ yang na pha rol des mi thob zhus pas/ nga la sngon byang sha dor sems can la snying rje skyes pas sems can sdug bsngal bar gzigs pa la 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams bzhugs pa la 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal ba 'ong dgongs pa byung*/ rje rin po che la zhus pas de tsug 'ong ba yin/ de'i dus su snying rje rkyang par bzhag nas song ba yang yod pas/ snying rje phyag rgya chen po dang gnyis su med par go dgos/ de ltar yang snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med gsung*/ pha rol po des bsod nams mi 'thob/ rnal 'byor pa des lnga ldan la nyams su blangs na sangs rgyas pa'i dus su pha rol po de rang nyid kyi 'khor du 'ong*/

chos kyi thog ma'i bdud rtsi 'thung*/ rang nyid kyi rgyud smin pa dang grol bar byed/ snying rje rkyang pa la mnyam par bzhag na de rnams mi 'ong gsung*// //gong ma'i bzhed pa chos spyi'i babs/ rgyu de song la 'bras bu de 'byung yin pas/ rang nyid kyi rgyu song na sdug bsngal 'ong ba bde/ rang gi rgyu ma song na 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag la smin par shog ces pa ni/ bsam pa bzang po dge ba yin pa la/ gzhan gyi rgyu song ba'i 'bras bu rang la 'ong ba ma bde zhus pas/ 'di sngon mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ snying rje tsab tsub ni yod/ shes rab kyis ni ma zin pa'i smon lam btab tshul gyis da ltar bsnyung nad 'di lta bu byung gsung*/ 'di'i skabs su ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo'i gtam rgyud kyang gsung*/ de la rje rin po che'i zhal nas nged rang rnams kyis ni smon lam de ltar mi btab gsung nas/ sa bcad kyi dmigs pa lnga mdzad/ bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa yin nam min/ bsngo ba sems bskyed dang mthun nam mi mthun/ smon lam 'grub bam mi 'grub/ grub nas bzod dam mi bzod/ thabs gzhan yod dam med na yod pas/ rang gzhan gnyis ka bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i thabs tshul dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byed pa yin gsung*// //ting nge 'dzin la 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa la sogs pa mang po gsungs kyang 'dir tshul khrims la skye ba'i ting nge 'dzin mang po skye bar 'dug pas phyag rgya chen po go na lta ba dag pa yin nam zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin zhi gnas de dang ldan pa'i zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po ni/ lta ba dag par 'ong gsung*// //rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// mi ldog sems dpa' chen po yi// shes bya'i sgrib par gsungs pa dang*// zhus lan brgya rtsa mar chos sku'i snang bar gsungs 'dug pa ma bde zhus pas/

shes sgrib kyi snang bar gsungs pa de/ nang 'dzin pa 'di sems 'khor gsum gyi rtog pa yod pas de'i snang bas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la yul yul can du 'dzin pas shes sgrib tu 'ong ba yin/ chos skur snang na snang med shes rab ldan pa ro gcig chen po yin/ snang ba sna tshogs su gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ spros bral nam mkha'i dbus su ro gcig pa yin gsung*// //rmi lam du bla ma la chos zhus pa sad nas brjed par 'dug pas/ mi brjed pa'i thabs ji ltar byed zhus pas/ rmi lam du bla mas chos gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ sad pa'i snang ba la shes pa mi 'jug pa gnad zab/ nga la sngon rlung log byung ba la nyin par ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun rmi lam du drongs/ rmi lam gyi rgyun ting nge 'dzin la sad pa'i snang bas bar ma chod pas bsnyung nad kyang dwangs/ da lta dmigs pa la gnad du song na 'chi kar 'pho ba yang gnad du 'gro ba la tshegs med/ da ltar lte bar bla ma bsgom pa la gnad du song na/ 'pho ba'i dus su bla ma spyi bor bsgoms pa gnas spo ba dang 'dra ste/ snang ba phar bsgyur tshur bsgyur yin/ chos rje'i zhal nas deng sang nad drag pos btab pa'i dus su/ dmigs pa bsgom bcug pa 'di gcig pu'i drin yang khyed kyis nga la mi 'khor gsung*// //gsum ldan gyi skabs su snying rje'i sgo nas sems can gyi sdug bsngal gyi khur 'khur ba lugs gang lags zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyis sems can la phung po gsum du gzigs/ nges pa'i phung po la bsngags pa brjod/ ma nges pa'i phung po rjes su bzung*/ log pa'i phung po tshar bcad/ tshar ma bcad na blos spangs khur ma khur ba yin te/ gang phan byed pa ni/ khur khur ba yin te/ tha na skam la gnas pa'i sems can chur song na 'don pa la sogs pa sems can gyi don du 'gyur tshad bya gsung*/ sems las su rung ba dang*/ dge sbyor shes pa bkol du gtub pa gnyis la khyad ci yod zhus pas/

dge sbyor shes pa bkol du gtub na sems las su rung ba de yin/ sems las su rung ba la gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis yin/ gnas skabs spros bral yan chod la 'ong ba yin/ 'di'i skabs su rnam rtog bdud la khyed kyis bsrung ba gces bya ba la sogs pa'i lung yang gsung*/ mthar thug tu dul na rje btsun lta bu yin pas lus kyi sprul bsgyur la sogs pa bkod pa dpag tu med pa nus pa'i bla ma byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ slob ma mos gus kyi ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa gnyis kyi rten 'brel 'grig na slob mas bla ma'i sku'i bkod pa mthong ba yin/ 'di yi skabs su rje btsun gyi sku'i bkod pa gsang ba'i slob mas mthong ba'i gtam rgyud dang*/ sems nyid dul na cir yang bsgyur du btub pa'i lung yang gsung*// //sdom pa gsum chos skur rtogs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ spong sems brtan po la mnyam par bzhag pa gnyis la khyad ci yod zhus pas/ sdom pa gsum chos skur rtogs pa lta ba rnam par dag pa yin/ spyod pa rnam dag spong sems dang gnyis med du go ba ni zung 'jug zag med kyi tshul khrims yin/ de ltar ma go ba'i spong sems zag bcas yin gsungs// //spros bral rtogs pa la rjes shes phra'u skyes pas las gsog gam mi gsog zhus pas/ 'di la mi gsog par 'dod pa yang yod de/ las shin tu yang gsog de sgom pa byang chub grags kyis/ rje rin po che la zhus pa/ spros bral ba la rjes shes gsum du ldang ba de sgyu ma lta bu de rjes shes a 'thas su 'ong ba bde/ chos skur gsungs pa ma bde zhus pas/ chos sku yin yang snyam pa de la dgongs pa yin gsung*/ mgon po phag mo gru pas rje sgam po pa la zhus pas/ spros bral rjes shes gsum po gang bzang zhus pas sems kyi rtsa ba bsha' mar chod na khyad med gsung*// //spros bral ba'i rtogs pa yod pas/

bla ma de rang du rtogs na bye brag tu mos gus 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ rtogs pa dang bla ma gnyis med du go ba de la mnyam par bzhag pa de rang mos gus yin/ 'on kyang phrin las bsgrub pa'am/ rmi lam du chos zhu 'dod na mos gus dung dung pa dgos gsungs// // phyag rgya chen po mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su/ sgra skad cig ma grags pa skye med du 'ong sla/ gzugs snang stong du 'ong dka' bar 'dug zhus pas/ sgra skad cig ma yun thung bas sla bar 'dug pa yin/ sgra rgyun ma chad par yun ring du byung na dka' bar 'ong*/ gzugs kyang de dang 'dra ste khyod 'di nas slong thang yid la gyis dang*/ yid kyi gzugs skad cig ma yin pas/ snang stong du 'ong sla bas 'ong*/ gsha' mar go na khyad med rtog pa thams cad kyi gshis phyag rgya chen po yin pas babs de las mi 'da'/ 'di'i skabs su/ ji ltar gzugs ni sna tshogs dang*// mdog dang dbyibs ni tha dad pa// nam mkha'i dbyings las byung nas kyang*// de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur// bya ba'i lung yang gsung*// //de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgya khar chu bo naiñjā na'i 'gram du bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ mya ngan 'da' khar yang bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa de gnyug ma byams chen nam/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhag pa yin nam/ ji ltar lags zhus pas/ bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag dgos pa yin/ de 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin yang yin pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis dpag par mi nus pa yin/ rgyu mtshan byang chub kyi sems kyis khyad par du byas pa yin/ mnyam par bzhag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sprul bsgyur dang snang ba dang mi snang ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin yon tan phrin las thams cad bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin las skye ba yin/

gzhi yin gnas yin/ yon tan thams cad des bskyed pa yin pas/ mya ngan las 'da' kha yang mnyam par bzhag dgos pa yin gsungs// //grib 'ong ba 'di rang nyid la bag la nyal yod pa yin nam/ pha rol gyi grib des gos pa lags zhus pas/ grib can des rkyen byas nas slongs pa yin nam zhus pas/ 'di la rje rin po che la zhus pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems can gyi dus na lus ngag yid gsum/ lam nyams su len pa'i dus yi ge gsum gyis sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sku gsum du 'ong ba yin/ slob pa lam la zhugs pa'i dus su lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong bar byed pa de yin te/ rgyud pa'i dus su grib 'ong ba yin gsungs// //yang snang ba rang sems yin pas phyi rol gyi grib de yang nang gi dge sbyor de las mi gzhan par 'ong du gsha' zhus pas/ ci tsam rgyud dag pa bzhin du grib 'ong sla ba yin te/ dper na rnam shar dkar po la dri ma 'go sla ba bzhin du yin gsungs// //rtog pa phra bu skabs der 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ dgos gsung*// //'o na rje btsun chen po'i phyag mkhar la byin rlabs zhus pas shags kyis gsal/ phyag mkhar la rtog pa ni med lags na zhus pas/ da res slob dpon rdugs pa yin/ 'on kyang grib tshan che na sa rdo tshun spyad kyang 'gas pa yin gsungs// //spros bral gyi rtogs pa yod pa la 'khrul 'khor dang dus gnad ting nge 'dzin gsum gang gal che zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gal che/ dus gnad kyang ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'i tshe na yin la/ 'khrul 'khor yang ting nge 'dzin des dbang byas pa'i 'khrul 'khor du 'ong ba yin gsungs// //'od gsal ba ni thob par ma gyur tshe// dkyil mo krung 'di bshig par mi bya'o// zhes pas/ 'khrul 'khor gtso che na snyam nas zhus pas/ 'od gsal thob par 'dod pa'i sems de rang rin po che yin pas/ des dbang byas pa'i 'khrul 'khor du 'ong ba yin gsung*//

//sngags kyi bzhed kyis sems nang du gnas pas yon tan bskyed cing*/ mi gnas na nyes skyon bskyed par gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma yang phyi rol du mi dmigs par nang du bsgom par gsungs pa la/ chos nyan pa'i dus su bla ma phyi rol du dmigs dgos par byung ba ci tsug byed zhus pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ bla mas chos gsungs pa yang thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag nas gsungs pa yin/ des grib kyis kyang mi tshugs pa yin/ gdul bya rnams la yang snang ba rgya chen po 'ong ba yin/ slob mas chos nyan pa yang thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag nas chos nyan na chos go ba dang*/ phyi rol du chos gsungs pa dang*/ dge sbyor gnyis med du go nas 'ong*/ de ltar sems chos la gnas na gdams ngag go// blo drang por zhog la nga la nyon gsungs// //chos thams cad skad cig ma'i 'khor lo snang ba rang sems yin pas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dus su lus la gnas pa'i srog chags srin bu'i rigs rnams kyang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa yin nam zhus pas/ sngon rje rin po che la zhu zhing 'dug pa/ rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i dus su lus la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyang sangs rgyas pa yin ces pa la/ rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i dus su gdul byar 'ong gsung*/ re shig gi dus su gsang sngags su lus la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro mar gsungs 'dug pas sgom chen pa de grongs pa'i dus su spur zhag re tsam bzhag pa de mkha' 'gro ma rang gnas su dengs bcug pa yin gsungs// //gang zag dge ba'i bshes gnyen du shar ba la sogs pa bzhi po la skye tshul zhus pas/ 'di ngas rje rin po che la zhus pa las/ ngas khyod kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba sad par byas pa de gang zag dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char bar byas pa yin/ thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad dang nga 'bu'i gsung gnyis su med par go ba de gsung rab dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char ba yin/

snang ba sna tshogs su 'dug pa de/ rang nyid kyi dge sbyor nyid las mi gzhan zhing skye med du rtogs pa snang ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char ba yin/ rig pa de dang 'dra gsungs// //chos rje'i zhal nas da bar rje btsun nyid la seṅge la bcibs nas/ nam mkha' la byon pa gzigs pa la seṅge de bde ba'i stobs 'di tsam brjod mi nus pa gzigs gsungs pa dang*/ nga 'bu'i rnam sbyar 'di nyid thub pa 'di nyid mi zad pa'i 'phrin las dang bcas pa gzigs te/ nged kyi ltad mo de 'dra ba gsum mthong gsungs 'dug pa/ de shes bya la chags thogs med par gzigs pa yin nam/ ngo tir mos gus dgos pa yin nam zhus pas/ shes bya la chags thogs med pa yin/ rje btsun dang thub pa chen po la mos gus mdzad pas gzigs pa yin gsungs// //dben pa'i gnas su bla ma la mos gus skyes pa la/ dge sbyor la gnad du song nas bla ma yang yang dran na/ rten 'brel gyis bla mas kyang yang yang dgongs par 'ong ngam zhus pas/ 'di la ngas chos kyi lan yang btab/ bka' bkyon dgos par yang byung*/ yang yang dran pa gnad du ma song ba yin/ gnad du song na dge sbyor dang bla ma gnyis med du rtogs pas bla ma phyi rol du med par go nas 'gro 'dod kyi rtog pa zhi nas 'ong ba yin mod/ 'di'i skabs su/ rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma rnams// dbang du bsdud pa'i gdams ngag brjod// ces pa'i lung dang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas mgon po phag mo gru pa la mjal bzhed par byung ba la/ phag mo gru dang bcas pa lus la bsgoms pas gdung ba zhi bar byung gsungs// //yi dam sa bon las bskyed pa dang*/ brdzus skyes su bskyed pa gnyis la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ khyad med yi dam gang dang mjal ba'i las bsags pa de 'byon pa yin/ de ltar yang*/ me tog gang du lhung gyur cing*// bskal pa du mar bsgrubs gyur pa'i// las dang skal ba mthun pa yi// yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog

/gsungs// //phyi rol tu rin po che'i rigs yod pa de byang chub kyi sems las grub pas nang du byang chub kyi sems yod pa dang rgyud tshod mthon po'i lag tu 'ong ba gsungs pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i lag tu yang gser la sogs dol 'ong bar 'dug pa byang chub kyi sems dang mi ldan pas ma bde zhus pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lag tu 'ong ba yang byang chub sems dang rgyud tshod mthon po'i phyogs su rgyu rin po che song ba las byung bas na/ de yang sems byang chub kyi sems dang 'brel pa can du bde gsungs// //tshul khrims la ting nge 'dzin skye ba de rgyud tshod dma' ba la skye zhing*/ rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa rgyud tshod mthon po la skye snyam na zhus pas/ khyad med spong sems las skye ba de rgyud la skye ba'i tshul gyis ngos 'dzin sla ba yin/ rdzas sam grogs kyis ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa de ngos ma zin pa'i rtags yin/ rdzas kyi dngos po mngon du ma gyur na ma gyur/ gyur na gyur tshad kyis skyon bskyed pa'i rigs zhig dang*/ yon tan bskyed pa'i rigs zhig cis kyang yod pa yin gsungs// //kun brtags yongs grub gzhan dbang gsum rgyud la skye tshul gyi ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ bum pa skam po kun brtags/ mig skyon sbyang zhing sgrib g.yogs med pa yul rkyen/ bum pa byas pas gzhan dbang*/ bum pa grub pas yongs grub yin gsungs// //sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ khams gter lta bu 'byin pa'i lag pa yod gsung ba de gang lags zhus pas/ khams la gsum du gsung*/ sems can thams cad la gshis kyi yod pa gnas pa'i khams/ bla mas rkyen byas nas rtogs pa sad pa'i khams/ bsgoms nas skyon dag cing yon tan dang ldan pa ni rnam par smin pa'i khams su gsung*/ gter lta bu 'byin pa'i lag pa yod par gsungs pa de/ sa bcu'i mgon pos chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa de yin gsungs//

mgo byang du ston dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ g.yas pa rtog pa'i rtsa yin pas sa la phab pa dang*/ dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab de gling bzhi kun gyi byang na yod pa de/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gdan yin pas mgo byang du ston pa yin gsungs// //glo bur du gzer drag po byung nas/ sngon 'gro rnams sgom ma nus na dmigs pa rkyang pa bsgom pa yin nam zhus pas/ de'i dus sngon 'gro rnams 'bungs nas bsgom pa yin/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang na nad phan pa dang yon tan rdzogs pa dus mnyam du 'ong ba yin/ ma tshang na nad phan yang yon tan mi skye bas/ rje rin po ches dngos gzhi sab sob phal che la yod/ nga sbyor ba dang rjes la thugs rtsis cher mdzad pa yin gsung*/ nad kyi stobs ci tsam che ba tsam du bdag gi nad 'dis bya ba la sogs pa lam du btang ba dang sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnams la 'bung ba gnad zab gsungs// //dgyes mdzad nas/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// dngos po kun la khyab pa po// lus ni lus las ma skyes pa'o// gsungs pa'i 'bru gnon cig zhus pas/ ye shes chen po gnas pa de/ byang chub pa lnga las grub pa'i lus 'di la ye shes chen po ni bde stong gnyis su med par gnas/ de rtog pa thams cad las log par rtog pa med pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin pas rtog pa thams cad spong ba yin/ dngos po la khyab pa de bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spros pa'i mtha' brgyad kyis stong pa dang*/ dngos po thams cad kyang gshis mtha' brgyad kyis stong pas dngos po kun la khyab/ de lus la gnas kyang lus las skyes pa min/ lus kyi rtsol ba las byung ba ma yin gsungs// //lung ma bstan gyi ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ spyir lung ma bstan 'di go dka' ba yin/ gdul bya'i rgyud la kun 'byung nyon mongs pa'i sa bon yod/

de'i rkyen gyis sad pa dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang*/ lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'i sa bon yod/ dge ba'i rkyen byin na 'gog pa byang chub pa gsum mngon du byed/ de ltar rkyen sa bon gnyis po yod pa la rkyen gang gis kyang dbang ma byas pa'i skabs de tsam zhig lung ma bstan du 'ong gsungs// //nyon mongs skye ba la lam gtong min pa gzhan la 'grub na nus mthu ci tsam yod zhus pas/ lam gtong gis 'phel ba rgyun bcad pa yin/ khyod bum pa 'di la cig ltos dang*/ maṇ+ḍal yid la gyis dang*/ bum par 'dzin pa'i shes pa rgyun chad pa yin/ de dang 'dra gsungs// //bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa las kyi lhag ma gsung bar 'dug na/ sngon ded dpon thabs la mkhas pas mi nag mdung thung can bsad pa la zhe sdang gi 'dres yod pa yin nam ci lags zhus pas/ ded dpon la zhe sdang med/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos/ las de lta bu byed pa las ma bzlog na/ mi kho rang yang dmyal bar 'gro/ gru gang gi mi rnams kyang zhe sdang gis mtshams sbyar nas dmyal bar 'gro bar gzigs nas/ tshad med pa'i thugs rjes ma bzod nas/ mi de rnams las de lta bu la zhugs na ma legs kyi/ bdag gis mi nag bsad pa'i las 'bras myong yang bla snyam nas bsad pas/ bskal pa 'bum gyi 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar gsungs pa tshad med pa'i thugs rjes phyir bsnyil ba yin/ zhe sdang yod na 'khor ba phyir bsnyil ba shes bya la mi srid gsung*/ pha rol srog dang phral ba'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas nas kyang seng ldeng gi tshal pa byung ba ci yin snyam na/ rgyu song gi 'bras bu thabs mkhas pa'i phrin las yin/ seng ldeng gi tshal pa ma byung na mi de rnams zhe sdang gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las de las mi bzlog ste/ seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ sngon las 'di dang 'di lta bu byas pas/ da rung yang 'di lta bu byung gsungs pas/

mi de rnams de lta bu'i sems las log nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa spangs pa la 'di lta bu byung na/ bdag cag rnams la lta ci smos snyam pa la sogs pa yon tan skyes pa thabs mkhas pa'i phrin las su byung ba yin/ rgyu 'bras yin te/ sngon rgyu ma song na seng ldeng gi tshal pa bzhed kyang mi 'byung ba yin gsungs// //seng ldeng gi tshal pa ma zug pa'i bar gar gnas zhus pas/ byang chub kyi sems la gnas gsungs// //seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa de las kyi lhag mar gsungs pas/ lhag ma yin na des rdzogs pa yin nam zhus pas/ rdzogs pa ma yin/ byang chub kyi sems ma zad pas seng ldeng gi tshal pa mi zad/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can gyi don byed pa la mdzad pa'i mtha' med gsungs// //mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la dug tsher zug pa de rgyu ci lta bu song ba yin zhus pas/ rgyu 'di lta bu yin bya ba mi shes/ mdor na gang yin yang thabs mkhas pa'i phrin las su byung bas/ zhabs la dug tsher zug pas sku mtshal mang po byung nas lan cig grongs la nye ba'i dus su nye gnas kyis bos pas sad pa bzhin byung*/ de'i dus su snang gsum gyi 'char tshul dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs tshul thugs su chud pas/ rmi lam bar do rnams gsungs pa yin/ dug tsher ma zug na chos de rnams mi 'byon pa yin gsungs// //snang ba rang sems kyi dngos 'dzin zhus pas/ snang ba de phyi rol na med/ rang gi sems yin/ sems gang yod pa de'i snang ba 'ong ba yin/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa thol gyis skyes pa'i dus su sems de'i snang ba 'ong la/ skad cig ma phyi ma la byams pa'i sems skyes na/ des dbang byas pa'i snang bar 'ong ste/ snang ba la tshugs med pa yin gsungs// //gzhan gyis spyang kis lug bsad pa mthong na khyod kyang bsad par thal zer na zhus pas/ de kun byis pa'i rig pa yin/ lug bsad snyam pa de rang rang gi sems yin mod/

rjes su yi rang skyes na rnam smin 'ong gsung*// //chos rje bla ma ldum la bla ma rin po ches snang ba rang sems su bzhed lags sam zhus pas/ de yin mod gsung*// //'o na thub pa chen po byang chub kyi shing la sku rgyab brten nas sangs rgyas pa la/ shing da rung shul na ke re 'dug na zhus pas/ khyod la de'i gnyer ka med/ de'i dus su shing ker re 'dug snyam pa de khyod rang gi sems yin mod/ ngas bla mar 'dzin pa yin te gsungs// //bla ma'i grogs po la sogs pa la sngar byams pa skyes pa la phyis zhe sdang skye ba'i skabs yod dam zhus pas/ sngar byams pa skyes pa la phyis zhe sdang skye ba'i skabs shin tu yod/ 'byung nye ring du byas na bla ma la skye ba 'byung ring*/ nga 'dir ja nur gsol ba'i steng du slob ma zhig byung na de la ma byin cing bka' bkyon nas btang yang zhe sdang mi skye/ grogs po sngar zas lan yod pa zhig byung ba la de ltar byas na zhe sdang skye ba 'byung ste gsungs// //sngar byams pa skyes pa la phyis zhe sdang skyes pa dang*/ sngar byams pa ma skyes pa la phyis zhe sdang ma skyes pa gnyis la/ rnam smin che chung yod dam zhus pas/ spyir byas pa shes shing byas pa drin du gzo ba la byams pa skye bar gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma drin che ba la zhe sdang skyes na rnam smin che/ mtshams med kyi las yin/ drin med pa la sngar byams pa skyes kyang*/ phyis zhe sdang skyes pa rang sems can gzhan la skyes pa gnyis la khyad med gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po la khyad med na/ 'khrul 'khor gsum la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ ngo bo la khyad med kyang 'khrul 'khor la khyad yod/ bla ma dang 'dra ba zhig la dga' ba yod na/ slob ma rnams kyang bla ma'i rnam thar 'dzin par 'ong*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis seṅge'i nyal stabs ma mdzad na/ deng sang rjes su zhugs pa mi 'ong ste/ mdzad pa phrin las che ba yin gsungs// //nyi zla gzas bzung ba'i dus su/

nang du rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel ji ltar 'grigs pa yin zhus pas/ lus can rnams nyi zla sgra gcan lus la gnas pa de rten 'brel phyogs gcig tu 'grigs pas/ phyi rol du yang nyi zla gzas 'dzin pa yin gsungs// //nyams su len pa'i dus su bdud bzhi po 'byung ba de rtsa ba nyon mongs pa'i bdud yod pas gsum po de las 'byung ba yin nam/ 'on te so sor 'byung ba yin nam/ nyon mongs pa choms na gsum po yang choms par yin nam zhus pas/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud yod pas gsum po 'byung ba yin te/ 'dod chags skyes na nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ 'dod chags las grub pa'i nad kyis lus sems 'khrug pa phung po'i bdud/ 'dod chags de dang bdag gcig pa'i bud med kyis 'dzum pa dgod pa la sogs pa byed cing*/ nyon mongs pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i grogs byed pa ni lha'i bu'i bdud/ ma chags pa'i srog gcod par byed pa 'chi bdag gi bdud yin pas/ gnyen po'i stobs kyis rtsa ba nyon mongs pa'i bdud choms na gsum po yang choms pa yin gsungs// //rtog pa skad cig ma la bdud bzhi tshang lugs kyi ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ skad cig la mtshon pa la zhe sdang thol gyis skyes pa nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ lus sems 'khrug pa phung po'i bdud/ rkyen las skyes pa lha'i bu'i bdud/ byams pa'i srog gcod pa 'chi bdag gi bdud yin gsungs// //dngos po dag pa zhig yod na/ mi phod bzhin du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la 'bul ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yod pa zhig la 'phangs sems med par rang yan chod pa bla ma dang*/ zhing mi dag pa gcig la phul na gnyis po la khyad ci yod zhus pas/ 'di'i dus su bsam pas zhing bsgrub pa dang*/ zhing gis bsam pa bsgrub pa gnyis yin/ rgyud tshod dma' ba la ni zhing gal che/ 'di'i skabs su rab gnas mkhan pos yon bdag gi bsam pa bcos lugs dang*/ phag smad kyis mchod rten la drud pas rdzab kyis ser ka bsrubs lugs dang*/

rgyu des phyis mi lus thob nas mchod rten bya rung kha shor nas bsam yas kyi bar du dpag tu med pa'i gtam rgyud kyang gsung*/ mdor na bla ma tsam ni zhing mi dag pa la 'phangs pa med par phul yang dngos po des ci 'grub mi shes/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i phyogs su dngos po khab skud tsam zhig song yang*/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i phrin las su 'byung ba yin/ rgyud tshod mthon po la dngos po gal che/ dngos po rnam dag yod na bsam pa rnam dag rang la yod pas/ zhing rnam dag bsgrub pas chog ste/ jo bo rjes khyi la zan kham cig ster yang*/ dbu cog cog lan gsum mdzad nas ster ba yin pas/ jo bo theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor par bzhugs pas khyi de lhag pa'i lhar bsgrub pa yin gsung*// //byams chags gnyis rgyud la skye tshul ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ 'ga' zhig gis byams chags gnyis rgyud la skye tshul gcig yul mi bsgyur bar 'dod/ byams chags gnyis rgyud la skye tshul mi gcig /ma la chags pa skye ba'i skabs kyang yod la/ shag mo la byams pa skye ba'i skabs kyang yod de/ byams pa dge ba zang yag yin/ chags pas bde 'gro mi thob ste/ thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed// gsungs// //rang man chod la snying rje'i sgo nas dngos po byin pa dang*/ yi dam du bskyed nas phul ba gnyis la khyad ci yod zhus pas/ khyad che snying rje gang sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa zhig zhing chos can du yod pa la skye ba yin/ de la byin pa dang*/ zhing bsam dngos gsum gyi rten 'brel 'grig nas/ yi dam la phul ba gnyis phrin las yang mi mnyam gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po rmi lam lta bur gsungs pa ci lags sam zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po gtsang ba rtag pa bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ sgyu ma mi rtag pa 'dus byas rkyen las skyes pa 'jig pa'i chos can yin/

de ltar yang*/ skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang*// rmi lam sprin dang glog lta bu// 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar lta// gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po rgyus ma bskyed cing rkyen gyis mi 'jig pa yin/ de ltar yang mgon po byams pa'i zhal nas/ ji ltar nam mkha' me nyid kyis// sngan chad nam yang tshig pa med// de bzhin 'di ni skye ba dang*// rga dang na ba'i mes mi 'tshig /gsung*/ sgyu ma lta bur gsungs pa de rten 'brel tshogs pa las grub pa 'jig tu yod pa la dgongs pas sgyu ma dper gsungs pa yin gsungs// //nam mkha' la dkyil krung bcas nas g.yang la lhung dogs kyi 'jigs pa dang bcas pas song ba rmis pa'i dus su/ rlung sems gar gnas pa yin zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas skyon tsam la mi 'jigs/ yon tan la 'jigs gsung*/ 'ga' zhig gis 'di la yon tan du 'dod de/ 'bo ra se der 'gro ba rtsar yod pas/ de'i dus su rlung stod du 'tshangs pa yin pas/ sum khrid kyi dmigs pa bsgom pa yin gsungs// //sangs rgyas pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba sgrub cing mi dge ba spong ba yin la/ nyan thos kyi tshul khrims la sogs pa yon tan rnams kyang dge ba sgrub cing*/ mi dge ba spong ba yin pa la/ gtan sangs mi rgya ba ma bde zhus pas/ nyan thos su yod ring la gtan sangs mi rgya/ sems bskyed nas sangs rgya ste/ nyan thos sems bskyed ma thag tu sa lnga pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ba de sangs rgya ba yin/ nyan thos rang sangs rgya ba min gsungs// //'khor 'das kyi bde skyid thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las 'byung bar gsungs pa la/ log lta can gtan mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsungs 'dug pa/ log lta can yang 'khor 'das kyi sems su tshud na/ 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las 'byung ba de/ kho'i rgyud la gar ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsungs pa de/

log lta dang ldan ring la gtan mya ngan las mi 'da' ba yin/ log lta de'i las zad/ dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bag chags shes rgyud la yod pa sad nas lam la zhugs na sangs rgya ste/ de'i dus su log lta can min/ 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid tha na dmyal ba'i gnas su tsha ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba'i tshe/ rlung ser bu bsil tsam byung bas bde ba cung zad nyams su myong ba de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i byin rlabs yin/ nam zhig de la skyon du blta zhing*/ de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i sems skyes na/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i byin rlabs yin/ de ltar yang gal te sangs rgyas khams med na// sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*// mya ngan 'das la 'dun pa dang*// don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur// gsung*/ dben pa'i gnas su nyon mongs pa spong byed kyi gnyen po bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa skye ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ shing skam po mes gdungs pas brlan gnas sa ma byung bas phyir 'don pa dang 'dra ste/ spong byed kyi gnyen po la gnad du song nas/ nyon mongs pa bag la nyal du yod pa de slongs pa yin/ de'i dus su mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla mas zin cing*/ lnga ldan gyi nyams su blangs pa dang*/ rang nyid bsgrub bya don gyi snying po de yin gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po dang bla ma gnyis med du rtogs na/ bla ma chos skur rtogs pa yin nam zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po rtag chad kyis stong pa de dang bla ma gnyis med du rtogs na/ bla ma'i dus kyi mtha' chos skur rtogs pa yin gsung*// //bla ma la sku gsum gyi mthong tshul gyi zhabs tog byed pa la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mthong ba longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'byung*/ sprul pa'i skur mthong na gzhan don 'byung*/ chos skur rtogs na bla ma'i dus mtha' rtogs pa dang khyad che gsungs//

//lnga ldan bsgom pa'i dus su yi dam dran tsam gyis chog gam zhus pas/ gsal bar sgom pa gsal na 'phro mi gzhag gsung*// //bshags pa byed pa'i dus su yi dam sgom nas bshags pa dang*/ ma sgom nas bshags pa gnyis la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ khyad yod yi dam sgom nas bshags pa la gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang ldan dgos/ dam tshig gsang sngags su dbang bskur nas bya ba dang byed pa thams cad yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar byed pa dam tshig yin pas/ de ltar bsgoms nas bshags pa byed pa yin/ yi dam la cang bshags rgyu yod dam snyam na/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab rgyu cang yod dam gsungs// //rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang gnyug ma byams chen gyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis gcig lags sam zhus pas gcig gsungs// //'khrul pas 'khrul pa 'grub pa lags sam mi 'grub pa lags zhus pas/ 'khrul pa'i las 'bras 'khrul pa yin/ mi 'grub na chos thams cad bdag med pas bdag tu 'khrul bas khams gsum gyi 'khor ba mi 'grub par 'gyur gsungs// //rnam rtog phra ba'i phra ba la bdud chen po'i chen po 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ rtogs pa yod pa'i rtog pa phra ba yin/ rtogs pa med pa'i rtog pa rags pa yin/ spros bral gyi rtogs pa yod pa mi rtog pa rjes shes su 'byung bas phra ba yin/ spros bral bas las kyi sgrib pa spangs pa yin/ sa bdun pa man chod rtogs pas nyon mongs pa spong ba yin/ sa brgyad pa yan chod du dgu pa bcu pa la shes par bya ba'i yul thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la sgrib pa'i rtog pa phra ba'i phra ba yod pa la/ bdud chung ngus bar du gcod mi nus pas tshangs pa la sogs pa shin tu stobs dang ldan pa'i bar chad 'byung*/ rtog pa phra'u de nyid kyi srog chad na 'jig rten gyi srog chad pas/ khong gi yul las 'das snyam na bdud chen po'i chen po tshangs pa la sogs pa rnams kyi bar chad 'byung ba de gang gis 'joms na rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'joms pa yin gsungs//

//gshin bsngo byed pa'i dus su gshin po dge ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin nam/ dge ba gshin po'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin zhus pas/ gshin po dge ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa yang yod de shi bar ma shes shing*/ shul du 'dug pa rnams kyis dge ba byed pa la/ kho yang stong grogs byed pa'i snang ba 'byung ba ni/ gshin po dge ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ shi bar shes nas gshin po dge ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa min/ dge ba gshin po'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ shul na 'dug pas kho'i don du dge ba byas pas kho'i shes rgyud la mi dge ba'i sa bon yod pa bag la nyal dge ba'i las sad nas bsam pa bzang po'i 'bras bu 'grub pa yin gsungs// //dben pa'i gnas su bsgom pa'i dus su grib gnon 'ong ba 'dug pa de rtsa rlung gi byed pa lags sam/ gzhi bdag la sogs pa'i grib gnon 'ong ba lags zhus pas/ gzhi bdag ma lags par gda'/ de 'dra ba byung ba'i dus su rlung sems stod du 'tshangs pa yin pas/ lag pa yang cis kyang snying gar zug nas yod pa yin/ rin po che dbye chung na thugs dam mdzad pa'i dus su/ skyo bsangs la phyin pa'i sar ba lang sug po gyen la bstan pa mang po byung nas sku lus la thim pa'i snang ba byung ba/ 'khrul 'khor gan rkyal du gzims pa'i rkyen yin par mkhyen nas bzhugs pas ma byung*/ de 'dra ba mi 'ong ba la sum khrid kyi dmigs pa lus phyir la bsring ba gnad zab gsungs// //sdom pa gsum gnad gcig tshul phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid dang sbyar ba'i ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa gzhan gnod bzhi dang bcas pa las log pa yin/ gang gis gnod na mi dge ba bcu byas na rang la gnod gzhan la gnod pas mi dge ba bcu spang zhing*/ dge ba bcu bsgrub pa ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ de'i steng du phan 'dogs pa'i bsam pas dge bcu sems can gyi don du byed pa ni/

dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yin la/ gsang sngags su dbang bskur nas kyang dam tshig dang ldan dgos te/ rdo rje sku'i dam tshig gi lus kyi sgo nas srog mi gcod/ ma byin par mi blang*/ mi tshangs par mi spyad/ rdo rje gsung gi dam tshig gis ngag gi sgo nas rdzun dang phra ma ngag 'khyal tshig rtsub spang*/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gis yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba spong ba yin pas/ de ltar gsum po dge ba sgrub cing mi dge ba spong ba phyi'i gnad gcig de ltar gsum po nyams su blangs pas nang du ting nge 'dzin skye bar byed pa'i thabs gcig pas nang gi gnad gcig nang du ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing dbang po yul gyi rjes su ma 'brangs pas/ gsang sngags kyi yon tan ma lus pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs yin pas gsang ba'i gnad gcig rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs par byed pa'i thabs su gcig pas/ de kho na nyid kyi gnad gcig pa yin gsungs// //dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnad du bsnun dgos pa bzhin du phyag rgya chen po la yun ring du gnas na de gnad du bsnun dgos sam zhus pas/ de ltar gnas na sa lam thams cad des bgrod pa yin/ bsgrub bya yin pas mi gnas pa la gnas pa/ gnas pa brtan pa/ brtan pa gong nas gong du bogs 'don pa'i thabs la 'bad gsungs// //kun gzhi la dge ba'i rtog pa skye ba'i tshe na/ mi dge ba'i rtog pa ji ltar gnas zhus pas/ gcig skye ba'i tshe na gcig bag la nyal du gnas pa yin gsungs// //rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin lnga la sbyin pa btang bas phyis lnga sde bzang po byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ rten 'brel gsum tshogs kyi rgyu btang ba yin/ khyed cag 'di la rab tu dga' bar gyis la gsungs pa'i tshig snyan pas/ sku lus kyi sha khrag gis tshim par byas pa sbyin pa/

gtan khrims la sogs pa ni don spyod pa/ gshis rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa don mthun pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu btang cing*/ smon lam btab pas thog ma'i 'khor du byung zhing chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thungs pa yin gsungs// //pha rol tu phyin par lus mi gtsang ba/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ gsang sngags su lus lhar bsgom pa gnyis la/ yon tan gyi bskyed tshul khyad ci yod zhus pas/ mi gtsang bar dran pa nye bar bzhag pas kyang*/ tha mal gyi lus la chags zhen spong ba yin/ lhar bsgoms pas kyang tha mal gyi lus la chags zhen dang bcas pa ldog pa yin pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ lhar bsgom pa gnyis ka dbang po yul gyi rjes su mi 'brang bar nang du chags pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'i thabs yin pas/ de'i ngos nas yon tan bskyed tshul gcig pa dang*/ gnyis ka lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs pa'i thabs yin/ de ltar yang*/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsungs// de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag zhi bar 'dod pas shes rab bskyed// gsungs// //dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis/ sa brgyad thob par bzhed pa la/ 'dir sgrib gsum spangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ gnyis med gcig tu gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i yi dam gyi lha gdod ma nas yin pa la yin par ma shes shing*/ yongs grub kun btags kyi spros pas stong pa'i sku de sangs rgyas kyi sku yin la/ thugs gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba chos kyi sku yin pas/ sa brgyad thob pa mtshar rgyu med gsungs// //sngon gyi dus su rgyu 'bras myur ba ltar 'dug la/ deng sang mi myur bar 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ zhing bsam dngos gsum gyi rten 'brel 'grig na rgyu 'bras myur ba yin/ yid ches skyes ma skyes min pa sngon dang deng sang la khyad med/

go sla ba'i dbang du byas na khyod kyis tshig snyan pa smras na/ lan du'ang snyan pa 'ong la mi snyan pa smras na lan du mi snyan pa 'ong ba de rgyu 'bras yin gsungs// //bsnyen gnas kyi skabs su rtsa ba bzhi yan lag tu 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ lus po yongs su grub pa la yan lag nas rim gyis lus po grub pa dang 'dra ste/ srog gcod pa spong ba'i yan lag nas bzung ste/ yan lag brgyad po tshang ba'i dus su rtsa bar 'ong ba yin gsungs// //khrid kyi rim pa gcig gi nang du thams cad 'dus par nyams su len nyan lags sam zhus pas/ shin tu nyan/ khrid kyi rim pa thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig yin/ cig la mtshon na gtum mo bsgoms pas dbang po yul gyi rjes su ma 'brangs pas/ rlung nang du log rtsa kha bye/ lus bde ba'i stobs rgyas pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ bde ba la brten nas ting nge 'dzin skye ba lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin la brten nas shes rab skye ba lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yin gsungs// //dben pa'i gnas ngo mtshar mtshar bar phyin nas/ der yun ring du gnas par 'dod na/ de'i thabs ji ltar bya zhus pas/ yun ring du gnas par 'dod na chags pa yin pas/ de lta bus phyin na chags zhen med par bla ma dkon mchog la 'bul ba yin/ de ltar yang mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ sdod sa chu yi gru dang 'dra ste gtan pa'i blo yang spang gsungs// //nang du rtsa rlung gi byed pas phyi rol du sa rdo gser du mthong na/ de mi 'gyur ba'i thabs ci zhig byed zhus pas/ de'i dus su ltos pa med par bla ma dang dkon mchog la 'bul ba yin gsungs// //bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba la dga' ba skye bar 'dug pas lnga ldan gyis gnad du bsnun 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ dga' ba skyes pa la 'dres yod pas lnga ldan gyi gnad du bsnun dgos gsungs//

//gtum mo bsgom pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs pas bde ba bskyed pa dang*/ rdzas kyi rnam pa la sogs pas bskyed pa gnyis la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ bde ba bskyed pa dang gnad du bsnun dgos pa'i ngos nas khyad med la/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas skye ba sbyor bas khyad par du byas pa yin gsungs// //dge mi dge skad cig ma'i 'khor lor gsungs pas/ 'dren pa'i las gar ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ ngas khyed rnams la chos bstan pas smin cing grol bar byed pa yin te/ khyed rnams la chags na de tsam zhig 'dren ma bde gsungs// //bcom ldan 'das kyis srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs ye shes kyi mes shes bya'i bud shing bsregs te/ de ni gsum yin nam gcig la mnyam par bzhag pa yin zhus pas/ srod la bdud btul ba de gnyug ma byams chen gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis btul ba yin/ 'jing la mnyam par bzhag pa de nyid kyi rgyun bsrings pa yin la/ tho rangs de nyid stobs su gyur pa'i ye shes kyi mes shes bya'i bud shing bsregs pa yin gsungs// //rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod pa'i rtogs pa de gang lags zhus pas/ sa dang po chos nyid kyi bden pa yin te/ de nyid kyi rgyun bsrings pas sa lam thams cad bgrod pa de yin te/ dper na tshes gsum zla ba nar son pa nya rgyas pa dang 'dra gsungs// //sems stong pa nyid du rtogs pa la snang ba de ltar du ma rtogs na gnyis med du rtogs pa'i thabs gang lags zhus pas/ de ltar snang stong zung 'jug tu rtogs pa la gong gi mnyam bzhag der rgyun bsring ba yin gsungs// //sangs rgyas kyi 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ sku skye ba sna tshogs su ston dgos pa la/ sems stong par rtogs pas skye ba mi len par 'dod pa de chad ltar mchi'am zhus pas/ de chad ltar mchi/ rtag chad kyis stong pa kho nas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel du 'byung bas skye ba len pa yin gsungs//
