//sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa'i ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ bla ma mi thub rdo skas la yar byung ba la rnal 'byor pa zhig byung snyam ste/ kho jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom zhing yod pas lus ngag yid gsum jo bo'i rang gzugs su yod pas na/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs de yin gsung*/ go sla ba'i dbang du byas na bar dor pho mo chags pa spyod pa mthong na/ chags sdang mig ser mi bskyed cing*/ nga dge slong yin mig gis kyang ltar mi 'os snyam pa'i spong sems de sdom pa'i ngo bo yin gsung*// //dag pa'i sems gsum gyis mnyam pa nyid kyi rtogs tshul gyi ngos 'dzin re re zhu zhus pas/ sa brgyad kyi byang chub sems dpa' lus mngon du gyur/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas skyes pa'ang skye med du bzod la/ ma skyes pa'ang skye ba med pa chos kyi skur rtogs pas sangs rgyas dkon mchog mngon du gyur/ dgu pas ngag ā li kā li mngon du gyur pas so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi mngon du gyur/ me la mtshon na mer nges pa nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa/ reg bya tsha zhing me'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa chos so so yang dag par rig pa/ bsreg pa la sogs pa me'i las 'grub pa don so so yang dag par rig pa/ me'i mtshan nyid gzhan la smra bar nus shing zhum pa med pa/ skye ba'i rgyu gnas pa'i gzhi 'jig pa'i rkyen shes nas/ skye ba'i rgyu bsgrub pa la mkhas/ gnas pa'i gzhi bsten pa la mkhas/ 'jig pa'i rkyen la mkhas pa ni/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa/ bcu pas yid mngon du gyur te/ 'khor dul ba mtha' yas pa la dbang gsungs// //dge slong nag po la bram ze'i bu mo ma dad pas bya rog zhar ma 'dra byas pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar bya rog zhar mar skyes pa'i rkyen/ dge slong gis byas pas dge slong la nyes pa zhig yod lags sam zhus pas/

gzhan ma dad pa'i nyes pa yod pas/ dge slong gi byin len gyi bcas pa'i gzhi mdzad pa yin gsungs// //yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ log pa'i lta ba gnyis yin pa la/ mu stegs byed pa la yang 'tshe ba spong ba yod pa de ji ltar mchi zhus pas/ sems can la 'tshe ba spangs pa'i lta ba thob kyang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ de nyid thob par byed pa'i thabs chos la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ thabs de nyid bsgrub pa'i grogs dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba ni lta ba rnam par dag pa/ de las bzlog pa mu stegs pa/ skyabs gnas phyin ci log tu bzung ba des sems can la 'tshe na spang ba yang dge tsam yin/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin te/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa mi dran zhing*/ zas gos gcig pu don du gnyer bas mu stegs byed de/ 'tshe ba spangs pas sangs rgya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin gsungs// //rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang rang 'grig tu byung ba gnyis la rgyu 'bras myur mi myur yod dam zhus pas/ rang 'grig tu byung ba mthong chos myur ba yin/ bsgrigs pa gnad zab ste/ rgyu gang song ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba yin pas/ rang 'grig mi sgug gsungs// //ro gcig gi rtogs pa yod pa bar do dang po'i 'od gsal ngos zin nas bsgom med du na 'pho ba la sgrib pa de gar ngos 'dzin spong tshul ji lta bu lags zhus pas/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa yod kyang bar dor cis kyang snang ba gsum 'ong ste/ bar do dang po'i gsal dwangs gnyis med du rtogs pa'i tshe sgrib pa der spang ba yin/ 'od gsal gnyis po dbyer mi phyed/ gzugs sku gnyis kyi snang ba 'ong gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po dang bskyed rim zung 'jug tu go na rjes shes mchi'am zhus pas/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug snang ba rang bzhin med par go ba mnyam gzhag ltar 'dzin pa dang bcas pa rjes shes yin gsungs// //rmi lam du bla ma grogs por yang 'ong*/

bud med du yang 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ rmi lam du bla ma sna tshogs su byung na mos gus la ltem brkyang byung ba'i rtags yin/ na chung rgyan can du byung na/ tshul khrims kyis bsgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i rtags yin pa dang*/ bla ma chags pa'i yul ma yin pas/ na chung la chags pa mi skye bas skyon med/ bud med rgan pa skra zings/ lus la rgyan med pa yugs sa mo la sogs pa rmi lam du byung na dam tshig la chag nyams byung ba'i rtags yin pas/ bshags bsdam la sogs pa dam tshig sor chud pa'i thabs bya gsungs// //sems can thams cad ma yin du 'dra ba la gang chung ba la byams pa skye bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ chung ngu'i dus su dga' bde'i cha shas che ba dang*/ rtog pa rags pa mi skye bas/ byams pa skye ba sla ba yin gsungs// //sa bcu'i mgon po sangs rgya khar bdud dmag 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ 'khor gsum gyi rtog pa yod pas bdud kyi 'jug sgo byung ba yin/ bar du gcod ma nus pa dang*/ che ba bton pas 'jig rten na rtsod pa med par sangs rgyas pa yin gsungs// //sa bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrin las mnyam pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ sa bcu pas gang la gang 'dul de la de ston gyi chos gsung nus pa dang*/ 'khor dul ba mtha' yas mnga' ba'i ngos nas mnyam par gsungs pa yin/ mtha' med du mi mnyam pas 'dul ba la bslab gzhi bca' ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams pa'i zhal nas/ de lta mod kyi sa rdul dang*// rgya mtsho ba lang rmig rjes chu// khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i khyad de nyid// gsungs// //sems can la nang du nyi zla yod pas phyi rol du nyi zla byung ba la/ nyi ma 'phel 'grib med cing*/ zla ba 'phel 'grib yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ nyi ma shes rab yin pas 'phel 'grib med pa yin/

zla ba thabs yin pas 'phel 'grib dang bcas pa yin gsungs// //nyon mongs pa cha mnyam gyi ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ nyon mongs cha mnyam 'dzin pa yin/ gnyen po cha mnyam yul phyi la 'dzin pa yin gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims gnad gcig par bzhed pa la/ 'dir zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims gnyis phyag rgya chen po dang gnad gcig tshul gyis ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims phyag rgya chen po yin/ de ltar yang*/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dgos pa ni// don dam rtogs pa yin zhes gsungs// des na rab tu byung ba rnams// rtogs pa don dam rtogs par mdzod// ces pa dang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po stong pa sus bsgoms pa// tshul khrims dag pa'i 'go la de 'dug ste// zhes pa'i lung yang gsung*/ yang gnyen po drag po bsgoms nas spang bya la sdang zhing gnyen po la chags shing yul yul can gyi 'dzin pas tshul khrims bsrung ba ni/ zag pa dang bcas pa yin la/ gshis phyag rgya chen po yin te/ de ltar ma rtogs gsungs// //rdo rje ting 'dzin rgya mtsho 'khrugs kyi ting nge 'dzin de/ sangs rgyas nyag cig min pas ma rtogs pa lags sam zhus pas/ 'di la gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis yin/ mthar thug rtogs pa sangs rgyas nyag cig yin/ gnas skabs su rtogs pa sa brgyad pa yan chod dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas rtogs pa yin te mtha' med du mi mnyam gsungs// //sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi gtso bo phan sems can du 'byon pa'i dus su/ rang nyid sangs rgyas yin pa mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ lam nyams su len pa'i dus su/ rgyu song ba'i 'bras bu yin pa dang*/ yul de'i sgrib pa yin pa dang*/ phrin las rgyun chad med pa sku'i gsang ba yin gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bshags pa byed pa dang*/ 'gyod sems kyis byed pa gnyis la sgrib pa dag pa snga phyi yod dam zhus pas/

khyad yod 'gyod sems drag pos bshags na 'phel ba rgyun bcad/ sgyu ma lta bur bshags pa byas na rtag par 'dzin pa spong*/ phyag rgya chen pos bshags pa byas na nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin shes pas rtag chad du 'dzin pa dag ste/ 'di la lan cig the tshom skyes pas kyang*/ srid pa hrul por btang ba yin gsungs// //bde ba can du skye bar 'dod pas rang nyid dge sbyor 'phel ba'i ting nge 'dzin stobs kyis smon lam btab pa dang*/ zhing rnam dag gi mdun du smon lam btab pa gnyis la khyad mchis sam zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang ldan pa'i dus su smon lam btab pa gnad zab/ lar der skye ba la rgyu phun sum tshogs pa dgos te/ snang ba mtha' yas la gus pa dang ldan zhing gsol ba 'debs pa dang der skye ba'i las bsags pa dang*/ zhing rnam dag gi mdun du smon lam btab pa'i phun sum tshogs pa song na/ sgyogs dang sgyogs kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhin du/ zhing der cis kyang skye ba yin gsungs// //byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs dang dper na shan pa'am smad 'tshong mas byas na de grogs po dge 'dun du 'ong ngam zhus pas/ dge ba la 'dun pa dge 'dun yin pa dang*/ rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba sad par byed pa'i mgon por byung na grogs kyi mi tshad bla ma dam pa yin gsungs// //snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems su rtogs nas tshogs gsog byed na/ zhing bsam dngos gsum rten 'brel bsgrig 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ 'di la gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis yin/ mthar thug tu thugs su chud pa sangs rgyas nyag cig yin pas/ sems las las/ las la las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ma 'dres par mkhyen pas/ sems can gyi rgyud la kun 'byung nyon mongs pa yod pas skye ba'i rgyu/ gnas pa'i gzhi/ 'jig pa'i rkyen mkhyen nas 'dul bar bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyag cig gi spyod yul yin/ gnas skabs su rtog pa dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/

bsam pa rnam dag byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pa'i dngos po rnam dag de zhing rnam dag bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phul zhing*/ zhing bsam dngos gsum gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pas mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'ong gsungs// //tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas// gsungs pa'i gnas tshul ji ltar lags zhus pas/ gser la g.ya' chags kyang gser gyi gshis la 'gyur ba med la/ gser mkhan mkhas pas gser gyi g.ya' phyis nas rin chen zhun mas gsung rab bzhengs nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod gnas su 'gyur ba bzhin du/ sems kyi gshis gdod ma nas dag pa la ma dag pa'i skabs spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med la/ bla ma mkhas pa'i gdam ngag gis glo bur gyi dri ma dag par byas nas/ dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med pa chos kyi sku yin gsungs// //gnas byin rlabs che ba'i gnyan pa de rten gyi gang zag gi byed pa yin nam/ phyi rol du yod pa yin zhus pas/ phyi rol du gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa yod par gsungs/ rten gyi gang zag gi byed pa yin te/ rje btsun mi la la phyir byon pas rje btsun gyi byin rlabs kyis/ gnas de byin rlabs can du byung ba dang*/ rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas pas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis mchod gnas su byung ba dang*/ mdor na gnas gang yang rung ba de/ rten gyi gang zag de'i bsam pas dbang byas pa'i gnas su 'ong ba yin gsungs// //snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems su go bas/ tshogs mchod byed na cho ga zhib mo byed pa dang*/ gshis kyi gnas lugs go bas cho ga zhib mo ma byas pa gnyis la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ khyad yod de lta bur go yang cho ga zhib mo byed dgos/ ci 'dra ba'i las byas pas/ de 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba yin gsungs//

//dge ba mi dge bar mi 'gyur/ mi dge ba dge bar mi 'gyur bar gsungs pa la/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus kyi slob pa lam la zhugs pa'i dus kyi rtog pa mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ sems can gyi rgyud la dge mi dge'i bag chags kyi sa bon nus pa'i mthu ldan du yod pa de slob pa lam la zhugs nas bden pa'i don mthong ba'i dus su dge mi dge gang rung gi rkyen byin pas bag la nyal slongs pa de lam du btang*/ sems bskyed lnga ldan gyi nyams su blangs pas sangs rgyas pa'i dus na rgyu 'bras rigs mi 'dor zhing ma 'dres pa'am mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo 'ong bas/ ded dpon gyis mdung bsnun pa'i rgyu 'bras zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pa byung ba yin/ rigs 'dor na dbu'i gtsug gtor na 'ong dgos gsungs// //dkon mchog brtsegs par sems 'khor ba ma yin lus 'khor ba yin par gsungs pa la bde sdug thams cad sems kyis myong bar 'dug snyam na zhus pas/ stong pa nyid la gzugs su 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi lus de 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ mdor na bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin gsungs// //lam nyams su blang ba'i dus su lus lhar bsgom pa la rgyan gyi rnam pa gcig ma gsal yang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la shor ke 'byung bar gsungs par 'dug pa de ci tsug lags zhus pas/ de kho na lags/ lam nyams su len pa'i dus su rgyu phun sum tshogs pa btang bas/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'byung ba yin gsungs// //lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs nas brjod du med par gsungs pa la/ rje sgam po pa sngon pad+ma'i bla mar sangs rgyas pa/ thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa de/ 'dir rje btsun dang mjal nas gnyal gyi se ba lung du gzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong gsungs pa ma bde zhus pas/

lam nyams su len pa'i dus su rtog pa'i spu ris mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su skye ba nyams su blangs pas sangs rgyas nas mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can gang dang mjal ba'i las bsags pa der sku skye ba sna tshogs su bzhes dgos pas/ rje sgam po pa pad+ma'i bla mar sangs rgyas la/ thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa de/ 'dir rje btsun dang mjal nas se ba lung du gzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba de/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yin/ khyod kyis da lta mi go gsungs// //sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis zla 'od gzhon nu la ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po gtad pa de/ deng sang gi phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid ma lags sam zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid yin/ snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sems can 'di rnams ting nge 'dzin 'di min pas mi thul bas/ mgon po zla 'od gzhon nus nged rang rnams la thugs rjes gzigs pa yin mod gsungs// //rje sgam po pa'i bzhed kyis rgyud sde rin po che bzhi gang zag gi nyams su len pa'i khrid kyi rim par bzhed pa dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rtogs par dka' zhing rgyud sde bzhi'i snying por gsungs pa la/ de rnams sa bcu'i mgon po la sogs pa'i yul du 'dug pa la/ 'dul ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyag cig gi spyod yul yin pa la/ sa bcu'i mgon pos kyang dpag par dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ sems can gyi rgyud la nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa rtog pa'i spu ris mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su skye bas/ las sna tshogs su tshogs pas sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa/ sa bcu'i mgon pos kyang mi mkhyen pas/ 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyag cig gi spyod yul yin pa dang*/ gsang sngags su rdo rje'i lus la rtsa gang gnas su rlung gnas/ rlung gang gnas par byang chub kyi sems gnas tshul rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs mthar thug thugs su chud pa rdo rje 'chang nyag cig gi spyod yul yin te/

sa bcu'i mgon pos kyang mthar thug tu ma rtogs gsung*/ 'o na shā ri'i bus dri ba la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs la lan 'debs pa'i spobs pa shes rab snying por gsungs pa snyam na/ de nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs yin te/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang*// 'chad dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang*// mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa// de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu// gsungs// //chos thams cad rkyen la ltos pas thams cad lung ma bstan yin na/ sangs rgyas kyang lung ma bstan du mchi'am zhus pas/ sangs rgyas la gdul bya'i sems can rnams kyis mthong tshul tha dad pas 'phrin las kyi 'jug sgo ma nges pas na/ de tsam cig lung ma bstan du gsungs// //chos kyi 'khor lo gsum po snga ma la phyi ma'i sa bon du bzhag par gsungs pas/ sa bon gnyis po gang lags zhus pas/ bden bzhi'i skabs su kun 'byung shes zin shes par bya ba gzhan med gsung ba la sogs pa bzhi po mtshan ma med pa'i sa bon yin la/ mtshan ma med pa'i skabs su/ sems dang yid dang rnam shes mthong med pa// de ni chos mthong yin zhes 'dren pa rnams kyis gsungs// nges don gyi sa bon yin gsung*/ nges don gyi go ba mtshan ma med pa nyid du nges shing*/ gtsang ba rtag pa bde ba bdag dam pa'i yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin la/ 'das pa la mi sems ma 'ongs pa la yid mi 'jug da ltar ba la rnam par shes pa mi gnas pa ni nges don yin gsungs// //len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra// sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes// nyan thos byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan// gsungs pa de// ji ltar lags zhus pas/ de len pa'i rnam par shes pa da ltar skye bzhin pa'i rnam par rtog pa rig rig tur tur po 'di rang yin/

de zab cing phra ba rtogs par dka' ba yin/ sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab pa ni/ rig rig tur tur po de la sogs pa yin/ nyan thos rnams la ma bstan pa ni/ nyan thos kyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma bstan pa yin gsungs// //gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir na de// gsung ba'i don ji ltar lags zhus pas/ 'di rang sangs rgyas la gsungs pa yin te/ phyi gzung ba'i yul mi 'dzin pa ni/ gzung don rtog pa spong ba yin la/ 'dzin pa mi spong ba ni dben pa'i gnas su kho rang gi ting 'dzin la ngo mtshar du 'dzin cing de nyid kyi rgyun mi gtong ba de yin/ rang nyid kyi rgyud la sbyar na/ lus sems stong par rtogs pa gzung 'dzin rtog pa spangs pa yin/ de nyid bsgoms pas nyams myong bzang po skyes pa la/ bdag tu 'dzin cing 'bral bar mi 'dod pa ni 'dzin pa mi spong ba yin gsungs// //gang zag gi bdag med pa dang chos kyi bdag med kyi ngos 'dzin zhig zhu zhus pas/ gang zag gi bdag med phung po lnga bdag med du rtogs pa yin la/ lam 'phags pa'i bden pas 'gog pa byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i chos cig yod par 'dod de/ de ma grub par rtogs pa chos kyi bdag med yin gsungs// //drang don la sogs pa mtha' drug po la/ rje rin po che'i bzhed pa dang*/ gzhan gyi 'dod lugs gang lags zhus pas/ gzhan gyi sangs rgyas la seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa med de sems can 'ga' zhig gis snang ba la/ drang don yin te/ 'dir ni seng ldeng gi tshal ba rgyu song gi 'bras bu yin pas/ nges don du bzhed/ gzhan gyis seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa med la/ zug gsungs pas zug par bstan gsungs pas/ sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin par 'dod de/ 'dir ni zug pa la zug par bzung bas sgra ji bzhin par bzhed/ gzhan gyis sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa ma yin te/ sems can 'ga' zhig 'dren pa'i don du gsungs pas/

dgongs pa can du 'dod de/ 'dir ni gshis dang babs su nges gsungs pas/ dgongs min du bzhed gsungs// //byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab pa'i rgya bdun po de gang lags zhus pas/ dpe'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas 'bring rnam gsum la sogs pa yin/ don gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa la/ rgya rim pa bdun po de ni rnam shes tshogs drug nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang bdun yin gsungs// //nad kyi ngo bo gang yin pa de gsol ba 'debs pa'i bla mar bsgom gsung ba de gang lags zhus pas/ nad kyi stobs ci tsam drag pa de tsam du na sa de rang du 'jig rten mgon po shin tu gsal bar bsgoms na/ nad 'dus byas 'jig pa yin gsungs// //sa bcu'i mgon po la 'khor dul ba mtha' yas pa mang ba de/ dang po nas rgyud dag pa sha stag 'ong ba lags sam zhus pas/ rgyud dag pa 'ong ba yin/ sa bcu'i mgon pos 'phrin las kyi 'jug sgo yod pa thams cad mi 'dul ba med pa yin gsungs// //sems can thams cad rim gyis sangs rgya bar 'dug pa la/ ma rig 'khrul 'khor 'di la zad med 'phel ba med gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ 'khor ba ni mtha' bral yin la/ sems can la mtha' med pas/ ma rig 'khrul 'khor 'di la zad med 'phel ba med pa yin gsungs// //lam gtong gi skabs su bdag gi nad 'dis nad 'di lta bus nyen pa'i sems can gyi nyon mongs pa dag par gyur cig ces lam du btang ba la nad de rang gis dag pa yin nam/ nyon mongs pas nyon mongs pa dag pa ma bde zhus pas/ bdag gi nad 'di lta bu'i nad kyis nyen pa'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal de bdag gi 'dis 'khor bar gyur cig ces pa dang*/ las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par gyur cig ces pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa de/

rang dang pha rol gyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba yin gsungs// //zhe sdang gi rtog pa nyams su blangs pas sangs rgyas pa'i dus su 'khor zhe sdang can rnams 'dul bar gsungs pa la/ sems can thams cad la zhe sdang yod pa la 'ga' zhig gdul byar 'ong ba de sngon zhe sdang la gnad du bsnun pa'i dus su/ gdul bya de rnams kyi rigs mthun gyi rgyu dgos pa lags sam zhus pas/ lam nyams su len pa'i dus su yul pha rol gyi mi snyan pa smras na skad cig ma snga ma la zhe sdang thol gyis skyes na/ phyi ma zhe sdang 'dis 'di lta bu'i sems can gyis gtso byas pa'i sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par gyur cig ces pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa des yul de byin gyis brlabs pas/ pha rol des 'di la tshig ngan smras pa ma legs snyam pa la sogs pa bsam pa bzang po skyes nas phrin las kyi 'jug sgo byung bas gdul bya'i rgyu de yin la/ zhe sdang gi rkyen byas pa la gnad du bsnun pas/ de'i rigs can rnams smin pa dang grol bar byed pa yin pa dang*/ spong sems brtan po skyes pa'i dus su bdag gis 'dis tshul khrims 'chal ba'i sems can gyi gtso bo byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par gyur cig ces gnad du bsnun pas tshul khrims dang ldan pa rnams 'khor du 'ong zhing*/ tshul khrims 'chal ba can gyi rigs can rnams kyi rgyud smin pa dang grol bar byed pa 'ong gsungs// //bla ma'i drung na ni med/ rgyang nas gus pa'i sgo nas mchod pa bzang po phul na/ bla ma la mthong snang ji ltar mchi zhus pas/ bla ma la rag jo bo rjes dge bshes ston pa la/ rgya gar na nga'i slob ma dge tshul zhig gis nga la mchod pa 'bul dril bu bsil gsung ba la/ dge bshes ston pas snyan gtad pas kyang ma gsan par gda' gsungs// //bla ma sgom pa'i dus su gdan ma gsal na/

bla ma yang mi gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ de tsug 'ong ba yin te gdan rtsegs bsgom pa gnad zab/ bla ma gsal nas gdan ma gsal na rnal 'byor pa de'i shul ngan par 'ong la/ gdan de gdul bya'i ngo bo yin gsungs// //sangs rgyas pa'i dus kyi mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo lam nyams su len pa'i dus su bsgrub dgos la/ sems bskyed pa dang rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i rtog pa chud mi za bar 'dod pa dang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi rtog pa chud mi za bar 'dod pa gang lags zhus pas/ sems bskyed pa dang rtog pas khyad par du byas pa'i rtog pa chud za ba ma yin la/ thog ma med pa nas kyi rtog pa chud mi za ba bde ste/ thog ma'i bag chags gshis sam rgyud la bag la nyal du yod pa de lam nyams su len pa'i dus su/ gnyen po'i rkyen gyis slongs pa de sems bskyed pa la rtog pas khyad du byas shing*/ gnad du bsnun cing sangs rgyas pa'i dus su mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'ong bas na gsum ga bde/ rten gyi gang zag cig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba'i dus su 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi bag chags rnams mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'ong ste/ rtog pa re re sangs rgyas re re yin gsungs// //'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bag chags 'di glo bur bar 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ rkyen glo bur bas slong bas na glo bur bar 'ong gsungs// //sngon gyi grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams tshe nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu thub pa de ting nge 'dzin nam thugs dam zhig la gnad du bsnun pa lags sam zhus pas/ pha las thob pa dang ma las thob pa'i dkar dmar gnyis gnas ma 'chugs na/ tshe nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu thub/ 'di la rlung sems la dbang thob pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs// //sangs rgyas rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i dus su/ cis kyang tho rangs su nges pa lags sam zhus pas/

cis kyang tho rangs su nges pa yin/ mdor na nad pa gcig la dmigs pa bsgom na tho rangs su zin cing nad phan pa dang*/ tho rangs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa'i dus yin pa dang*/ rtsa thams cad stong par yod pas sems bskyed bsgoms na rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rtsa rlung du 'ong bas/ lus ngag yid gsum byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum du 'ong bas na tho rangs shin tu gnad zab pa yin gsungs// //'khrul 'khor yang dkyil mo krung du nges pa lags sam zhus pas/ 'od gsal ba de thob par ma gyur tshe/ dkyil mo krung de bshig par mi bya gsung ba'am/ rdo rje dkyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas gsungs pas/ 'khrul 'khor yang de rang du nges pa yin te gsungs// //de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rjes su 'brang gsung bar 'dug pas/ de ci tsug lags zhus pas/ de yin gyis de bzhin gshegs pas 'khrul 'khor seṅge'i nyal stabs mdzad pas/ deng sang gdul bya de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba ste/ phrin las che bar byung gsungs// //sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi rdo rje'i gdan dang sku rgyab brten pa'i byang chub kyi shing gcig lags sam/ stong rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo ci tsug lags zhus pas/ gcig sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis rdo rje'i gdan 'di nyid du byang chub kyi shing la sku rgyab brten nas sangs rgyas pa yin gsungs// //chen po gsum gyis ma reg pa'i rtogs pa de gang lags zhus pas/ de gsum gyi tshig gis bkab pa'i blos byas ma yin pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa de yin gsungs// //rmi lam du dge ba stobs che la mi dge ba stobs chung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ 'di zhe 'dod kyis phul ba yin/ rmi lam gnyid kyi khyad par du byas pas/ gti mug gi rang bzhin yin/ dge ba skye ba dkon pas/ mun khung gi glog dang 'dra bas/ dge ba stobs che bar gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs//

//mos gus kyi lta sgom spyod gsum gang lags zhus pas/ lta ba rnam par dag pa phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa de yin/ rgyu 'bras kyi tshogs pa 'byung bas spyod pa rnam dag tshul khrims rin po che yin/ bla ma'i mos gus kyang de yin/ de dang shes pa 'bral ba med par byed pa sgom pa yin gsung*// //pha rol tu phyin par zas gos smad dkris sman bzhin bsam pa dang*/ gsang sngags su lhag pa'i lhar bskyed nas mchod pa'i tshul du longs spyod pa gnyis la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ khyad yod pha rol tu phyin par smad dkris sman bzhin bsam pas chags zhen ldog pa yin/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags su zhing bsam dngos gsum sangs rgyas su bsgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pas khyad par du byas pa yin gsungs// //lus lhag pa'i lha gdod ma nas yin pa la/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas su 'du shes bskyed pas/ phung po sangs rgyas la smod pa'i ltung ba mi 'byung ba lags sam zhus pas/ lus mi gtsang ba'i rdzas su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa las bdag tu 'dzin pa ldog pa yin pas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i thabs yin/ bdag med sangs rgyas yin/ lhag pa'i lha de nyid kyang bdag tu 'dzin na phung po sangs rgyas la smad pa yin pas rtsa ltung 'byung*/ de ltar yang*/ lha 'dod chags skyes na yi dwags yin// lha zhe sdang skyes na dmyal ba yin// lha gti mug skyes na dud 'gro yin// lha dug du song na mi dge bas// de bas lha la bya ra gces gsungs// //shes pa bstod na 'od gsal zin yang khams ldog par 'dug smad na gnyid du 'gro bar 'dug pas/ 'od gsal zin pa dang khams mi ldog pa'i thabs gang lags zhus pas/ 'di khrid kyi dus su smras pa yin mod/ sgrim dang glod pa'i mtha' dang bral bas 'od gsal zin pa yin/ khams mi ldog par byed pa la phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du gnas pa gnad zab pa yin gsungs// //rab tu gnas pa byed pa'i dus su tshad med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin las langs pa'i dus su/

me tog gtor gsung ba la/ snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs skyes pas gtor na rtsub par mchi'am zhus pas/ rab gnas kyi skabs su phrag dog med pa gal che/ phrag dog med na mnyam pa nyid la tshad med pa bzhi skye/ bkra shis dang bde legs thams cad byams pa tshad med pa las 'byung bas zab pa yin gsungs// //de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las byed pa dang bcas pa dang*/ byed pa med pa gang lags zhus pas/ de gnyis ka 'dod pa yang yod de/ rje rin po ches mtha' bral du bzhed gsungs// //gsang ba'i bdag po'i phyag gi rdo rje de khong rang min pas mi theg pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lam nyams su len pa'i dus su rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad kyi snyan la gsang bdag grub pa yin/ rna ba rlung yin/ rlung gtum po khro bor byung ba yin/ 'dogs par byed pa rlung yin/ de la dbang thob pas theg pa yin/ rdo rje 'dus ma byas yin pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pas gzhan gyis mi theg pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs// //pho mor grub pa la bar dor chags sdang gnyis so sor skye bar 'dug pa la/ ma ning du skye ba grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang lags zhus pas/ ma ning du skye ba'i las bsags pa dang*/ pho mor skye ba'i chags sdang rag pa ma skyes pa de yin gsungs// //'pho ba'i dus su rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugs gnas la mos pa bskyed pa dang*/ de nyid kyi zhabs drung du skye bzhin du bde ba can nam mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du 'dun pa btad na der skye ba lags sam zhus pas/ shin tu skye ste 'dun pa tsam ring ba'i rgyu/ nye ba'i rgyu'i dbang du byas na der skye ba la lta sgom spyod pa mthun dgos/ bde ba can du skye bar bzhed pa lta ba rnam dag spyod pa dge ba ma lus pa bsgrub pa ni spyod pa rnam dag /de nyid kyi rgyun bsgom pa ni sgom pa rnam dag

de gsum dang ldan na zhing der cis kyang skye ba yin/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa lta ba rnam dag dge ba ma lus pa bsgrub cing mi dge ba ma lus pa spong ba spyod pa rnam dag de nyid kyi rgyun la rtse gcig tu gnas pa sgom pa rnam dag de gsum dang ldan na cis kyang sangs rgyas/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ lta bsgom spyod pa gcig na sku gsum rgyun chad med gsung*/ mdor na bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ lta sgom spyod pa ma gcig na lta ba rkyang pas mi 'grub ste/ mu stegs byed lhar skye bar 'dod pa lta ba yin/ spyod pa lha rten gyi mdun na ba lang bsad nas mchod pa dang*/ sgom pa de nyid kyi rgyu la gnas pas lhar skye bar 'dod de/ lta sgom spyod pa ma mthun pas lhar skye mi srid/ kho rang tshe 'phos nas ba lang du skye ba de gzhan gyis khrid nas lha rten gyi mdun du bskor ba byed cing bsad pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba/ phyin ci log gi bsam pa'i rang gzugs 'grub pa yin gsungs// //de ltar lta sgom spyod pa mthun pas bde ba can du skye na/ rigs kyi bdag po gang 'ong zhus pas/ khyod kyi bla ma yang yin la/ nga la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa yod pas/ khyod snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing du skye bar 'dod na/ bla ma'i gsung gi rigs su byung ba'i rtags yin pas/ rigs kyi bdag po bla ma'i gsung gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa yin gsungs// //nyin par gyi dus su zhe sdang gi rtog pa skyes pa chun dka' bar 'dug la/ rmi lam du chun sla bar 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ nyin par bsam pa rtse gcig tu ma song*/ rmi lam du rtse gcig tu song ba yin/ bar dor de bas kyang rtse gcig tu gnas pas rmi lam dang bar do'i ting nge 'dzin stobs che bas/ rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin yin/ srid pa bar dor rdo rje gdan yid la byas pa tsam gyis slebs pa yin gsungs//

//nad pa la phyi dro'i kha zas nyes med du gsungs pa de gtan med pa lags sam zhus pas/ 'di thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'dri/ 'di la mu gnyis yin/ pha jo skya bo la mtshon na/ zas la rkam pa med cing lus la ma chags pa dang*/ 'chi bas 'jigs pa med cing sku des gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol nus pa zhig la sems can gyi don du gsol ba btab nas gsol na nyes pa gtan med yin/ de las bzlog pa'i rkam chags dang bcas pas zos na nyes pa shin tu yang yod pas phan pa'i dus su bshags pa yin gsungs// //yang dben pa'i gnas su zas bcud chung gi rigs la yang bcud can gyis nus pa bskyed par 'dug na de ci lags zhus pas/ de 'dra ba 'ong ba yin/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa dang*/ spong sems brtan pas 'ong ba yin/ 'di'i dus su mkha' 'gro mas spod la sogs pa 'debs/ rmi lam du mi ma yin gyis 'tsho ba 'dren pa yin te/ 'di la phan yon dpag tu med pa yod/ ngo srung sla/ phyi thag ring*/ mi'i zas bas bcud che/ khams 'phel ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs che/ 'di'i dus su mi dang 'brel bcad/ ri dang gangs kho na la sdod cing dge sbyor gyi rgyun bsrings pas rnal 'byor pa nam mkha'i 'brug lta bu 'ong ba yin/ nga 'bu la yang sngon 'ba' rom na yod pa'i dus su ja thung 'dod par byung ba la chu bskol nas 'thungs pas ja bzang po'i ngad pa bro zhing go chod par byung bas ja yi sred pa chod par byung*/ phyis ja phye bag cig byung ba bkol nas 'thungs pas sngon gyi de dang khyad mi 'dug de'i dus su dge sbyor 'phel ba'i gnad du song bar 'dug gsungs// //lus lus med/ sems sems med/ snang ba snang med du rtogs na/ yon tan gong ma la sgrib pa'i sgrib byed ci lta bu zhig lags zhus pas/ de ltar snang sems dbyer med du rtogs pa ro gcig yin/ bsgom med kyi sgrib byed de gnyis med dbye ba med pa'i tshul du rtogs pa skye ba de yin gsungs//

//rang la yul gang yang rung ba zhig gis zhe sdang gi sgo nas mi 'tsham pa bsgrub pa mthong ngam thos pa la byams pa skyes nas de nyid bsgom pa dang*/ lnga ldan gyis nyams su len pa gnyis gnad gang zab zhus pas/ de lta bu mthong ba dang thos pa la byams pa skyes pa na de nyid kyi rgyun la gnas pa zab gsungs// //zhe sdang skyes pa lnga ldan gyis nyams su blang ba dang*/ zhe sdang ma skyes par lnga ldan sgom pa gnyis gnad gang zab zhus pas/ zhe sdang skyes par nyams su blangs na zab ste/ sangs rgya ba'i dus su de'i rigs can gdul byar 'ong ba yin gsungs// //nyon mongs yul rkyen las skyes pa nyams su blang ba dang*/ dge sbyor gyis slong ba gnyis la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ yul rkyen la skyes pa so so tha mal pa la yang yod/ dge sbyor gyis slongs pa gnad zab ste/ nyon mongs pa bag la nyal du yod pa de dge sbyor gyis slongs pa yin te/ dge sbyor la gnad du song ba'i rtags yin gsungs// //mnyes pa gsum las lus ngag gi zhabs tog 'bring du gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu 'ong ba ma bde zhus pas/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed kyi dbang byas pa'i lus ngag gi zhabs tog byas na/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim par mi 'ong*/ kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi rim 'gro ba yin pa sku dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral ba med pa ste/ phyi rim par mi gda'/ bsngo ba sems bskyed ma dran zhing zas gos gcig pu don du gnyer ba'i ched du zhabs tog byas na phyi rim par 'ong gsungs// //bla ma la cha rkyen dngos po 'bul rgyu yod na/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed gnad du 'gro sla zhing*/ lus ngag gi zhabs tog byas pa la bsngo ba sems bskyed gnad du 'gro dka' bar 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ yid ches skyes ma skyes yin/ rdzas kyi dngos po de rang nyid la 'phangs par yod pa de/

'bul ba smin phrag shin tu bsdus nas bsgom na gnad du song ba yin/ zhabs tog byed pa la yang bla ma mnyes pa'i phrin las 'di lta bu bsgrub tu yod pa de dga' snyam na bsngo ba sems bskyed gnad du mi 'gro ba'i don med de/ de lta bu yid ches ma skyes pa'i rtags yin gsungs// //sangs rgyas pa'i dus na phrin las mi chung cher 'gro ba la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'ga' zhig yun ring du sangs mi rgya ba'i smon lam 'debs pa'i rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ nga 'di la dpal chen po'i grub mtha' la 'thu/ sa bcu yod ring la shes sgrib kyis mi gle gsungs// //rang la nad phog pa'i dus su dmigs pa bsgom pa la bla ma'i sku'i rim 'gror bsngos pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du bsngos pa gnyis la khyad ci yod zhus pas/ 'di la nad ma sos pa dang*/ sos pa tsam dang*/ yon tan gyi gter 'byed pa dang gsum yin/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa bsgom pa 'dra ba la/ sbyor ba dang rjes la gnad du bsnun pas khyad par du byas pas yon tan rin po che'i gter kha bye ba yin/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas dngos gzhi sab sob phal mo che la yod/ nga 'bu sbyor ba dang rjes la thugs rtsis che ba yin/ des na lnga ldan gyis nyams su blangs nas dmigs pa bsgom pas bla ma'i sku'i rim 'gror 'gro zhing nad sos pa yon tan rin po che'i gter kha bye nas 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen por 'gro ba dang*/ longs spyod kyang de las grub pa zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs// //dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mchod pas/ bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod dga' gsung bar 'dug pas/ bla ma la bzhes pa zhig 'dren rgyu yod na bla mas gsol ba dang*/ bla ma la grogs po gces pa zhig byung ba la gzhan ster rgyu yang med/ de nyid byin na bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par 'dug na/ de gnyis gang zab zhus pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mchod pas bla ma'i ba spu cig mchod dga' gsung ba de nges pa yin la/

mchod pa de bla ma gang mnyes par byed pa mchod pa yin/ de ltar yang bla ma mnyes byed gang yin bya// mi mnyes de kun spang bar ni// de dag de la bslab par bya// gsungs pas bla ma la bzhes pa zhig 'dren rgyu yod na/ bla ma'i mgron gces pa de la gnang bar bzhed pa la/ cis kyang gsol bar zhus pas mi mnyes bzhin du gsol ba bas/ bla ma'i mgron la byin na bla ma'i thugs mnyes shing thugs dgongs rdzogs par 'dug na bla ma mnyes/ mchod pa yin pas de rang bsod nams shin tu che gsung*/ log par lta ba la log pa'i lta bar shes pa de yang dag pa'i lta ba yin gsungs pa de de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ de kho na yin/ log pa'i lta ba la log pa'i lta bar ma shes na log lta de nyid mthar thug tu 'dzin cing*/ de nyid la yid 'byung ba'i bsam pa mi 'byung ba de nyid rang log lta yin gsungs// //rdo rje gdan dang ma yi mngal// gnyis po ma gtogs thogs med rgyu// gsung ba de/ rdo rje gdan gyi ngos 'dzin dang de gnyis la rdugs pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig zhu zhus pas/ rdo rje gdan rgya gar gyi rdo rje gdan la 'dod pa yang yod/ rdo rje gdan de yin na a tsar phru gu bdog pa mang po yang yod pa de rnams kyang rdugs dgos/ rang gi sems nyid rdo rje'i gdan yin/ de ltar yang sems nyid rdo rje'i gdan drung na ces pa dang*/ de nyid rtogs par dka' ba la dgongs pa yin/ rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa dang mi ldan na ma'i mngal la yang rdugs pa yin/ de gnyis min pa gang la'ang mi rdugs pa yin gsungs// //yon bdag mo slob dpon la chags pas/ slob dpon la ni nyes pa med pa la/ mo la slob dpon 'dra ba'i bu tsha gtsas pas/ slob dpon la skur pa byung ba bsal ba'i ched du slob dpon ar+ya de bas lam du 'grim pa'i srang du ma he dmar zal gyi gzugs byas nas bzhag pa dang*/ ba rnams la be'u ma he 'dra ba skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/

pha ma gnyis po'i lus la na ba'i sdug bsngal med cing dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan zhing zla mtshan gyi dus la gnas pa dang*/ bud med de slob dpon la chags pa'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs su yod pa dang*/ bar do'i rnam shes der skye ba'i las bsags pa dang gsum tshogs kyi rten 'brel 'grig pas bu slob dpon 'dra ba btsas pa yin/ pha ma de lta bu dang ldan yang bar do'i rnam shes der skye ba'i las ma bsags na der mi skye ste/ ma'i mngal rdugs gsungs pa 'di la dgongs pa yin/ de dang 'dra/ ma he dmar zal la chags pa'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs yod pa dang*/ bar do'i shes pa der skye ba'i las bsags pa dang*/ be'u ma he 'dra ba skyes pa yin gsung*// //deng sang ro gcig rtogs pa sa brgyad kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang rtogs tshod mnyam pa yod kyang*/ sprul bsgyur la sogs pa mi nus shing*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas sa lnga'am drug pa'i rtogs tshod dang mnyam pa las med kyang snang ba dang mi snang ba la sogs pa sprul bsgyur mang po nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ 'di bsam gtan bzhi yi ting nge 'dzin rdzogs ma rdzogs yin/ lhag mthong ro gcig gi rtogs pa yod kyang*/ zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin ma rdzogs na de rnams mi 'byung ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas zhi gnas 'jig rten gyi ting nge 'dzin la goms pas nam mkha' sar bsgoms nas dkyil krung bca' ba dang*/ rtsig pa nam mkhar bsgoms nas thogs pa med pa'i rgyu de yin gsung*// //rang bzhin gcig tu ma nges pas/ gang ltar brtags pa de ltar snang*// bya ba dang*/ gshis la mi gnas na bltas pas mi 'gyur bya ba'i rgyu mtshan zhig zhu zhus pas/ rang bzhin gcig tu ma nges zhes pa ni/ chos thams cad grub pa med pa la dgongs la/ gang ltar brtags pa de ltar snang zhes pa ni/ grub pa med pa'i ngang nas ji ltar bsgrubs pa ltar 'byung ste/ de la 'khor 'das gnyis kyang ji ltar 'byung ba yin/

don gnyis pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyis chu la mi bying ba'am/ nam mkha' dngos por bsgrubs nas thal mo gdabs pas sgra 'byung ba nam mkha' la dngos po ni med snyam na/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin thob pas de ltar byung ba yin/ rten 'brel de rgyu med pa la bltas pas byung ba ma yin/ rgyu bsgrubs pas ting nge 'dzin skye/ de 'dris shing goms par byas pa la brten nas thob par 'gyur ba yin/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel ji ltar bsgrubs pa ltar 'byung gsungs// //las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sngon la spong zhing shes bya'i sgrib pa phyi nas spong bar gsungs pa la/ rje btsun chen pos shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon nas spong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ shes par bya ba'i yul sangs rgyas la bsgrib ste/ sems stong par rtogs pa'i dus su spangs pa yin/ de ltar yang 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas te/ de bas gzhan du ma tshol cig gsungs/ 'o na las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spong mi dgos pa yin nam snyam na/ de min zhor la spong ba yin gsungs// //shi 'phos nas sdom pa gtong mi gtong la/ gzhan gyi 'dod pa dang chos rje'i bzhed lugs bde ba zhig zhu zhus pas/ 'chi 'pho ba'i dus su sdom pa gtong bar 'dod pa la/ 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i zhal nas/ tshul khrims la nyes pa'i skyon med par bsrungs na/ rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs sdom pa'i ngo bo de mi gtong*/ bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin pa'i gnad kas gzhon nu rab byung tshul khrims la nyes pa'i skyon med pas zhing khams rnam par dag par me tog pad+ma la chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed dang bcas te mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par skye ba sdom pa ma gtong ba yin gsungs// //sdom pa gsum gnad gcig pa'i gnad kas so so thar pa'i sdom pa la skyon byung na gnyis po la yang skyon 'byung ba lags sam zhus pas/

gnyis po la yang skyon 'byung ste/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa gnod pa bzhi dang bcas pa las log pa yin pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i skabs su yang sems can rnams la gnod pa spong dgos/ byang sems dang spong ba dang dad pa dang ldan pa'i sems sun phyung ba na rtsa ltung 'byung ba yin mod gsungs// //dam pa'i chos 'dul bar chang ni nyes pa sum cu rtsa drug dang ldan/ rtsa mchog gis kyang blang bar mi bya'o gsungs pa/ rdzas de mi dge ba yin nam zhus pas/ rdzas de nyid la dbang po bsgyur nus pa'i mthu dang ldan pas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags su dbang po myos pa bkag pa yin/ 'o na ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gsungs pa ci yin snyam na/ gsang sngags kyi thabs khyad par can gyis/ dbang po myos pa'i nyes pa'i skyon bcom nas ting nge 'dzin gsal ba dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsgrub pa yin/ de 'dul bar bkag pa'i skabs med gsungs// //byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum gzhi spros pa dang bral bar gcig rgyud la skye tshul dang byed las kyi ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ byams pa shin tu 'jam pas bkra shis dang bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ byed las bde ba dang ldan par byed/ snying rje rtsub pa yin/ byed las sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed/ byang chub kyi sems kyis rang gzhan bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par byed pas/ gshis spros pa dang bral ba thun mong yin/ rgyud la skye tshul gyi las ma 'dres par bsags pas gang yin yang lnga ldan gyis gnad du bsnun na rang gzhan gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde skyid bsgrubs pas chog pa yin gsungs// //'pho ba sgom pa'i dus su ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig tu gnas dgos pa la sbyangs pa zhan pas rtse gcig tu ma gnas na dran pa tsam gyis 'pho nus sam zhus pas/ spyir 'pho ba 'di gal che ste/ 'chi khar gsal ba la da ltar gyi dus su bla mas gang bsnyad pa'i dmigs pa'i rim pa la gnad du song ba dang*/

dam tshig dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ da ltar yul dman pa la ma chags pa dang*/ bla ma bsgom pa gnad du song ba'i goms pa'i stobs yod na 'chi kar 'pho ba sgom pa la gnad du 'gro ba la tshegs med de/ goms pa'i stobs gang che ba'i phyogs su 'pho bas 'chi kar 'pho ba gsal bar 'dod na da lta'i dus su 'bad pa chen po dgos pa yin/ rtse gcig tu ma gnas na 'pho mi nus/ lus bcos te 'pho ba 'di gnad zab pas dud 'gro 'chi ba mthong na yang lus bcos te 'khrul 'khor seṅge'i nyal stabs byas na ngan song du phul yang mi skye bar gsungs// //yan lag bdun pa'i skabs su srog gsum gtong ba'i mchod pa gsungs pa'i srog gsum po gang lags zhus pas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i srog nyon mongs gsum po sdug bsngal srog /yul la zhen pa 'ching ba'i srog dang gsum yin gsungs// //smon pa byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can du 'dug la/ khyad par yang byang chub kyi sems kyis mdzad pa bzhed par 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ smon pa de nyid 'grub pa rgyu ci dgos snyam na/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pas sku de nyid la skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyur 'ong ba yin gsungs// //byams pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor 'di ltar yin bya ba zhig zhu zhus pas/ byams pa byas pa shes shing byas pa drin du gzo ba las/ shes pa byams lhang nge ba skye ba bsnyen pa/ byams pa'i shugs chen po'i rgyun la goms par byed pa sgrub pa/ zhe sdang la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs nam skyes pa'i dus su byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang byas pa las sbyor yin gsungs// //phyi yul dang nang sems can la chags pa dang bral na/ de las ldog pa chags pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba bzhin du/ ja'i ro la chags zhen dang bral na/ bral 'bras ji ltar mchi ba la sogs bzhi po ngos 'dzin zhus pas/

nang sems can mi mo nu ma can la chags pa dang bral na/ lha'i bu mo snyan gdub 'khor can gyis zhabs tog byed/ lha'i bu mo la chags pa dang bral na/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog byed/ de yang chags pa dang bral na yum lhan cig skyes ma'i ye shes dang 'bral ba med par gnas/ ja'i ro la chags pa dang bral na/ dngos po 'dra ba 'dod pa med kyang lag tu 'ong ba bral 'bras/ ma chags pa'i ting nge 'dzin de rgyu 'bras bsgrubs pas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsi yod pa la sogs mkha' 'gro mas spod btab pa la longs spyod pa la dbang na dbang gi 'bras bu/ rgyu song gi 'bras bu bslu ba med par 'byung ba rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yin gsungs// //gsang sngags gsar rnying gi khyad gang lags zhus pas/ slob dpon pad+ma yan chad zhe sdang 'dul ba gtso bor ston par mdzad pa rnying ma/ rje mar pa phyin chad 'dod chags dang gti mug la gnad du bsnun nas 'dul ba gtso bor mdzad pa gsar ma yin gsungs// //lta ba rkyen thub cig yod na dben pa bsten dgos sam mi dgos zhus pas/ spyod lam rnam bzhi khyad med kyang dben pa bsten dgos gsungs// //rje phag mo gru pa bla ma gong ma gang nas kyang gdams ngag che ba'i rgyu mtshan ci tsam lags zhus pas/ kho bo dben pa bsten yun ring ba las byung ba yin gsungs pas dben pa bsten pa gal che gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po dang yi dam zung 'jug tu rtogs nas phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa dang yi dam bsgom pa gnyis la khyad yod dam zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po thun mong ba yin/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa gsang sngags kyi khyad par du byas pa yin/ lha sku phyag rgya chen po bya ba yin gsungs// //'og min gyi ngo sprod cig zhu zhus pas/ 'og min la gsum yin te/ gzugs khams kyi gnas gtsang ma ris kyi 'og min ni dbang phyug chen po'i gnas yod/

gzhan 'og min bya ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sha stag gi gnas yod de/ dbang phyug chen pos mdo rgya che rol pa zhus pa dang*/ der nyan rang dang ma 'dres pa'i gnas zhig yod par gda'/ gnyis pa dpal ldan nā ro pa'i bzhed kyis spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga la zer/ gsum pa rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ babs sam gnas lugs kyi 'og min bsha' ma de/ byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis sam/ 'khor 'das gnyis/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa de la rdo rje 'chang ngam rnam par snang mdzad zer te/ de ston pa de lta bu/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos zab mo dris pas/ de dag mnyam pa nyid du rtogs par byed pa dang*/ dus rgyun chad med pa dang*/ gnas thams cad kyang mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i gnas der chos sku gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid du gsungs pa yin gsungs// //skye 'gag spros pa'i mtshan ma yi// sems kyi gshis la bsgyur du med// gsungs pa de/ rtog pa thol gyis skyes pa'i dus su sems kyi gshis de gar ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ rtog pa skyes pa de rang rtag chad kyis stong pa chos kyi sku yin gsungs// //stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung ba dang*/ rgyu 'bras stong nyid du 'jug pa/ de gnyis su med par gnas par go ba des lam dang rnal 'byor bzhi dang sbyar ba zhig zhu zhus pas/ 'di gshis kyi gnas pa yin/ rgyu 'bras stong nyid du go sla ba yin/ rtog pa skyes pa stong pa nyid du go bas las mi bsog pa dang*/ skye ba mi len pa'i phugs su yang 'di yod pa yin/ 'di nyi tshe ba'i stong nyid yin/ 'di'i skabs su mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla mas ma zin na nag po kha 'byam du 'gro dogs yod pas/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung ba 'di go na tshul khrims la gces spras su mi byed kha med yin/ 'di ro gcig gi rtogs pa yin/ 'di'i dus su rgyu 'bras la 'phrig tshud pa'am go ba'i 'go tsam pa yin/

de nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas skyon 'dag cing yon tan rdzogs nas shes bya sha mong gi sul bzhin du mkhyen cing dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas su 'gro ba yin/ de ltar bsgom ro gcig gi ngang la 'byams gyur na// lho dpal gyi ri la dar chen 'phyar// dgos 'dod kun mi 'dod bzhin du 'byung*// gsungs// //phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yod pa gnyis kyis gcig gis bla ma dam pa la dngos po'i tshogs bsog pa dang*/ gcig gis dben pa'i gnas su zhing bsam dngos gsum sangs rgyas su byas nas skad cig ma'i dus gnad de las ma yol bar rten 'brel bsgrig pa gnyis gang myur zhus pas/ de khyad yod/ zhing bsam dngos gsum sangs rgyas su byed pa de myur/ dper na nam mkha' la rdo bskyur ba dang 'dra/ nga 'bu sngon nub gling na yod pa'i dus su dge sbyor la gnad du 'gro ba zhig byung bas 'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i dus su rang nyid kyi gang ltar 'dod pa bzhin du bsgrubs chog par 'dug snyam pa 'ong bar 'dug snyam nas de nyid du zhe 'dod cig bsgrubs pas ji lta ba bzhin byung gsung*// //spros bral gyi rtogs pas mtshams sbyar nas tshe'i dus byas na ro gcig bsgom med du na 'pho nus sam mi nus zhus pas/ bar do dang po'i 'od gsal ngos zin na spros bral yin na ro gcig du na 'pho/ ro gcig yin na sgom med du na 'pho/ des na deng sang gi dus su spros bral de nyid rgyun bsring ba gal che/ 'di la bsgom nus na bar do'i khrid de zab pa yin gsungs// //snang ba rang sems skad cig ma'i 'khor lo yin pa la/ rten gyi gang zag cig gi shes rgyud la lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'dre ji ltar ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ skad cig ma yin pa kho nas skad cig ma rtag pa ma yin te/ rten gyi gang zag gi shes rgyud la/ bzang rtog ngan rtog gnyis yod de/ de las grub pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'dre gnyis yin/

bzang po'i grogs byed pa lhan cig skyes pa'i lha/ ngan pa'i grogs byed pa lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre/ de gnyis phan tshun mthun pa las kha da byed pa'i dus su gnyis ka 'drer ma song ba gal che/ 'di shin tu gnad zab pas mthun par ma nus na'ang phugs su ma zhugs pa zhig dgos/ nged rang rnams kyang*/ grogs po'i yon bdag gi lhan cig skyes pa'i 'drer ma song ba tsam re bsgrub par zhu/ shin tu gal che gal che gsung*/ rab 'byams phyogs bcur zhing khams rgyal ba yi// sras kyi thu bor bdag cag gyur nas kyang ni// zab cing rgya che dam chos gter mdzod la// mi brjed gzungs thob gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin shog /dri med theg chen gsung gi mdzod// ma rig mun sel bla ma'i gsung*// zab mo yi ger bkod pa las// byung ba'i dge ba dri med des// bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus kun// thub pa'i rgyal sa thob gyur cig /nor 'khrul la sogs byung gyur na// bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol// //

zhu lan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gces pa'i snying po ma rig mun sel zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 819) ༄// sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gdams ngag rin chen rgyan 'dra// rdo rje 'chang sogs bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// dag pa ye shes thugs mnga' ba'i// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa rnams kyi rjes 'brangs nas// sems can blo yi mun sel cing*// dad ldan sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i phyir// gdams ngag rin chen rgyan 'dra bri// de la rnam pa gsum yin te// lta ba gtan la dbab pa dang*// 'khrul pa'i phu thag gcod pa dang*// rang sems srang du gzhug pa'o// dang po lta ba bstan pa ni// dpal ldan nā ro chen po yis// rgyu sde rnams kyi dgongs pa yang*// rnam pa gsum du 'dus par bshad// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// dngos po'i gnas lugs lta ba ste// 'od gsal dang ni zung 'jug go// sems la ma grub ma 'gags gnyis// ma grub rnam dag 'od gsal la// ma 'gags lhun grub zung 'jug go// gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// gnyen por lta ba 'od gsal bstan// chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// gnyen por lta ba zung 'jug bstan// rnam rtog 'od gsal 'dod lugs ni// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rtsa ba sems// sems gdod nas dag pa'i de bzhin nyid// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// ye nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// gdod nas dag dang ngo bos dag /rigs kyi dag cing lhun gyis grub// bsam brjod tha dad mtha' dang bral// rgyun chad med cing 'dus ma byas// skye 'gag gnas pa gsum dang bral// kun la khyab cing dngos ma grub// 'gro 'ong med cing rgyun mi 'chad// rang byung bde chen zag pa med// de lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin// 'di ltar gyi snang ba sna tshogs 'di// rang sems bag chags 'khrul snang ste// phyi rol grub pa rdul tsam med// dper na skyes bu mig nad kyis// nam mkha'i skra shad ji bzhin no// de yang lang kar gshegs pa las// phyi rol don yod ma yin te// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// bag chags kyis ni sems dkrugs pas// snang ba'i 'khrul pa don ltar 'byung*// zhes so/

phyi rol gyi snang ba rang snang yin// sems ye nas rang byung chos sku yin// de yang saṃ bhu ṭa las ni// rang byung ngo bo nyid 'di ni// chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags// zhes so brtag pa gnyis pa las/ rang dang rang gi rtogs pa las// sangs rgyas ma yin sems can ni// cis kyang yod pa ma yin no// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*// bshang lam srin bu la sogs pa// rtag tu rin chen bde ba can// 'jig rten khams ni gang du yang*// sangs rgyas gang du rnyed mi 'gyur// sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin// sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan du med// ces so gsang ba 'dus pa las/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs nas// chos bdag med pa mnyam gnas pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// ces so rdo rje'i gur las kyang*// 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// thog ma tha ma rtogs las grol// ces so// slob dpon bram ze'i zhal nas kyang*// gdod nas dag pa'i nam mkha' rin chen la// bltas shing bltas pas mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur// yang gdod nas skye med nam mkha' yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan mgon po bla mas bstan te rtogs// yang sems ni ngo bo nyid kyis dag pas na// de nyid dri med mchog gi go 'phang ngo*// ces so de ltar dngos po'i gnas lugs so// //nyams len lam gyi rim pa ni/ ma bcos rnal ma rang so la// shes pa glod la bcangs kyis zhog /snang ba med pa'i chos nyid la// yid la mi byed phyag rgya che// bag chags rnam rtog na bun bzhin// rang gi lag pas rjes ma gcod// dran rig 'khrul snang rjes ma gcod// mkha' la glog 'gyu rang log ltar// rang sar bzhag pas rang sar grol// chu rlabs rnyog ma bzhag na dwangs// sems rang sar bzhag na rnam rtog dwangs// dran pas zin pa shin tu gces// rgyun chad med par goms par bya// de yang rdo rje'i gur las ni// chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal la// gang gis goms pa de las gzhan// sangs rgyas sems can mnyam par 'gyur// ces so saṃ bhu ṭa las kyang*// rnam rtog ma rig chen po nyid// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par 'gyur// zhes so/

gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid la 'jug pa las/ stong nyid bsgoms pas grol 'gyur gyis// bsgom pa lhag ma de don yin// zhes so// do ha las kyang*/ bde chen gza' gtad bral ba chu bo lta bur bsgom// zhes so// lam gyi rim pa'o/ /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni/ lta ba 'od gsal rtogs gyur nas// lam brtson 'grus drag po mngon du gyur// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob// lus rgya brtsis gdab dag dang bral// 'bras bu chos sku rang sa zin// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa// 'od gsal chen por ro gcig 'gyur// dbyings dang ye shes dbye ba med// yin par rtogs pa dbang thob pa'o// dbang po 'bring gi gang zag gis// tshe 'dir 'od gsal goms gyur pas// rnam smin lus rgya grol ba dang*// bar do skad cig dang po la// 'od gsal gnyis po 'phrad nas kyang*// bde chen chos skur rang sa zin// rang snang rtsis gdab kun las 'das// sngon gyi smon lam thugs rje yis// gzhan snang gzugs sku sna tshogs 'byung*// de yang re zhig 'bras bu tsam// don dam par sku gsum mtha' las 'das// gdod ma nyid nas bde chen klong*// lta ba rnam par dag pa 'od gsal gyi 'dod lugs so// yang lta ba dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi// lhun grub zung 'jug gi 'dod lugs ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam gyi rim pa 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa gsum las/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum// rang bzhin stong pa spros bral la// mtshan nyid ma 'gags cir yang snang*// ngo bo dbyer med zung du 'jug /de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// rtog pa gnyis po sangs nas ni// gang rung dngos po gcig gyur pa// zung 'jug ces ni de la bshad// ces so// 'khor 'das gnyis med zung 'jug ste// snang stong dbyer med zung du 'jug /don dam kun rdzob zung du 'jug

/thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug /de bzhin gnyis snang thams cad kun// gdod nas dbyer med zung 'jug ste// dper na snang stong zung 'jug ni// snang ba las gzhan pa'i stong pa med// stong pa las gzhan pa'i snang ba med// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa'o// snang ba stong par 'gal ba dang*// stong na snang bar 'gal snyam na// de yang 'gal 'du'i skyon med de// snang ba'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid// stong pa'i ngo bo snang ba nyid// 'gal 'du'i skyon med zung 'jug go// snang ba'i cha nas ma bral ba// stong pa'i cha nas mi ldan pa// ma bral mi ldan zung du 'jug /ma 'gags phyogs nas snang ba la// ma grub phyogs nas stong pa nyid// ngo bo gcig la tshul tha dad// snang ba gang shar ngos zin tshe// ma rig snang ba log chos can// yid kyis kun brtags chos nyid gnyis// ngo bo gcig la tshul tha dad// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las/ 'khor nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid// 'khor ba spangs nas logs su ni// mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes so// de bzhin zung 'jug thams cad kyang*// 'khor ba'i phyogs nas ma bral ba// myang 'das phyogs nas mi ldan pa// ngo bo gcig la tshul tha dad// 'gal 'du'i skyon med zung du 'jug /thabs kyi phyogs nas ma bral ba// shes rab phyogs nas mi ldan pa// ngo bo gcig la tshul tha dad// 'gal 'du'i skyon med zung du 'jug /kun rdzob phyogs nas ma bral ba// don dam phyogs nas mi ldan te// ngo bo gcig la tshul tha dad// 'gal 'du'i skyon med zung du 'jug /de bzhin gnyis snang thams cad kun// ngo bo dbyer med zung 'jug go// de ltar zung 'jug ngo bo de// gnyis gcig tu stong pa lta bu min// gcig gnyis su bgos pa lta bu min// gcig re mor byed pa lta bu min// phyogs gcig yod phyogs med lta bu min// snang stong 'dres pa lta bu min// snang ba'i cha nas gzhan na yod// stong pa'i cha nas gzhan na med// de shes brjod yul las 'das pa te// mthar thug zung 'jug ces bya'o// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// rnam rtog ye shes gzugs can dang*// 'khor ba rnam par rtog pa gnyis// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// zhes so// yang de nyid las/

kun rdzob don dam rang bzhin can// byang chub tu ni rab tu bskyed// ces so// slob dpon bram ze'i zhal snga nas/ gang yang gnyis po sbyor bar shes pa des// 'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas// zhes so// yang gnyis med phyag rgya chen po'i gnas// ces so// pha rol tu phyin pa las kyang*/ chos thams cad gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med so so ma yin tha mi dad do// ces so// shes rab snying po las kyang*/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes so// gnas lugs lta ba'i zung 'jug go// nyams len lam gyi rim pa ni/ bum dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis po dbyer med bsgom// snang stong zung 'jug nyams myong 'char// gsang dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rlung dang 'od gsal dbyer med bsgom// gsal stong zung 'jug nyams myong 'char// dbang gsum pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// lam thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug bsgom// bde stong zung 'jug nyams myong 'char// bzhi pa tshig dbang thob pa yis// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bsgom// rig stong zung 'jug nyams myong 'char// sems kyi ngo bo dang rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum la/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs snang stong yin// ngo bo gsal bas gsal stong yin// rang bzhin stong pas rig stong yin// dbyer med bde stong zung 'jug go// zung 'jug nyams su myong ba yis// gnyis su 'dzin pa rang sar grol// re dogs gnyis med zung du 'jug /dgag sgrub gnyis med zung du 'jug /yul shes gnyis med zung du 'jug /bde sdug gnyis med zung du 'jug /bdag gzhan gnyis med zung du 'jug /re dogs med pa'i mtha' dang bral// dgag pa med cing bsgrub pa med// yul shes bde sdug gnyis 'dzin bral// de yang sgyu ma bde mchog las// 'di ltar rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das// stong pa ma yin mi stong min// zung 'jug bde ba chen po ste// shes rab pha rol phyin par gsal// ces gsungs so// lam zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni/

lta sgom mngon du gyur pa yis// 'bras bu zung du 'jug pa ni// chos sku spros dang bral ba dang*// gzugs sku mtshan dpe 'bar ba gnyis// ngo bo gcig la tshul tha dad// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa yin// shes bya ji snyed mkhyen pa dang*// gnas lugs ji ltar rtogs pa gnyis// ma bral mi ldan zung du 'jug /dbyings la ye shes kyis mi gnod// ye shes la yang dbyings kyis khyab// 'gal 'du'i skyon med zung du 'jug /rang snang mtha' brgyad bral ba dang*// gzhan snang lhun gyis grub pa gnyis// chos can chos nyid dbyer med par// lhun grub zung 'jug chen po yin// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// nga las 'gro ba thams cad byung*// nga yis 'di kun khyab pa ste// 'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong*// zhes so// yang rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler mkhyen// zhes so// las rgya mtsho'i rgyud las// spros bcas la ni brten nas kyang*// spros pa med pa rab tu skye// mtshan ma gzugs kyi sku nyid dang*// chos kyi skur ni zung du 'jug /ces so// gzhung bum pa las kyang*/ snying rjes mya ngan 'das mi gnas// shes rab kyis ni 'khor ba min// mtha' gnyis rnam par dor nas kyang*// chos kyi skur ni zung du 'jug /ces so// gsang ba shin tu mthong ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ dngos por lta ba rab spangs te// sgyu ma lta bur sbyor shes pa'i// sngags pas zung 'jug nor bu ltar// sems can don la bla med byos// zhes so// bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las kyang*/ gsang sngags lha yi tshul gyis ni// longs sku'i dngos grub bsgrubs pas 'grub// chos kyi sku dang rab gnas te// sprul sku phyogs bcu'i 'gro don mdzad// de ltar phyi rabs rnal 'byor pas// tshul de nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// gang zag blo yi 'jug phyogs kyis// lta ba 'od gsal zung 'jug gnyis// gang zag blo yi rigs las gsungs// sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i theg par gcig

/mthar thug sangs rgyas dgongs pa gcig /gang ltar brtags kyang 'gal ba med// rang re'i mos pa tha dad yin// lta ba gtan la dbab pa'o// sems 'khrul pa'i phu thag gcad pa ni/ 'khor 'das gnyis su ma byung ba'i// dang po'i sems de ji ltar gnas// 'khrul nas 'khor ba ji ltar byung*// rtogs nas myang 'das ji ltar byung*// 'khor 'das gnyis su ma byung ba'i/ */thog ma'i sems kyi gnas lugs ni// byas pa med pa'i rang byung ste// gnyug ma lhan skyes ye shes ni// de la 'khrul lugs rnam lnga ste// gzhi ci las 'khrul na gnyug ma la// rgyu gang gis byas na ma rig pas// rkyen gang gis byas na yid gnyis kyis// dpe ni rmi lam dag dang 'dra// 'bras bu khams gsum 'gro drug go// sems gnyug ma ye shes rang byung las// rgyu ma rig rnam gnyis 'byung tshul ni// sems nyid chos nyid 'dres pa de// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin// de nyid snang la ma nges pas// rang ngo rang gis ma shes te// lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa'o// gsal ba ngar 'dzin shes pa yis// shes pa rang rig nga ru bzung*// yul rang snang dag la gzhan du bzung*// rtogs byed shes rab dang bral bas// chos nyid don de ma rtogs pas// kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa'o// rkyen gang gis byas na gnyug ma'i yid// kha phyir bltas yid kyi rnam shes de// kha nang bltas nyon mongs can gyi yid// kun gzhi gnyug ma'i ye shes dang*// sgo lnga'i rnam shes ye shes gnyis// yid gnyis kyis ni dbyen bcug nas// 'phrad cing nye ru ma bcug go// nyon mongs yid kyis kha nang bltas// gnyug ma nga med nga ru bzung*// sgo lnga rtog med yin pa la// yid kyi rnam shes mtshan mar bzung*// yul shes gnyis su bzung ba yis// chags sdang las dang nyon mongs bsags// dpe ni srin gyi kha chu'am// rmi lam dag gi yul bzhin du// rang gis rang nyid 'ching bar 'gyur// 'bras bu khams gsum 'khor ba ste// mthar thug ngan song rnam pa gsum// ma rig ye shes rnam gnyis po// ngo bo chos kyi dbyings su gcig

/ldog byas kyis ni tha dad ste// ma rig 'khrul par snang tsam na// rtogs pa'i ye shes mi gsal la// ye shes nyid du rtogs tsam na// ma rig 'khrul pa mi gnas pas// de gnyis tshul ni tha dad yin// yang ma rig 'khrul pa snang dus su// ye shes gang yang song ba med// ye shes nyid du rtogs tsam na// ma rig 'khrul pa spangs pa med// rtogs pa'i ye shes mi gsal la// de gnyis ngo bo gcig pa yin// 'khrul pa ldog tu btub mi btub// ldog par phyin cing rtags byung na// 'khrul pa ldog tu btub pa yin// ldog par ma phyin rtags byung na// 'khrul pa ldog tu ci la btub// phyi rtags lus kyang 'byung ba snyoms// nang rtags mngon shes bying rgod med// gsang rtags shes pa rtsis gdab bral// 'khrul pa ldog pa la yang lnga// gzhi gnyug ma rang chas yod pa yis// rang gi rgyu yi chos lnga dang*// rkyen bla ma dam pa yin pa yis// mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa dang*// thabs ni gsang sngags gdams ngag ste// rim gyis pa dang cig char gnyis// dpe ni rmi lam sad pa'am// 'khyags pa chu ru zhu lta bu// 'bras bu rang gzhan gnyis kyi don// phun sum tshogs pa'i sku gsum mo// //rgyu rang gi chos lnga bstan pa ni// mos pas bla ma bsten pa dang*// dad pas 'khor 'bangs chos la 'jug /shes rab kyis ni chos don go// dam tshig bslab pa gsum dang ldan// snying rjes sems can byang chub 'god// rkyen bla ma mtshan nyid gsum ldan ni// sgrub rgyud byin rlabs chags pa dang*// stong nyid mngon sum rtogs pa dang*// snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'o// thabs gsang sngags cig char gdams ngag ni// gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa ste// lag pa'i gter bzhin ngo sprad pas// yid ches thag chod nang nas 'char// lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa// ye shes nyid du thag kyang chod// gnyis 'dzin kun brtags ma rig pa// nyams su myong bas rang sar grol// yid gnyis phra ma cer la thon// yul shes gnyis med bde chen klong*// de ltar ma rtogs gang zag la// gsang sngags rim gyi gdams ngag ni// lam bskyed rdzogs rtsa rlung thig le dang*// rmi lam sgyu lus la sogs la// brten nas ye shes rim gyis skye// nges shes skyes pa'i tha ma la// sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes// ma rig gnyis po rang sar dag

/dpe ni rmi lam sad pa'am// 'khyags pa chu ru zhu ba 'dra// 'bras bu sangs rgyas sku gsum ste// rang snang chos sku spros bral la// gzhan snang gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'byung*// de ni sems can grol tshul lo// gzhi chos nyid skye ba med pa las// sems can 'khrul ba ci yis lan// ma rig sgrib pa'i gnyid kyis non// rmi lam lta bur 'khor bar 'khyams// don chos kyi sku la gos pa med// ma rig pa yis rgyu byas nas// rkyen las dang nyon mongs bag chags kyis// khams gsum rgyu drug gnas su 'khor// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong*// de rmi lam dag dang khyad par med// ma rig rgyu yi 'khrul snang dang*// gnyid kyi rkyen gyis rmi lam dang*// sbyor sngags dag gi sgyu ma gsum// 'di gsum khyad par rdul tsam med// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel rnam gsum gyis// log pa'i kun rdzob 'khrul gsum yin// da ltar gyi khams gsum 'khor ba dang*// rmi lam gyi khams gsum 'khor ba gnyis// khyad par rdul tsam yod ma yin// da ltar gyi dgra gnyen zas nor dang*// sgyu ma'i dgra gnyen zas nor gnyis// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// de ring lha sbyin bsad pa dang*// rmi lam du mchod sbyin bsad pa gnyis// khyad par phra ba rdul tsam med// de ring dpal sbyin bsad pa dang*// sgyu mas rgyal byin bsad pa gnyis// khyad par med do skyes bu kun// de ring dge bcu spyad pa dang*// rmi lam dge bcu spyad pa gnyis// de gnyis don la khyad par med// rang gis sdig bcu spyad pa dang*// sgyu mas sdig bcu spyad pa gnyis// khyad par med do rnal 'byor kun// snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma la// dngos por ma 'dzin skal ldan kun// med bzhin snang ba 'khrul snang la// chags par ma byed skyes bu kun// gnyid 'thum sad pas rmi lam sad// sbyor sngags bshig pas sgyu ma grol// dpe de bzhin bla ma'i gdams ngag gis// rang sems lhangs kyis rtogs tsam na// ma rig sgrib pa'i gnyid chen dag

/rmi lam sgyu ma zhig pa bzhin// 'khrul pa'i snang ba gtan pa zhig /tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas// don chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos shing*// ci yang byas pa med par rtogs// 'khrul pa'i snang ba chos skur grol// sbrul gyi mdud pa ji bzhin no// blo gnyis 'dzin nam mkha'i mdud pa zhig /mun la khri gdugs shar ba bzhin// ma rig mun pa gtan nas sangs// dbul po gter dang 'phrad pa bzhin// rang sems sangs rgyas gter dang phrad// chu phran rgya mtshor slebs pa bzhin// 'khor 'das gnyis po gcig tu 'dres// lcags la gser 'gyur btab pa bzhin// sdug bsngal zag med bde bar 'char// tshong pa rang yul slebs pa bzhin// lhun grub chen po'i rang sa zin// de grub thob bla ma'i bka' drin lags// don dam du 'khor 'das ma grub kyang*// rmi lam sgyu mar chos byas na// rmi lam sgyu mar mngon sangs rgya// rmi lam sgyu mar sdig byas na// rmi lam sgyu mar dmyal bar 'gro// nges pa'i don la gang yang med// de ltar snang ba gzhi med la// nges med du snang bar rig pa la// so so a thang nges pa can// sngar bzhin phyis kyang snang ba ci// 'di bag chags sred byed shes pa yis// snga phyi gnyis po gcig tu 'dres// rigs 'dra gcig tu 'dres pa yis// de la yod par dmigs pa dang*// rtag par rtogs pa goms pa yis// de la so sor blo zhen pas// 'dra ba gzhan 'byung nas ni 'khrul// med pa yod par snang ba 'di// rang gi shes pa skad cig ma// snga mas dmigs pa'i yul byas nas// phyi mas de yi 'dzin mkhan byas// med pa yod snyam 'dzin pa byung*// 'dzin pa de nyid 'khor ba'i rgyu// des na bla ma'i gdams ngag gis// snang srid sgyu mar shes byas la// rang sems ma 'khrul gtan la dbab// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs so// snang srid rmi lam sgyu ma yin pa la/

brtag pa gnyis pa las/ sgyu ma ji bzhin rmi lam bzhin// mngon shes snang ba de ltar brtag /ji ltar rmi lam sgyu ma dang*// ji ltar bar do'i srid yin pas// rtag tu goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dkyil 'khor nyid du de bzhin 'dod// ces so// yang de nyid las/ spros pa'i rmi lam ltar bcas na// spros pa nyid ni spros med bsgom// ji ltar rmi lam sgyu ma ltar// dngos po nyid du brtag par bya// zhes so/ pha rol tu phyin pa las kyang*/ chos thams cad ni rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o// de bas lhag pa'i chos shig yod na yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o// zhes gsungs so// kun rdzob rmi lam sgyu ma yin// don dam du spros pa dang bral ba yin// de 'khrul pa'i phu thag gcad pa yin// rang sems srang du gzhug pa ni/ thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas// gzhi rang ngo ma shes 'khrul pa yis// ngan song gsum du gtan yul byas// bskal pa grangs med sdug bsngal myong*// lha mi thob pa rgyun cha tsam// da lan dal 'byor chud ma gsan// dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i lus// thob pa dka' la 'jig par sla// 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod mtha' med// bla med byang chub mi bsgrub pa// ngan song gsum gyis mi 'jigs sam// skye 'chi gnyis kyis ma bred dam// 'khor ba zhen pa ma log gam// rang re rgas pa cha med dam// gzhan dag 'chi ba ma tshor ram// thar pa'i skam sa mi snyog gam// rang yul bdud kyi btson ra yin// gnyen 'dun bdud kyi jag pa yin// zas nor bdud kyi zhags pa yin// da bdud las thar zhing bde 'dod na// rang yul spongs la chos la song*// tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas// phyi rol 'dod yon rnam lnga la// dga' dga' spro spro byed byed nas// dus da lta'i bar du 'khor bar 'khyams// da zhen pa thong la sgrub pa gyis// lto rgyab gnyis kyi tshis ma byed// 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po 'di// phyi nas bltas pas rus pa'i gzeb// nang nas bltas pas mi gtsang snod// chu rgyun 'dra ba rnag khrag rdzing*// rgyu ma mi gtsang dri yis gang*// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi nad kyi mkhar// 'di la glo gtad ma che bar// bya ba thong la nyams su long*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// thar bar byed pa bla ma'i gru// yang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// dam tshig sdom la rab gnas shing*// stong nyid thugs chud thugs rje che// shes rab don la ma rmongs pa// de 'dra'i bla ma dam pa la// lus sems lhag ma med pa yis// thugs gting nas mnyes pas byin rlabs 'jug

/brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma dam pa yang*// mos gus che la nyon mongs chung*// shes rab che la zhen pa chung*// dad pa che la bya byed nyung*// dam tshig snying rje gtong phod ldan// tshe 'di yid la mi rgyu ba// snod bcud 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis// ting 'dzin drod rtags khams dgu 'dus// khams 'dus pa gsum gyis drod rtags 'char// drod rtags nyams myong dwangs pa dang*// nam mkha' sprin dang bral 'dra yis// sems kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthar thug bde chen chos sku yin// bde chen gnyug ma'i ye shes de// bla ma rin chen thugs dgongs yin// bla ma'i thugs dgongs gnyug ma de// rang sems dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yin// bla ma sangs rgyas rang sems gsum// ma rtogs dus na tha dad ste// rtogs na gcig las gnyis su med// rang sems rig pa'i rdo rje 'di// phyi nas bltas pas 'dra ba med// nang nas bltas pas yin pa med// ci yang ma yin pa yi don// med pa ma yin pa yi dbyings// brtags shing dpyad pas dngos ma grub// dbyibs dang kha dog yul las 'das// blo yis reg na dug tu 'gyur// des na ma bcos rang sar zhog /sgrib pa bying rgod nyon mongs kun// rang sor bzhag pas rang sar grol// mnyam bzhag rjes thob rnam gnyis so// dang po rab rib sgyu ma tsam// goms shing je gsal je gsal 'ong*// nan tan klong du gyur tsam na// mnyam bzhag rjes thob dbye ba med// chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ro// 'khrul pa gzhi med nyid du rtogs// snang ba phyag rgya chen por 'char// de yang goms shing 'dris pa yis// brtson 'grus bya ba rab tu gces// ye sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid de// glo bur 'khrul pas ma slad ngang du zhog /rnam rtog sprin bzhin dengs nas 'gro// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rtsa ba yang*// rang sems rtogs dang ma rtogs yin// sems gnyis 'dzin du 'khrul na 'khor ba yin// gnyis med du rtogs na sangs rgyas yin// phyi 'khrul pa la bltas na nyon mongs 'khor ba yin// nang sems nyid la bltas na ye shes yin// blo bya byed mang na kun rdzob yin// sems rang sor sdod na don dam yin// mchog thun mong gi rtsa ba bla ma yin// rgyun chad med par gsol ba gdab// nyams rtogs kyi rtsa ba mos gus yin// da ltem rkyang ma byed gdung ba bskyed// mthar thug gi rtsa ba rang gi sems// blo gnyis su ma btang dran pas bzung*// byang chub kyi rtsa ba shes rab gsum// da sgyid lug ma byed dang du long*// sangs rgyas kyi zhing sa dad pa yin// mi 'gyur brtan por gnas par gyis// thar pa'i rtsa ba brtson 'grus yin// da le lo ma byed myur du bsgrubs// rnal 'byor pa yi dga' brod de// ri khrod dgon par skye ba yin// bsnyen bkur ma tshol dka' thub gyis// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo yang*// rang sems rnyog ma dwangs pas gsal// gcig pur sdod la nyams su longs// rang 'dod dang bcas pa'i chos bshad dang*// mngon shes grong chog rten 'brel gyis// mi mgo bskor bas dmyal bar 'gro// rang la rang snying mi rje'am// da mi mgo ma bskor nags su song*// bde 'cham yul gyi dgon pa 'di// skyid chos sos bde'i gnas yin kyang*// nyams rtogs ri khrod kyi dgon par 'phel// da shi yang ri khrod dgon par snyogs// rang sems rdo rje bsgoms tsam na// phyi 'khrul pa'i yul la ma blta bar// nang sems nyid kyi ngo bo gtan la phob// yul snang sems gnyis kyi cho 'phrul la// gzhan rgyud la rtog pa ma byed cig

/gcig la gnyis su phye bas 'khrul// des na gnyug ma rang so bzung*// sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mnyam bzhag la// go yul gyi rtog pa dran pas 'joms// blos byas rtogs pa'i bsu bskyel de// gnas lugs mi rtog mnyam bzhag bsgom// lhan skyes bde chen gnyug ma'i sems// rnal ma rang so go ma bshig /ye sangs rgyas la bcos na 'khrul// bag chags kun rdzob 'khrul snang 'di// rnam dag gzhi med chos nyid la// rtog dpyod dgag sgrub 'dzin pa spongs// ngo bo sing nge ye re ba// rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa yin// ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum// dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul yin// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// phung po lnga dang dbang po drug /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga// rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid// slob dpon bram ze'i zhal nas kyang*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes gnyis bral 'di las ma gtogs pa/ sangs rgyas che bar 'dod na rmug par shes par bya/ rang sems srang du bzhugs pa'o// dge'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil nas// rta chag steng ka'i dgon pa na// khyed dal bar bzhugs pa'i sgom chen pa// dal bar bzhugs pa khom lags sam// dad dang gus pa'i bsam pa yis// tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bgyis lags sam// bdag tu 'dzin pa thongs lags sam// gnyis med ye shes rtogs lags sam// bla ma mnyes par mdzad lags sam// sems la 'gyod pa med lags sam// rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams na// khyed deng sang bde bar bzhugs lags sam/// /ā+oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba da ta/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswa hā// //
